sessions.title: 'Blaseball': Game Development as Performance

summary.en: Blaseball explores game development as an ongoing performance involving its audience.
summary.zh: 《Blaseball》探讨将游戏开发视为与受众共同参与的持续表演。

sessions.title: 'Dead by Daylight': Integrating Shaders into the User Interface Pipeline

summary.en: Dead by Daylight examines integrating shaders and materials into user-interface production.
summary.zh: 《黎明杀机》介绍将着色器与材质接入用户界面制作流程的实践。

sessions.title: 'Diablo 2: Resurrected': The Art Direction and Pipelines for Resurrecting Evil

summary.en: Diablo II: Resurrected discusses preserving visual identity while rebuilding its art in three dimensions.
summary.zh: 《暗黑破坏神II：狱火重生》分享三维重建美术时，如何保留原作视觉特征。

sessions.title: 'Dreamscaper': Killer Combat on an Indie Budget

summary.en: Dreamscaper reflects on achieving satisfying combat with a small team and limited budget.
summary.zh: 《Dreamscaper》回顾小团队如何在有限预算下制作有满足感的战斗。

sessions.title: 'Knockout City's' Parallel, Deterministic, and Rewindable Entity System

summary.en: Knockout City presents an entity system supporting parallel execution, determinism, and state rewinding.
summary.zh: 《Knockout City》介绍支持并行执行、确定性及状态回溯的实体系统。

sessions.title: 'Naraka Bladepoint': Build a Popular Face Customization System

summary.en: Naraka discusses character-customization design, player priorities, and balancing defaults with personalization.
summary.zh: 《Naraka》分享角色定制设计、玩家偏好，以及默认形象与个性化之间的取舍。

sessions.title: 'NARAKA: BLADEPOINT' From Prototype to Release: Melee Combat and Battle Royale Games

summary.en: Naraka traces the development of its melee-focused battle-royale experience from prototype to release.
summary.zh: 《Naraka》回顾以近战为核心的大逃杀体验从原型到发售的开发过程。

sessions.title: 'PAYDAY 2': Leveraging Game Telemetry to Increase Engagement and Replayability

summary.en: PAYDAY 2 examines using telemetry and community challenges to encourage engagement and replay.
summary.zh: 《PAYDAY 2》介绍利用遥测与社区挑战，促进玩家参与和重复游玩的实践。

sessions.title: 'Psychonauts 2' Design Postmortem

summary.en: Psychonauts 2's lead designer reflects on decisions behind key systems and levels.
summary.zh: 《Psychonauts 2》首席设计师回顾关键系统与关卡背后的设计决策。

sessions.title: 'SKYWEAVER': Learnings from Launching a Trading Card Game on Web3

summary.en: Skyweaver discusses launching a free-to-play trading-card game with a player-owned economy.
summary.zh: 《Skyweaver》分享推出具有玩家所有制经济的免费集换式卡牌游戏的经验。

sessions.title: 'Star Wars: Squadrons': A Blast from the Past
sessions.title_zh: 《星球大战：战机中队》：重温昔日激情

summary.en: Creative director Ian Frazier connects Squadrons' 1990s space-sim influences with its modern design. He discusses concurrent VR and screen development, flight-controller support, and the team's testing and iteration practices.
summary.zh: 创意总监 Ian Frazier 回顾《星球大战：战机中队》如何将九十年代太空模拟游戏的灵感带入现代设计，讨论 VR 与普通屏幕并行开发、飞行外设支持及测试迭代。

sessions.title: 'Unpacking': The Fun Behind the Foley

summary.en: Unpacking examines the Foley production behind its detailed and varied object sounds.
summary.zh: 《Unpacking》介绍丰富物品声音背后的拟音制作。

youtube.title: 'Unpacking': The Fun Behind the Foley

sessions.title: 'Wordle': Doing the Opposite of What You're Meant To
sessions.title_zh: 《Wordle》：把常规做法反过来

summary.en: Josh Wardle revisits the choices behind Wordle's growth from a personal project to a sale to The New York Times. The discussion connects unconventional product decisions with the human consequences of building, expanding, and selling the game.
summary.zh: 回顾《Wordle》从私人礼物发展到出售给《纽约时报》的过程，分析其中偏离移动游戏常规的产品选择，并兼顾创作者与玩家面对增长和出售时的感受。

sessions.title: 1000 Hours of Difficulty: How 'Destiny' Builds Systemic Challenge
sessions.title_zh: 千小时的难度：《命运》如何构建系统性挑战

summary.en: Bungie describes seven categories of difficulty used to vary Destiny 2's activities and sandbox encounters. Solo and group examples connect player pressure, available responses, and practical methods for testing and tuning demanding content.
summary.zh: Bungie 介绍《命运2》用于调整活动与沙盒内容的七类难度，结合单人和团队案例分析玩家承受的压力、应对工具，以及高挑战内容的测试与调校方法。

sessions.title: A 'Chicory' Marketing and PR Postmortem

summary.en: Chicory's team reflects on marketing and public-relations work around the game's release.
summary.zh: 《Chicory》团队复盘游戏发行前后的营销与公关工作。

sessions.title: A Brave New (Virtual) World: Ethics and Governance of XR and the Metaverse

summary.en: XR practitioners examine ethical questions and governance challenges surrounding virtual worlds.
summary.zh: XR 从业者讨论虚拟世界的伦理问题与治理挑战。

youtube.title: A Brave New (Virtual) World: Ethics and Governance of XR and the Metaverse

sessions.title: A Good Guerilla Is a Hidden Guerilla: Improving Stealth in 'Far Cry 6'
sessions.title_zh: 好游击队员善于隐蔽：改进《孤岛惊魂6》的潜行

summary.en: The Far Cry 6 team examines how perception, detection, equipment, and combat-state systems were adapted to support a guerrilla play style. The World Aggression system provides a concrete example of letting players manage encounters by putting away their weapons.
summary.zh: 围绕游击队员的角色体验，介绍《孤岛惊魂6》对感知、侦测、装备和战斗状态的调整，并以收起武器、混入环境的 World Aggression 系统说明潜行设计。

sessions.title: A Guided Tour of Blackreef: Rendering Technologies in Deathloop (Presented by AMD)
sessions.title_zh: 漫游Blackreef：《死亡循环》的渲染技术（AMD赞助）

summary.en: Arkane and AMD discuss the Void engine's DirectX 12 transition and efficient ray-tracing integration, comparing Deathloop with the studio's previous work.
summary.zh: Arkane 与 AMD 讨论 Void 引擎转向 DirectX 12、接入光追的难点，并比较《死亡循环》与前作的技术变化。

sessions.title: A Hotline for the Games Industry: Lessons Since 2020
companies: The Games and Online Harassment Hotline
tags: The Games and Online Harassment Hotline

summary.en: An industry harassment hotline reflects on lessons from providing emotional support since 2020.
summary.zh: 游戏行业反骚扰热线回顾自2020年起提供情感支持的经验。

youtube.title: A Hotline for the Games Industry: Lessons Since 2020

sessions.title: A Platform of Platforms Bringing the G3x Handheld to Life (Presented by Qualcomm)
sessions.title_zh: 平台中的平台：让G3x掌机成真（Qualcomm赞助）

summary.en: Micah Knapp explains why dedicated handheld gaming called for a platform beyond phone chipsets. Cooling, controllers, haptics, audio, and a demonstration device frame the G3x discussion.
summary.zh: Micah Knapp 说明专用掌机为何需要区别于手机芯片的平台，围绕散热、控制器、触觉、音频与演示设备，介绍 G3x 的产品思路。

evidence.note: 已核对公开英文字幕的开场讲者与主题；导读仅归纳实际可见的开场内容，未覆盖完整演讲。

sessions.title: A Quick Guide to Intel's Ray Tracing Hardware (Presented by Intel)
sessions.title_zh: Intel光线追踪硬件速览（Intel赞助）

summary.en: Intel explains its ray-tracing architecture, shader practices, and BVH construction on Arc graphics, connecting current hardware choices with path tracing.
summary.zh: Intel 介绍光追架构、着色器实践及 Arc 上的 BVH 构建，并解释硬件选择与路径追踪的关系。

sessions.title: Accelerating Creative Workflows with Epic Games (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: 与Epic Games加速创作流程（Autodesk赞助）

summary.en: Autodesk examines Maya Live Link and ShotGrid connections with Unreal Engine. Animation streaming, facial shapes, timeline synchronization, and collaboration illustrate the workflows under development.
summary.zh: Autodesk 介绍 Maya Live Link 与 ShotGrid 同 Unreal Engine 的连接，通过动画流送、面部形态、时间线同步和跨团队协作，说明相关工作流程。

evidence.note: 已核对公开英文字幕的开场讲者与主题；导读仅归纳实际可见的开场内容，未覆盖完整演讲。

sessions.title: Acceleration Structures in Ray Traced Open World Games (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 光追开放世界游戏中的加速结构（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: Peter Morley discusses resource and memory management challenges in ray-traced open worlds.
summary.zh: Peter Morley 从光追开放世界的资源需求出发，讨论开发者管理内存时需要面对的技术问题。

sessions.title: Accessibility and Accommodation Microtalks

summary.en: Advocates share lived experiences and approaches to workplace accessibility and accommodation.
summary.zh: 倡导者结合亲身经历，介绍工作场所无障碍与合理便利的实践。

sessions.title: Accountability & Repair in Games: Healing Harm

summary.en: This advocacy session examines accountability and repair after gender-based harm in game communities.
summary.zh: 本场倡导分享探讨游戏群体中性别相关伤害发生后的问责与修复。

sessions.title: Adobe Substance 3D Keynote (Presented by Adobe)
sessions.title_zh: Adobe Substance 3D主题演讲（Adobe赞助）

summary.en: Adobe reviews its 2022 Substance roadmap, covering Modeler's beta, procedural modeling, application updates, plugins, and the Material SDK.
summary.zh: Adobe 回顾 2022 年 Substance 路线，涉及 Modeler 测试版、程序化建模、各应用更新、插件及 Material SDK。

evidence.note: 依据 Adobe 官方对 GDC 2022 Substance Day 主题演讲的回顾，仅归纳其中记录的路线图议题。

sessions.title: Ads As Your Asset: Improving the Player Experience (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 让广告成为资产：改善玩家体验（Unity赞助）

summary.en: Unity and Pixel United use EverMerge to discuss in-game ad design. The case connects monetization choices with retention and the value players receive from advertising.
summary.zh: Unity 与 Pixel United 以《EverMerge》讨论游戏内广告设计，将商业化选择与留存、玩家从广告中获得的价值联系起来。

evidence.note: 已核对公开英文字幕的开场讲者与主题；导读仅归纳实际可见的开场内容，未覆盖完整演讲。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: 'Cyberpunk 2077': Bringing Light to Night City
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：《赛博朋克2077》——照亮夜之城

summary.en: CD Projekt RED traces how Night City's cinematic lighting goals shaped technical choices for a dense open world with changing time and weather. Interior and exterior production examples expose the different lighting problems each environment presented.
summary.zh: 从霓虹都市的电影感目标出发，说明昼夜、天气与密集光源如何影响《赛博朋克2077》的灯光技术选择，并通过室内和开放世界案例分析各自的制作难点。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Advanced Weather System for Mobile Game: 'Dark Area'

summary.en: A mobile-shooter team discusses implementing a dynamic weather system within platform constraints.
summary.zh: 移动射击游戏团队分享在平台约束下实现动态天气系统的经验。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Designing the Terrain System of 'Flight Simulator': Representing the Earth

summary.en: Flight Simulator examines terrain representation for a simulation spanning the Earth.
summary.zh: 《微软飞行模拟》介绍覆盖全球的模拟体验所需的地形表达。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Kickstart RT: Easy Open Source Ray Tracing
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：Kickstart RT——易于接入的开源光线追踪

summary.en: This session explains Kickstart RT's use of a world-space lighting cache for reflections, global illumination, and shadows. It examines the algorithm and cross-API integration, with comparisons against conventional ray tracing and path-traced references.
summary.zh: 介绍 Kickstart RT 如何把直接光照存入世界空间结构，再用于反射、全局光照和阴影追踪；同时讨论算法、跨图形 API 接入，以及与常规光追和路径追踪参考图的比较。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: New Graphics Features for 'Forspoken'
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：《Forspoken》的新图形特性

summary.en: Forspoken's rendering work spans open-world precision, lighting, and ray-traced effects combined with rasterization. The session also examines AsyncCompute, variable rate shading, and an automatic LOD workflow from both technical and artist-facing perspectives.
summary.zh: 介绍《Forspoken》在开放世界精度、光照及光栅化配合光追方面的实现，并讨论异步计算、可变速率着色优化，以及自动生成 LOD 对美术工作流程带来的机会与难点。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Real-Time Ray Tracing in 'Hitman 3'
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：《杀手3》的实时光线追踪

summary.en: This case study follows Hitman 3's integration of ray-traced reflections and sun shadows into a raster-based engine. Geometry preparation, acceleration structures, material adaptation, and scheduling provide the main implementation topics.
summary.zh: 以《杀手3》的反射和太阳阴影为例，介绍在光栅化引擎中接入光追时的几何准备、加速结构、节点材质转换与任务调度，并涉及半影和接触硬化的实现。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Render Pipeline Shaders
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：Render Pipeline Shaders

summary.en: Zhuo Chen introduces AMD's graph-based Render Pipeline Shaders SDK in the context of explicit graphics APIs. The talk connects rendering-graph concepts with the SDK's architecture and examples from game workloads.
summary.zh: 介绍 AMD 的 Render Pipeline Shaders SDK，先解释渲染图与显式图形 API 所面对的问题，再分析 SDK 架构及其在实际游戏负载中的应用数据。

sessions.title: Advances in Spatial Hashing A Pragmatic Approach to Robust, Realtime Light Transport (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 空间哈希新进展：稳健实时光传输的实用途径（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: Pascal Gautron examines sparse volumetric reuse through spatial hashing, from ambient occlusion to global illumination. Large CAD scenes provide the application context.
summary.zh: Pascal Gautron 讨论空间哈希对稀疏体积数据的存储与复用，从环境遮蔽延伸到全局光照，并以大型 CAD 场景说明应用背景。

evidence.note: 采用同题、同讲者的 NVIDIA GTC Spring 2022 会话 S41194，属于相关活动版本；内容限于空间哈希、稀疏体积复用、光照应用与该页说明的 CAD 情境。

sessions.title: Adventures with Deferred Texturing in 'Horizon Forbidden West'
sessions.title_zh: 《地平线 西之绝境》的延迟纹理探索

summary.en: Guerrilla explains a deferred-texturing approach for foliage and alpha-tested geometry in the Decima engine. A visibility pre-pass feeds compute-based analysis and shading, leading into software variable rate shading and overlapping rendering work.
summary.zh: Guerrilla 介绍 Decima 为植被和透明度测试几何设计的延迟纹理方案：先生成可见性缓冲，再由计算着色器分析与着色，并讨论软件可变速率着色及任务重叠执行。

sessions.title: Ahistorical Accuracy: Bringing New Myths and Representation to 'Civilization'
sessions.title_zh: 非历史的准确性：为《文明》加入新神话与文化呈现

summary.en: The Civilization team explores how mythical heroes, secret societies, and underrepresented cultures fit a game built around player-created histories. The discussion weighs cultural representation and audience expectations while the series moves toward live operations.
summary.zh: 探讨《文明》如何在玩家自行拼接历史故事的框架中加入神话英雄、秘密结社及较少被呈现的文化，并讨论文化表达、玩家预期与持续运营之间的设计取舍。

sessions.title: AI Summit: 'Age of Empires IV': Machine Learning Trials and Tribulations
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：《帝国时代4》的机器学习试验与波折

summary.en: Microsoft researchers and Age of Empires IV AI developers examine where machine learning, including reinforcement learning, fit the project and where approaches fell short. Training, tool selection, runtime inference, and integration with a large game are central concerns.
summary.zh: 微软研究人员与《帝国时代4》AI 开发者共同回顾机器学习和强化学习的应用尝试，讨论适用与失效的原因，以及训练、工具选择、运行时推理和大型游戏集成中的技术问题。

sessions.title: AI Summit: 'Hide N' Seek': A Social Deduction Game Using Controllable Language Models

summary.en: Hide n' Seek explores social deduction driven by open-ended dialogue with controllable language models.
summary.zh: 《Hide n' Seek》探索由可控语言模型开放对话驱动的社交推理玩法。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Buffing Bots with Imitation Learning
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：用模仿学习强化机器人

summary.en: The modl.ai team uses Forge and Fight! to discuss building a hybrid AI system for multiplayer bots. The case centers on bringing human-like behavior to a PvP game whose players construct their own weapons.
summary.zh: modl.ai 团队以玩家自行组装武器的 PvP 游戏《Forge and Fight!》为例，介绍混合 AI 系统的开发，讨论如何让机器人表现更接近真人玩家。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Cities at Scale: Simulating Street Life on a Budget
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：大规模城市——在有限预算下模拟街头生活

summary.en: This talk explores urban traffic simulation built around scheduling movement a short time ahead. It follows the consequences for spawning, simulation detail, route planning, and responses to player-driven changes.
summary.zh: 讨论以短期未来交通调度为核心的城市模拟方法，分析这种思路对车辆生成、细节层级、寻路与跟随，以及应对玩家实时干预的影响。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Controlled Chaos: The Combat of 'Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy'

summary.en: Guardians of the Galaxy discusses the AI and design behind its companion-based combat.
summary.zh: 《漫威银河护卫队》分享伙伴式战斗背后的 AI 与设计。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Down with Nav Meshes: The Next Generation of Navigation Data
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：超越导航网格——下一代导航数据

summary.en: Havok's navigation research considers alternatives to nav meshes, with particular attention to corridor maps. Examples include choosing safe spawn locations and finding routes for differently sized characters, linking data representation to navigation queries.
summary.zh: 介绍 Havok 对导航网格替代结构的研究，重点讨论走廊地图；通过安全出生点和不同体型角色的寻路需求，分析数据结构如何影响导航查询与关卡验证。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Innovations in Procedural Narrative
tags: University of Kentucky, Department of Computer Science
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：程序化叙事创新

summary.en: Emily Short discusses procedural narrative through systems that respond to player requests. Mask of the Rose provides an example of assembling dialogue and actions around an NPC's willingness and motivations.
summary.zh: Emily Short 围绕响应玩家请求的系统讨论程序化叙事，以《Mask of the Rose》说明如何根据 NPC 的意愿和动机组合对白与行动。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Language Models on Rails: ML-Assisted Narrative Games
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：给语言模型铺轨道——机器学习辅助的叙事游戏

summary.en: The speakers show how a graph-based authoring tool can constrain language-model dialogue within a narrative game. A graph-building walkthrough and playable example address the challenge of sustaining coherent NPC behavior across player-specific conversations.
summary.zh: 演示如何借助类似 Twine 的图结构创作工具，为语言模型生成的对话提供叙事约束；通过建图与试玩过程，讨论个性化交谈中 NPC 连贯性难以维持的问题。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Meta-Character-Spatial AI Dynamic Cooperative Model in Digital Game AI
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：游戏AI中的元、角色与空间AI动态协作模型

summary.en: Final Fantasy XV cases illustrate a model that coordinates overall game control, autonomous characters, and spatial understanding. The session explains how these three AI responsibilities work together to produce changing situations.
summary.zh: 以《最终幻想15》为例，介绍负责全局控制、角色自主行为与空间认知的三类 AI 如何协作，说明动态协作模型怎样组织不断变化的游戏情境。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Invades MMORPG: 'Lineage Clone Wars'
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：多智能体强化学习进入MMORPG——《天堂》克隆人战争

summary.en: The Lineage team discusses reinforcement-learning agents created for Clone Wars and Rookies vs. Veterans battle content. The case covers training complex agents in an evolving game, practical training choices, and problems encountered during development.
summary.zh: 《天堂》团队介绍为 Clone Wars 和 Rookies vs. Veterans 战斗内容开发强化学习智能体的过程，讨论在持续更新的环境中训练复杂角色的方法及开发中遇到的问题。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Virtual Happiness and How to Measure It: Utility AI Revisited
sessions.title_zh: AI峰会：如何衡量虚拟幸福——再看效用AI

summary.en: This talk questions how designers interpret and tune utility scores, then proposes a shared unit for utility in game AI. Statistics, probability, and reinforcement learning provide the basis for examining what score changes mean in practice.
summary.zh: 从效用分数难以解释和调校的问题出发，提出游戏 AI 的单位效用思路，并结合统计、概率与强化学习概念，讨论分值变化如何对应具体决策。

sessions.title: AI Teaching: The Application of Wukong Human-AI Collaboration Technology in MOBA Games (Presented by Tencent AI Lab)
sessions.title_zh: AI 教学：Wukong 人机协作技术在 MOBA 游戏中的应用

summary.en: Tencent's May 2022 official interview revisits AI-assisted player education demonstrated at that year's GDC. This related discussion places the example within the company's exploration of technology that supports developers and new player experiences.
summary.zh: 腾讯在 2022 年 5 月发布的官方访谈中，回顾了本届 GDC 展示的 AI 玩家教学案例，并将其放在技术支持开发者、探索新游戏体验的讨论中。

evidence.note: 采用 Level Infinite 于 2022 年 5 月发布的官方访谈，文中直接回顾本届 GDC 的 AI 玩家教学展示。原文未列具体会话名或讲者，导读仅作相关访谈回顾，不包含未披露的算法细节。

sessions.title: All about Analytics: Understanding the Data You Need to Inform Decision-Making for Your App Business (Presented by ironSource)
sessions.title_zh: 数据分析全解：读懂支撑应用业务决策所需的数据（由 ironSource 赞助）

summary.en: ironSource's early-2022 App Analytics material connects playtime, session length and level completion with monetization and acquisition data. It frames these reports as a shared basis for product, marketing and monetization teams to investigate business questions.
summary.zh: ironSource 于 2022 年初发布的 App Analytics 资料将游玩时长、会话时长和关卡完成情况与变现、获客数据联系起来，说明产品、营销和商业化团队如何以这些报告为共同依据，分析业务问题。

evidence.note: 相关官方资料导读：依据 ironSource 产品负责人 Nimrod Zuta 于 2022 年 1 月 26 日发布、现由 Unity 官网保留的 LevelPlay 文章中 App Analytics 部分。该文并非 Aimee Meehan 的 GDC 2022 原场简介或逐字稿；只能支持同期厂商分析工具及其业务问题，不确认原讲采用的案例、操作步骤或结论。

sessions.title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Churn Analysis Applying Methods from Different Domains in 'Naraka: Bladepoint'
sessions.title_zh: 条条大路通罗马：《永劫无间》中的跨领域玩家流失分析

summary.en: NetEase Thunder Fire UX applies methods from other research domains to player churn analysis. The talk introduces propensity-score matching, difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, and survival-analysis ideas through the Naraka: Bladepoint context.
summary.zh: 网易雷火 UX 以《永劫无间》为背景，讨论如何把倾向得分匹配、双重差分、断点回归和生存分析等跨领域方法用于理解玩家流失。

sessions.title: An Epic Journey through the Audio Universe that is 'Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy'

summary.en: Guardians of the Galaxy follows its audio-production journey from preproduction to final mixing.
summary.zh: 《漫威银河护卫队》回顾从前期准备到最终混音的音频制作过程。

sessions.title: An Insider's Guide to Games Audio: 5 Cheat Codes for Easier VO (Presented by PTW)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏音频内幕指南：让配音更轻松的五个秘诀（PTW赞助）

summary.en: SIDE LA's Jessica Kent discusses recurring mistakes in game voice-over production. The session offers practical considerations for avoiding those problems during the VO process.
summary.zh: SIDE LA 的 Jessica Kent 讨论游戏配音制作中反复出现的失误，分享在配音流程中识别和避免这些问题的实际考虑。

sessions.title: An Overview of the 'Diablo II: Resurrected' Renderer
sessions.title_zh: 《暗黑破坏神2：重制版》渲染器概览

summary.en: The Diablo II: Resurrected team explains its decision to build a custom 3D renderer. The technical overview covers lighting, skin, HDR color grading, and order-independent transparency as parts of the game's visual reconstruction.
summary.zh: 《暗黑破坏神2：重制版》团队说明为何从零构建专用 3D 渲染器，并介绍光照、皮肤、HDR 调色与顺序无关透明等重塑游戏视觉的关键部分。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: 'FIFA 22's' Hypermotion: Full-Match Mocap Driving Machine Learning Technology

summary.en: FIFA 22 discusses using full-match motion capture to support machine-learning-driven animation.
summary.zh: 《FIFA 22》介绍利用整场比赛动作捕捉，支持机器学习驱动的动画。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Animation and Customization in 'The Sims 4'

summary.en: The Sims 4 examines animation choices supporting varied characters and customizable objects.
summary.zh: 《模拟人生4》分享支持多样角色与可定制物件的动画设计选择。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: How Hollywood Cinematography Is Employed to Support Games Cinematic Visualization
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：好莱坞摄影如何支持游戏电影预演

summary.en: The Third Floor examines cinematic visualization for Apex Legends' Fight Night backstory film. The case study focuses on applying Hollywood cinematography practices to the planning and development of a game cinematic.
summary.zh: The Third Floor 以《Apex Legends》的背景短片《Fight Night》为案例，介绍如何将好莱坞摄影方法用于游戏影片的视觉预演与镜头规划。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Microtalks 2022
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：2022短讲集

summary.en: Animation specialists from AAA and independent development share compact perspectives on character performance and communication with players. The session spans craft, technical practice, production culture, and small techniques that support game animation work.
summary.zh: 来自大型项目与独立开发的动画从业者，以短讲交流角色表演与玩家信息传达，话题涵盖制作技巧、技术实践、团队文化，以及动画师参与游戏开发所需的跨领域能力。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Sustained Animation Excellence in 'Apex Legends'
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：持续保持《Apex Legends》的动画品质

summary.en: The Apex Legends animation team discusses the working methods and practices behind its animation production. The session focuses on how the team approaches maintaining animation quality over time.
summary.zh: 《Apex Legends》动画团队介绍制作中采用的方法与工作实践，重点讨论如何在持续开发中维持动画品质。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: The Animated World of 'Ratchet and Clank: Rift Apart'
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》的动画世界

summary.en: Lead animator Lindsay Thompson examines the ideas and production process behind Ratchet and Clank: Rift Apart's animation. The talk covers both cinematic scenes and animation used during gameplay.
summary.zh: 首席动画师 Lindsay Thompson 介绍《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》的动画灵感与制作过程，同时涉及过场影片和实际游玩中的动作表现。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: The Facial Animation Pipeline of 'Marvel's Guardians of The Galaxy'
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：《漫威银河护卫队》的面部动画流程

summary.en: Eidos Montreal follows facial animation from simultaneous actor capture through processing and final polish. The discussion links Faceware batch processing and photogrammetry-based expression references to the demands of dialogue-heavy ensemble storytelling.
summary.zh: Eidos Montreal 梳理从多位演员同步采集到面部动画精修的流程，介绍 Faceware 批处理与摄影测量表情参考如何服务于群像叙事中的大量对白和细腻表演。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: The Tricks of the Trade
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：行家技巧

summary.en: Six experienced animators each contribute three techniques or ideas that changed their practice. Their examples range from workflow shortcuts to observations about human movement and ways of approaching a project.
summary.zh: 六位资深动画师各分享三项影响自己工作的技巧或观念，范围从操作捷径、人体运动观察，到面对项目时的思考方式。

sessions.title: App Monetization Priorities for 2022 and Beyond (Presented by Meta)
sessions.title_zh: 2022年及未来的应用变现优先事项（Meta赞助）

summary.en: Meta and mobile-game leaders discuss monetization opportunities using a global developer survey. The panel considers priorities and strategies amid changes in the app business.
summary.zh: Meta 与移动游戏负责人结合全球开发者调查，讨论应用业务变化中的商业化机会、优先级及策略。

sessions.title: Application of AI Technology and Organizational Design to Improve Game Quality and Productivity
sessions.title_zh: 以AI技术与组织设计提升游戏质量和生产效率

summary.en: DeNA's cases examine how to match AI research with concrete game-development needs. The presentation connects cross-project research management, organizational structure, and strategy for extending AI work across multiple products.
summary.zh: 通过 DeNA 的案例，讨论如何将 AI 技术与实际游戏业务需求对应起来，并介绍跨项目研发管理、组织结构和推广策略如何支持多个产品采用 AI。

sessions.title: Architecting Jolt Physics for 'Horizon Forbidden West'
sessions.title_zh: 为《地平线 西之绝境》设计Jolt Physics架构

summary.en: Guerrilla describes the move to Jolt Physics through bottlenecks in streaming and multithreaded game-object updates. The talk examines architectural systems designed around those interactions and explains how the studio uses physics in production.
summary.zh: Guerrilla 从数据流送和多线程游戏对象更新的瓶颈出发，介绍转用 Jolt Physics 的背景，分析针对这些交互设计的架构系统及工作室实际使用物理引擎的方式。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Building Night City
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：建造夜之城

summary.en: This session follows Night City's environment art from early direction to final polish. It examines visual pillars, production pipelines, and collaboration between environment artists and other teams in building Cyberpunk 2077's city.
summary.zh: 从早期美术方向到最终品质打磨，梳理《赛博朋克2077》夜之城的环境制作，介绍视觉支柱、关键流程，以及环境美术与其他团队共同构建大型城市的协作方式。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Costume + Body = Character
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：服装加身体，塑造角色

summary.en: This talk applies costume-design thinking to game characters, treating clothing as evidence of personality, background, and setting. It examines construction, fit, and material behavior while distinguishing costume goals from fashion design.
summary.zh: 以服装设计的思路审视游戏角色，说明衣着如何传达性格、身份和世界背景，并讨论结构、合体程度与材质在身体上的表现，以及服装设计和时装设计的目标差异。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Creating Casual Art at Hyper-Casual Speed in a Multicultural Team
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：多文化团队如何以超休闲速度制作休闲游戏美术

summary.en: Voodoo's Berlin team uses Plantopia to discuss establishing a casual-game art process inside a hyper-casual company. The account focuses on tight schedules and communication across cultures during the pandemic.
summary.zh: Voodoo 柏林团队以《Plantopia》为例，回顾在超休闲公司中建立休闲游戏美术流程的经历，重点讨论紧迫工期、疫情背景和不同文化成员间的沟通。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Designing the Settlements in the World of 'Horizon Forbidden West'
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：设计《地平线 西之绝境》的聚落

summary.en: Guerrilla traces settlement design from early concepts to detailed production work in Horizon Forbidden West. The presentation connects environmental design choices with the visual identities of factions and their inhabitants.
summary.zh: Guerrilla 从早期构想到详细制作设计，梳理《地平线 西之绝境》的聚落视觉开发，说明环境造型如何与各阵营及居民的身份特征相互呼应。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Hair Art in Games: Aesthetics Difference between Eastern and Western
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：游戏发型美术——东西方审美差异

summary.en: The speaker compares Eastern and Western hairstyle traditions and their influence on game characters. Historical references and NetEase examples frame a discussion of period context, personalization, memorable contrast, and challenging stereotypes.
summary.zh: 比较东西方发型传统及其对游戏角色的影响，以历史图像和网易案例讨论时代背景、个性化与反差记忆点，并反思发型标签和刻板印象在游戏中的延续。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Leading by Learning: An Introvert's Discoveries in Art Leadership
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：在学习中领导——一位内向者的美术管理体会

summary.en: An art leader reflects on three years of learning to lead as an introvert. The discussion follows early doubts, changing self-understanding, and communication lessons relevant to quieter people entering leadership roles.
summary.zh: 一位内向型美术负责人回顾三年的领导经历，分享最初的顾虑、自我认识的变化及沟通体会，为准备承担管理职责或希望理解不同领导风格的人提供参考。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: When Inspiration Goes on Strike
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：当灵感罢工时

summary.en: Using Stonefly's fantasy forest as a case study, Adam describes a concept-art process that can continue when inspiration is scarce. The talk considers practical approaches to generating worlds, characters, and images under production demands.
summary.zh: 以《Stonefly》的奇幻森林为例，介绍概念美术流程如何应对必须按时创作的压力，讨论遭遇创作阻滞时构思世界、角色和画面的具体做法。

sessions.title: Art Practice in 'Justice Online': Whisper Between Dances and Games
sessions.title_zh: 《逆水寒》的美术实践：舞蹈与游戏之间的对话

summary.en: Justice Online's action designers discuss collaborating with Chinese classical dancers and choreographers. The case follows motion capture as a way to bring staged performance and cultural references into character animation.
summary.zh: 《逆水寒》动作设计团队介绍与中国古典舞演员及编舞团队合作的过程，讨论如何借助动作捕捉把舞台表演及其文化表达融入角色动作与动画制作。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Actively Building Trust: Creating the Voices of 'We Are OFK'

summary.en: We Are OFK explores trust-based casting and recording practices for voice performances.
summary.zh: 《We Are OFK》分享以信任为基础的配音选角与录制方法。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Ambisonics and the Great Outdoors

summary.en: Game-audio practitioners discuss ambisonic techniques for spatial sound in outdoor environments.
summary.zh: 游戏音频从业者讨论面向室外环境空间声音的高保真立体声场技术。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Designing Audio Based Game Mechanics
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：设计以声音为基础的游戏机制

summary.en: Blind Drive supplies production examples for a discussion of mechanics built around listening. The session examines sound-centered interaction and how designing for an audio-only experience changes the usual sound-design process.
summary.zh: 以《Blind Drive》的制作经验讨论聆听驱动的游戏机制，分析纯声音体验中的交互设计难点，以及这种目标如何改变通常围绕画面展开的声音制作流程。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: From Weapons to Wizards: Transforming Aesthetic and Modularity in 'Tiny Tina's Wonderlands'

summary.en: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands adapts modular audio approaches to a fantasy game's new sound categories.
summary.zh: 《小缇娜的奇幻之地》分享如何将模块化音频方法用于奇幻游戏的新声音类型。

youtube.title: From Weapons to Wizards: Transforming Aesthetic and Modularity in 'Tiny Tina's Wonderlands'

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Game Composer's Toolbox: Interactive Music Composition Tips & Tricks
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：游戏作曲家的工具箱——互动音乐创作技巧

summary.en: Megan Carnes moves from interactive-music concepts to the practical work of composing and implementing them. Examples from Divinuet, Dross, and inter-view examine how musical structure can accommodate dynamic game behavior.
summary.zh: Megan Carnes 结合《Divinuet》《Dross》和《inter-view》，讨论如何把互动音乐概念落实为作曲与实现方法，在响应游戏变化的同时保持音乐自身的表达。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Style Wars: Variety In Scoring While Maintaining A Singular Voice
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：风格之战——多样配乐中的个人声音

summary.en: scntfc discusses adapting composition and production to different games while retaining an identifiable musical voice. Cases including Oxenfree, ELOH, and Old Man's Journey show how project research informs those choices.
summary.zh: scntfc 以《Oxenfree》《ELOH》和《Old Man's Journey》等作品，讨论如何依据项目调研调整作曲与制作风格，同时保留可辨识的个人音乐语言。

sessions.title: Authoring Efficient Shaders for Optimal Mobile Performance (Presented by Arm)
sessions.title_zh: 编写高效着色器以优化移动端性能（Arm赞助）

summary.en: Arm and NaturalMotion show how Mali Offline Compiler feedback can guide shader authoring and iterative optimization. The Mali GPU Datasheet provides hardware context for shader design decisions.
summary.zh: Arm 与 NaturalMotion 介绍如何在编写着色器时解读 Mali Offline Compiler 的反馈并逐步优化，同时利用 Mali GPU Datasheet 理解硬件特点，为设计取舍提供依据。

sessions.title: AWS for Games Keynote (Presented by Amazon Web Services)
sessions.title_zh: AWS游戏主题演讲（Amazon Web Services赞助）

summary.en: AWS product teams introduce game-development services, solutions, and partners in their GDC 2022 keynote.
summary.zh: AWS 产品团队在 2022 年 GDC 主题演讲中介绍面向游戏开发的服务、解决方案与合作伙伴。

sessions.title: Basics of Marketing Your Games with Streamers

summary.en: A marketing practitioner discusses collaborating with streamers across different games and companies.
summary.zh: 营销从业者结合不同游戏和公司的经历，介绍与主播合作的方法。

sessions.title: Battlefield 2042: Procedural Badge Creation with Substance 3D Designer (Presented by Adobe)
sessions.title_zh: 《战地2042》：使用Substance 3D Designer程序化创建徽章（Adobe赞助）

summary.en: Clay Shanks and Priyabrata Biswal examine the procedural tools behind Battlefield 2042's player mastery badges. The case connects Substance workflows with the creation of UI art assets.
summary.zh: Clay Shanks 与 Priyabrata Biswal 以《战地2042》的玩家精通徽章为例，介绍程序化工具在 UI 美术资源制作中的应用，以及相关 Substance 工作流程。

sessions.title: Benefits of a Customized Reaper Pipeline for Dialogue at Naughty Dog
sessions.title_zh: 顽皮狗定制Reaper对白流程的价值

summary.en: Naughty Dog's dialogue team reviews its switch to Reaper during The Last of Us Part II. The speakers explain the editing needs that motivated custom tools and show how those tools fit the dialogue production pipeline.
summary.zh: 顽皮狗对白团队回顾《最后生还者 第二部》期间转用 Reaper 的经历，说明定制工具所对应的编辑需求，以及这些工具在对白制作流程中的位置。

sessions.title: Black Excellence in Game Development

summary.en: This session examines the contributions and influence of Black creators in game development.
summary.zh: 本场分享讨论黑人创作者在游戏开发中的贡献与影响。

sessions.title: Blockchain and Games: What Every Developer Should Know (Presented by WAX)
sessions.title_zh: 区块链与游戏：每位开发者都应了解的事（WAX赞助）

summary.en: WAX's speakers consider how blockchain can fit into a game experience. The session discusses integration practices and the opportunities developers should examine when evaluating the technology.
summary.zh: WAX 讲者围绕区块链如何融入游戏体验展开讨论，介绍相关整合实践，以及开发者评估这项技术时需要考察的应用机会。

sessions.title: Blockchain Gaming Centered Around MIR4 and WEMIX (Presented by Wemade)
sessions.title_zh: 以MIR4与WEMIX为核心的区块链游戏（Wemade赞助）

summary.en: Shane Kim uses MIR4 to discuss the persistence of game value and its relationship to everyday life. The talk presents the studio's perspective on blockchain gaming.
summary.zh: Shane Kim 结合《MIR4》讨论游戏价值的延续及其与日常生活的联系，介绍工作室对区块链游戏的理解。

youtube.title: [GDC] Blockchain Gaming Centered Around MIR4 and WEMIX

sessions.title: Blockchain Gaming: How Good Tech Empowers Players and Player Communities (Presented by Dacoco - Alien Worlds)
sessions.title_zh: 区块链游戏：技术如何赋予玩家与玩家社区更多自主权（Dacoco与Alien Worlds赞助）

summary.en: Saro McKenna considers blockchain gaming from the perspective of players and communities. Alien Worlds' use of DAOs provides context for discussing competition and cooperation between player groups.
summary.zh: Saro McKenna 从玩家与社区的角度讨论区块链游戏，可结合 Alien Worlds 使用 DAO 组织玩家群体的案例，理解竞争与协作如何进入社区结构。

sessions.title: Breaking Down the World of Athia: The Technologies of Forspoken (Presented by AMD)
sessions.title_zh: 拆解Athia世界：《Forspoken》的技术（AMD赞助）

summary.en: AMD and Luminous examine integrating lighting, reflections, shadows, and upscaling in Forspoken, alongside the challenges of adding DirectStorage.
summary.zh: AMD 与 Luminous 介绍《Forspoken》的光照、反射、阴影和超分辨率技术合作，并讨论接入 DirectStorage 的挑战。

sessions.title: Breaking the Cycle: The Making of 'Returnal'
sessions.title_zh: 打破循环：《Returnal》的制作历程

summary.en: Housemarque recounts Returnal's development as a shift from arcade shooters to a larger third-person project. Creative decisions about procedural worlds and layered narrative are considered alongside team growth, unfamiliar technology, and pandemic production.
summary.zh: Housemarque 回顾从街机射击走向大型第三人称项目《Returnal》的过程，把程序化世界与多层叙事的创作选择，同团队扩张、新平台、新引擎和疫情下的制作挑战联系起来。

sessions.title: Bring It to Life: A Look at Omniverse's New Runtime Animation System (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 让角色活起来：Omniverse新运行时动画系统概览（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: John Malaska introduces character setup, retargeting, and AnimGraph in Omniverse. Graphs and state machines provide the basis for discussing runtime skeletal animation.

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: Trust & Safety as a Revenue Driver
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：让信任与安全成为收入驱动力

summary.zh: 讨论如何从玩家评价中理解情绪信息，并将其转化为团队可讨论的制作优先级，涵盖客观整理、度量方式，以及跨版本追踪可执行反馈的方法。

sessions.title: Community Perspectives in Product: Truly Knowing Your Audience
sessions.title_zh: 产品中的社群视角：真正了解你的受众

sessions.title: Community Validated Deployment: Why You Need to Go Earlier than Early Access

sessions.title: Company Respec: How to Pivot Your Studio and Team
sessions.title_zh: 公司重新加点：如何调整工作室与团队方向

summary.zh: Proletariat 回顾从小型移动团队发展为大型跨平台工作室时的几次转向，讨论组织弹性、团队评估，以及在不同人员规模下落实重大方向变化的决策与经验。

sessions.title: Composing for 'Lineage M': Modular Construction in Game Music
sessions.title_zh: 为《天堂M》作曲：游戏音乐的模块化构建

summary.zh: Winifred Phillips 解析《天堂M》扩展内容的模块化配乐，讨论如何拆分音乐单元、设计分轨并部署素材，以调整张力与对比，同时维持统一的音乐识别。

sessions.title: Creating the Many Faces of 'Horizon Forbidden West'
sessions.title_zh: 塑造《地平线 西之绝境》的众多面孔

sessions.title: Creating the World of 'Riders Republic': A Declarative Pipeline
sessions.title_zh: 创造《极限国度》的世界：声明式制作流程

sessions.title: Cultivating the Cloud from Latency to Game Engines to Cloud-Game Streaming, Samsung Dives into the Development of the New Gaming Hub (Presented by Samsung Gaming Hub)

sessions.title_zh: 《模拟人生》的包容性设计

summary.en: Catharina Mallet examines how The Sims team's hiring and everyday working practices make room for different backgrounds and experiences. The discussion connects employee participation with game decisions, alongside lessons from the franchise and pandemic-era changes.
summary.zh: Catharina Mallet 介绍《模拟人生》团队如何通过招聘和日常工作容纳不同背景与经验，讨论成员发声怎样参与产品决策，并回顾系列积累及疫情期间用工方式的变化。

sessions.title: Developing and Retaining Diverse Talent (Presented by Xbox)
sessions.title_zh: 培养并留住多元人才（Xbox赞助）

summary.en: Jen MacLean and Annette Gonzalez discuss supporting diverse talent beyond recruitment. The fireside chat focuses on retention and growth into mid-level and senior roles.
summary.zh: Jen MacLean 与 Annette Gonzalez 讨论招聘之后对多元人才的支持，重点交流人员留任及向中高级岗位成长的问题。

sessions.title: Don't Make My Job Easy: Effectively Pitching to Publishers
sessions.title_zh: 别让我轻易拒绝你：有效地向发行商提案

summary.en: This session looks at how publishers screen game pitches before reaching detailed budgets or vertical slices. It focuses on shaping the opening and overall presentation so a scout has reasons to try the demo and advocate for the project.
summary.zh: 从发行商筛选项目的实际流程出发，讨论提案在预算和垂直切片被阅读之前如何建立吸引力，使项目拓展人员愿意试玩，并有理由在内部支持这款游戏。

sessions.title: DOTS Authoring and Debugging Workflows in the Unity Editor (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: Unity编辑器中的DOTS创作与调试工作流程（Unity赞助）

summary.en: Damian Campeanu presents DOTS Editor tools for inspecting entities and systems, profiling, and tracing changes. The session also explores workflows that connect familiar GameObject authoring with an entity-based runtime.
summary.zh: Damian Campeanu 介绍 DOTS 编辑器中检查实体与系统、性能分析及追踪数据变化的工具，并讨论如何把熟悉的 GameObject 创作方式与基于实体的运行时衔接起来。

evidence.note: Unity 2022 年 6 月官方更新直接链接本场 GDC 视频；编辑器工具议题另由 Unity 官方论坛保存的原会话说明及讲者此前公开发言支持。6 月更新本身不是原始大会简介。

youtube.title: DOTS authoring and debugging workflows in the Unity Editor | Unity at GDC 2022

sessions.title: Early Stage Game Evaluation: Lessons Learned and Best Practices
sessions.title_zh: 游戏早期评估：经验与最佳实践

summary.en: NetEase reviews six years of early-stage game evaluation and the factors used to organize it. Three assessment approaches are introduced, with practical attention to the 3X10 method during a game's cold start.
summary.zh: 网易回顾六年的游戏早期评估经验，说明阶段定义、关键因素与评估组织方式，并介绍三种方案，重点讲解冷启动阶段采用的“3X10”方法。

sessions.title: Educators Summit Session: Abolish Points: Using Specifications Grading in Game Courses

summary.en: An educator considers specifications grading as an alternative to points in game-development courses.
summary.zh: 教育者探讨在游戏开发课程中，以规范达标评分替代积分制的思路。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: An Aesthetic Approach to a Virtual Reality Education

summary.en: This teaching session examines an aesthetic approach to education in virtual-reality development.
summary.zh: 本场教学分享讨论从美学角度开展虚拟现实开发教育。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Changing Industry for the Better
sessions.title_zh: 教育者峰会：推动行业变得更好

summary.en: These presentations discuss preparing students for healthier and more inclusive professional practice. Topics include teaching responses to crunch and broadening course materials to include more voices and social-justice perspectives.
summary.zh: 几位教育者讨论如何帮助学生进入更健康、更包容的职业实践，涉及在教学中反思加班文化，以及扩充课程材料、纳入更多声音与社会公正视角。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Integrative 3D-Modeling 101: How Centering a Course on Diversity Made Better Artists

summary.en: A modeling course examines how emphasizing diversity can broaden students' artistic practice.
summary.zh: 三维建模课程案例讨论如何通过重视多样性，拓宽学生的美术实践。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Strategies for Creating Productive, Healthy Student Teams

summary.en: Educators share approaches for building productive, healthy student game-development teams.
summary.zh: 教育者分享建设高效、健康的学生游戏开发团队的方法。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Teaching Escape Room Design
companies: University of Illinois at Urbana Champaign
tags: University of Illinois at Urbana Champaign
sessions.title_zh: 教育者峰会：教授密室逃脱设计

summary.en: Educators compare courses in escape-room design through teaching case studies. They discuss tools, space, institutional support, common pitfalls, and how lessons extend to VR and hybrid experiences.
summary.zh: 教育者通过课程案例比较密室逃脱设计教学，讨论工具、空间与机构支持等条件、常见教学问题，并分析相关经验如何延伸到 VR 和混合体验。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Teaching Games with Games 7: Changing the Game
companies: Parsons The New School for Design
Parsons School of Design at The New School
tags: Parsons The New School for Design
Parsons School of Design at The New School

summary.en: Educators examine how game teaching relates to wider systems and structures of power.
summary.zh: 教育者讨论游戏教学与更广泛社会系统、权力结构之间的关系。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Tools Dev in Game Edu
companies: Michigan State University / Will Winn Games Inc.
tags: Michigan State University / Will Winn Games Inc.
sessions.title_zh: 教育者峰会：游戏教育中的工具开发

summary.en: Brian Winn and Jeremy Bond demonstrate tools built to support classes, research, student projects, and team formation. Their examples lead into practices for developing educational tools and sharing them with other game faculty.
summary.zh: Brian Winn 与 Jeremy Bond 展示用于课堂、研究、学生作品和组队的多种工具，从电子表格到关卡编辑器与效用 AI，并交流教育工具的开发和共享经验。

sessions.title: Elevate Game Profiling on Intel CPUs & GPUs using Advanced Graphics Analyzers (Presented by Intel)
sessions.title_zh: 用高级图形分析工具提升Intel CPU与GPU游戏剖析（Intel赞助）

summary.en: Intel's GPA team examines interpreting bottlenecks across system, frame, and timeline tools. Ray tracing and XeSS provide examples for relating hardware activity to shader performance.
summary.zh: Intel GPA 团队讨论如何结合系统、单帧与时间线工具解读瓶颈，并以光追和 XeSS 为例，将硬件活动与着色器表现联系起来。

evidence.note: 已核对公开英文字幕的开场讲者与主题；导读仅归纳实际可见的开场内容，未覆盖完整演讲。

sessions.title: Emotion Based Creation Pipeline
sessions.title_zh: 以情绪为基础的创作流程

summary.en: This proposed AAA production framework brings team leads' emotional judgments and collective knowledge into feature validation. The session considers production visibility, approval steps, and a shared definition of when work is done.
summary.zh: 提出将负责人情绪判断与集体知识纳入功能验收的 AAA 创作流程，讨论如何掌握制作状态、组织验证步骤，并建立团队共同理解的完成标准。

sessions.title: Equal Opportunity Fanservice: Creating Attractive Characters of & for All Genders
companies: Radiant G! Studios & Pro Game Guides
tags: Radiant G! Studios & Pro Game Guides
sessions.title_zh: 平等的粉丝福利：为所有性别创造有吸引力的角色

summary.en: This panel takes a queer perspective on fanservice and character appeal. The speakers discuss its history and how character and costume design can address different genders without relying solely on a heterosexual male viewpoint.
summary.zh: 圆桌从酷儿视角讨论粉丝福利与角色吸引力，回顾相关历史，并探讨角色和服装设计如何面向不同性别的玩家，避免只依赖异性恋男性凝视。

sessions.title: Everything I Learned About Community Management I Learned From 'Neopets'
sessions.title_zh: 我从《Neopets》学到的社区管理经验

summary.en: A community manager uses Neopets to examine community participation across a web game's design. Guilds and story-led events serve as examples for discussing practices developers can adapt to their own games.
summary.zh: 一位社区经理借《Neopets》分析网页游戏如何在不同系统中组织玩家参与，以公会和叙事活动等例子讨论其他游戏可以借鉴的社区管理做法。

sessions.title: Evolving the 'Horizon' Series: Animating Believable Robots and Characters
sessions.title_zh: 推动《地平线》系列演进：赋予机器人与角色可信动作

summary.en: Richard Oud examines animations and systems supporting Horizon Forbidden West's player mechanics, machines, and human enemies. The presentation also considers how character backgrounds and personalities guide consistency with the first game's visual language.
summary.zh: Richard Oud 解析《地平线 西之绝境》中支撑玩家机制、机械兽和人类敌人的动画系统，并讨论如何根据角色性格与背景故事，延续前作确立的视觉语言。

sessions.title: Expanding an IP: 'Clash of Clans' Universe Case Study
sessions.title_zh: 拓展IP：《部落冲突》宇宙案例

summary.en: This talk traces the Clash universe from Clash of Clans through Clash Royale to Clash Mini and Clash Quest. It considers how gameplay, art, and marketing decisions shaped a shared IP as each game explored new areas.
summary.zh: 梳理《部落冲突》宇宙从初作到《皇室战争》及《Clash Mini》《Clash Quest》的发展，讨论玩法、美术与营销选择如何共同塑造 IP，并在新作品中拓展世界。

sessions.title: Experimental Gameplay Workshop: 20th Anniversary
sessions.title_zh: 实验玩法工作坊：二十周年

summary.en: Developers showcase prototypes exploring unfamiliar forms of interaction. The anniversary event also reflects on the workshop's history and its transition to new creators and organizers.
summary.zh: 开发者展示探索新交互形式的游戏原型；二十周年活动同时回顾工作坊的发展，并讨论向新一代创作者与组织者的交接。

sessions.title: Exploring the Future of AI and Entertainment (Presented by Genvid Technologies)
sessions.title_zh: 探索人工智能与娱乐的未来（由 Genvid Technologies 赞助）

summary.en: In a related CEDEC 2022 panel, Remi Driancourt joins specialists in AI characters and digital humans to discuss future uses of characters and avatars in virtual worlds. The official outline highlights collaboration across technologies, nonverbal communication and challenges such as the uncanny valley.
summary.zh: 在相关的 CEDEC 2022 圆桌中，Remi Driancourt 与 AI 角色、数字人领域的嘉宾探讨未来虚拟空间中角色与化身的用途；官方议题包括跨技术协作、非语言交流和恐怖谷等实现难题。

evidence.note: 同讲者相关活动导读：依据 Remi Driancourt 参加的 2022 年 8 月 23 日 CEDEC 圆桌《AIキャラクター事情 最前線！仮想空間（メタバース）での開拓ビジョン・取り組み・課題》公开简介与受众收获。该活动的其他嘉宾与 GDC 原场不同，不能认定为 GDC 2022 同版演讲，也不将其内容归给 GDC 搭档 Solomon Sliwinski。仅阅读公开正文，未读取需登录下载的讲义。

sessions.title: Facebook Gaming: Building People-First Games (Presented by Meta)
sessions.title_zh: Facebook Gaming：打造以人为本的游戏（由 Meta 赞助）

summary.en: In a related discussion at the January 2022 GamesBeat and Facebook Gaming Summit, Oliver Messenger uses PAC-MAN Community to explore moving between playing, watching and influencing a game. He also describes how the community helps users understand their ways to participate.
summary.zh: 在 2022 年 1 月 GamesBeat 与 Facebook Gaming 联合峰会的相关讨论中，Oliver Messenger 以《PAC-MAN Community》探讨游玩、观看和影响游戏之间的转换，并说明社区如何帮助用户理解各种参与方式。

evidence.note: 同讲者相关活动导读：依据联合主办方 GamesBeat 于 2022 年 1 月 25 日对 GamesBeat 与 Facebook Gaming 联合峰会的报道，使用其中明确归于 Oliver Messenger 的发言。该文由记者署名，属于主办方对相关活动的发言记录，不是 GDC 2022 原场简介，也不是讲者本人署名文章；该圆桌搭档为 Jacob Navok、Matthew Ball，不含 GDC 搭档 Andrew Mo。导读保留活动与日期边界，不确认 GDC 原讲采用《PAC-MAN Community》案例。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Disrupting the Disruptors: How To Prevent Cheating By Addressing Player Motivation
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：干预破坏者——从玩家动机预防作弊

summary.en: This session approaches cheating through the reasons players choose to do it. The discussion identifies motivations and considers responses that can inform prevention and community management.
summary.zh: 从玩家为何走向作弊这一问题入手，拆解不同动机，并讨论针对这些动机的应对方式如何参与作弊预防与社区管理。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: How to Encourage Social and Emotional Learning In-Game in a Data and Research Driven Manner
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：用数据与研究推动游戏中的社会情绪学习

summary.en: Star Stable Online provides a case study in combining social-emotional learning research with player messaging. The speakers examine audience selection using AI and statistics, alongside ways to assess interventions aimed at disruptive behavior.
summary.zh: 以《Star Stable Online》为例，讨论如何把社会情绪学习研究用于玩家沟通，结合 AI 与统计分析选择目标人群，并评估针对破坏性行为的干预措施。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: How to Talk About Positive Behavior
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：如何谈论积极行为

summary.en: Riot Games introduces a developing taxonomy for describing positive and prosocial player behavior. The session considers why a shared vocabulary matters when designers want to identify and intentionally support those actions.
summary.zh: Riot Games 介绍仍在完善的积极与亲社会行为分类体系，讨论设计团队为何需要共同语言，才能识别值得鼓励的玩家行为，并在设计中有意识地支持它们。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Mission Driven Games: Developing a Better World

summary.en: Developers explore opportunities and responsibilities for producing positive social impact through games.
summary.zh: 开发者探讨通过游戏产生积极社会影响的机会与责任。

youtube.title: Mission Driven Games: Developing a Better World

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Review of Player Dynamic's Systems
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：玩家互动系统综述

summary.en: This overview groups player-dynamics systems by punishment, encouragement, and reform. It compares their components, strengths, and limitations, using game examples and available evidence about their effects.
summary.zh: 将玩家互动管理系统分为惩罚不良行为、鼓励积极行为和促进改正三类，结合游戏例子比较其组成、优缺点，以及已有的影响证据。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Using AI for Trust & Safety
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：用AI支持信任与安全

summary.en: Katie Zigelman discusses AI as one part of cross-functional trust and safety work. The session connects detection and moderation technology with community management, consistent policies, and practices that support constructive participation.
summary.zh: Katie Zigelman 讨论 AI 在跨职能信任与安全工作中的位置，把检测审核技术与社区管理、政策一致执行及积极参与机制联系起来，说明数据与协作如何共同参与治理。

sessions.title: Fast and Easy Character Creation with Substance 3D Modeler Beta (Presented by Adobe)
sessions.title_zh: 使用Substance 3D Modeler测试版快速创建角色（Adobe赞助）

summary.en: Ryan Corniel demonstrates Substance 3D Modeler Beta's approach to sculpting and assembling 3D content. Blocking out forms and managing scenes illustrate workflows available on desktop and in VR.
summary.zh: Ryan Corniel 演示 Substance 3D Modeler 测试版的雕刻与三维内容组装方式，通过形体搭建和场景管理，介绍桌面与 VR 环境中的创作流程。

evidence.note: 采用 Adobe 赞助的相关文章，其中说明并嵌入 Ryan Corniel 的 Substance Days at GDC 2022 演示；该文章不是原始大会简介。

youtube.title: Fast/Easy Character Creation w/ Substance 3D Modeler | Substance Days at GDC 2022 | Substance 3D

sessions.title: Fear of Scope: The #1 Reason We Make Ludicrous Production Decisions
sessions.title_zh: 范围恐惧：导致荒唐制作决策的首要原因

summary.en: This talk examines how anxiety about remaining scope shapes production decisions and delays cuts. The speaker proposes a method for revisiting scope before it becomes difficult to manage.
summary.zh: 从对剩余工作量的焦虑出发，分析范围恐惧如何影响制作决策并拖延内容删减，进而提出在规模失控之前重新审视项目范围的方法。

sessions.title: FidelityFX Super Resolution 2.0 (Presented by AMD)
sessions.title_zh: FidelityFX Super Resolution 2.0（AMD赞助）

summary.en: AMD examines temporal reconstruction in FSR 2.0, followed by optimization and integration considerations for developers working across platforms.
summary.zh: AMD 分析 FSR 2.0 利用时间信息重建细节的算法，并讨论跨平台优化及开发者接入时的考虑。

sessions.title: Figuring Out How Things Work in an Unfamiliar Codebase
sessions.title_zh: 如何弄懂陌生代码库的运作方式

summary.en: This session breaks down the process of building a mental model of an unfamiliar engine or system. The steps are intended both for programmers entering a codebase and for senior staff explaining that investigative work to new hires.
summary.zh: 拆解程序员进入陌生引擎或系统时建立整体认知的过程，既面向需要迅速理解代码的人，也帮助资深开发者把通常依赖经验的排查思路传授给新人。

sessions.title: FPP, Storytelling, and Player-as-an-Actor: Interactive Scenes in 'Cyberpunk 2077'
sessions.title_zh: 第一人称、叙事与作为演员的玩家：《赛博朋克2077》的互动场景

summary.en: CD Projekt RED explains how narrative systems from The Witcher 3 were reworked for Cyberpunk 2077's branching first-person scenes. The talk follows the player-as-actor concept into designer tools and the direction of interactive performances.
summary.zh: CD Projekt RED 说明如何将《巫师3》的叙事系统改造为《赛博朋克2077》的第一人称分支场景，并把“玩家也是演员”的思路落实到设计工具、行动表达与互动演出中。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit Session: Good Deeds Through Gaming: Integrating Features to Address Climate Change
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：通过游戏行善——加入应对气候变化的功能

summary.en: Tilting Point uses TerraGenesis to examine turning an environmental initiative into an in-game feature. The process covers selecting a cause and charity, integrating participation into the game, and explaining it to players.
summary.zh: Tilting Point 以《TerraGenesis》为例，讨论如何把环境公益想法落成游戏功能，包括选择契合的议题与慈善机构、设计游戏内参与方式，以及向玩家传达相关信息。

sessions.title: Free-To-Play Summit: Blockchain, NFTS, Play-To-EarnIs It Real or a Farce?
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：区块链、NFT与边玩边赚——真实机会还是闹剧？

summary.en: This panel surveys blockchain and cryptocurrency games from a 2022 perspective. Ownership, identity, platform constraints, environmental costs, scams, regulation, and the quality of play form the discussion agenda.
summary.zh: 圆桌基于 2022 年的行业背景讨论区块链与加密游戏，涉及所有权、身份、平台限制、环境成本、骗局、监管和实际游戏体验，并交流对后续发展的看法。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: Building Lifetime Value Through Quality Ad Placements
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：通过优质广告位建立生命周期价值

summary.en: This session considers ad implementation from soft launch through an established game's operation. Player, developer, and advertiser perspectives frame examples of conflicting interests and choices about ad placements and revenue.
summary.zh: 讨论从软启动到成熟运营阶段的广告实施，结合玩家、开发者和广告主的不同诉求，分析广告位设计中的利益冲突及收入相关选择。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: Capturing the Merge Games Market at Hyper Speed
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：以超高速切入合并游戏市场

summary.en: Lion Studios reviews its approach to identifying an opening in merge games. The case connects market assessment with rapid prototyping, iteration, and testing as the team prepared multiple products for release.
summary.zh: Lion Studios 回顾如何判断合并游戏市场的切入点，介绍从市场空缺识别到快速原型、迭代和密集测试的流程，以及多款产品走向发行时的实践。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: Don't Pass on Battle Pass: Best Practices for F2P Design
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：别错过战斗通行证——F2P设计实践

summary.en: This survey examines battle-pass designs across free-to-play genres and player groups. The session considers how seasonal content, return visits, and spending opportunities are organized into the feature's design.
summary.zh: 通过不同类型及玩家群体中的战斗通行证设计，讨论季节性内容、回访动机和付费机会如何组织在同一系统中，并归纳设计时可参考的原则。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: Ethical Play To Earn Businesses for Decent Human Beings
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：面向普通人的合乎伦理的边玩边赚业务

summary.en: A play-to-earn advocate examines criticisms of NFT games, including environmental impact, unrealized promises, and exploitation. The session presents the speaker's proposed responses and possible directions for the model.
summary.zh: 一位边玩边赚支持者回应 NFT 游戏在环境影响、未兑现承诺和剥削风险方面的批评，介绍其提出的应对思路与可能路径，供了解这一商业模式的争议。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: From Identity to Innovation: The Keys to Creation on 'Roblox'
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：从身份到创新——Roblox创作的关键

summary.en: Roblox product leaders discuss avatar technology and digital identity, followed by a developer panel on building for the platform. The session connects audience age, monetization, technical choices, and creative strategy in a shared virtual environment.
summary.zh: Roblox 产品负责人介绍虚拟化身与数字身份技术，随后与平台开发者讨论创作实践，涵盖受众年龄、商业化、技术选择，以及在全球虚拟平台上构建体验的策略。

sessions.title: Free-To-Play Summit: How Web 3.0 Can Transform Free to Play Games: A 'Habbo Hotel' Case Study
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：Web 3.0如何改变免费游戏——Habbo Hotel案例

summary.en: Habbo provides a case for discussing blockchain and supplementary NFTs in an established virtual community. The speaker explores how player-owned items and play-to-earn ideas might fit a long-running free-to-play IP.
summary.zh: 以长期运营的虚拟社区《Habbo Hotel》为例，讨论引入区块链与补充性 NFT 的思路，以及玩家持有物品和边玩边赚概念如何与既有免费游戏 IP 对接。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: Subscriptions: Challenges and Opportunities
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：订阅制的挑战与机遇

summary.en: George Jijiashvili examines subscriptions through an analysis of leading mobile games using Sensor Tower data. Genre comparisons and casual-game implementations frame the discussion of where subscriptions fit within monetization.
summary.zh: George Jijiashvili 借助 Sensor Tower 数据分析采用订阅制的头部手游，通过不同品类及休闲游戏的应用方式，讨论订阅在游戏商业化中的位置与机会。

evidence.note: 采用原始数据提供方 Sensor Tower 的现场回顾；该文明确讨论本场演讲，但不是 Omdia 原始简介。导读限于记录的方法与议题，不作额外数值推论；本条错误映射的 Vault 字幕未采用。

sessions.title: Free-To-Play Summit: The Art of 'Bloodhunt': AAA on Free-To-Play
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：《Bloodhunt》的美术——免费游戏中的AAA制作

summary.en: The Bloodhunt team follows its visual direction from IP exploration through concept art, style guides, and early footage. The session also examines repeatable production methods for creating detailed content at volume.
summary.zh: 《Bloodhunt》团队从 IP 探索、概念图、风格指南和早期影像梳理美术方向的形成，并讨论高细节内容批量制作所需的可重复、可扩展流程。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: The F2P Designers Notebook
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：F2P设计师笔记

summary.en: These microtalks examine mobile narrative design, language-model-assisted story play, and moments of player joy. The speakers consider team participation in storytelling, probabilistic design and safety, and obstacles to satisfying skill-based play.
summary.zh: 短讲分别讨论移动游戏叙事、语言模型辅助的即兴故事和玩家喜悦时刻，涵盖团队共同承担叙事、概率式设计与安全问题，以及技巧或解谜游戏中削弱满足感的设计障碍。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: The F2P Game Design Challenge
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：F2P游戏设计挑战赛

summary.en: Designers present proposals for the challenge theme Designing for Minnows. The brief asks them to imagine games whose revenue comes mainly from players spending ten dollars or less over their lifetime, followed by an audience vote.
summary.zh: 设计师围绕“为小额付费者设计”的命题提出游戏方案：让主要收入来自生命周期总支出不超过十美元的玩家，并由现场观众投票评选。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: The Year in Free-To-Play Mobile Games: 2022 Edition
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：免费移动游戏年度回顾——2022版

summary.en: Steve Meretzky and Dave Rohrl review developments in free-to-play design for their 2022 roundup. Merge games, international trends, and titles in soft launch provide material for analysis and predictions.
summary.zh: Steve Meretzky 与 Dave Rohrl 回顾 2022 年前后的免费游戏设计变化，从合并游戏、各地发展到软启动作品，分享分析与对未来趋势的预测。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: Top Gaming Features and Empowering the People Behind Them
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：热门功能与赋能背后的团队

summary.en: PeopleFun's Carol Miu discusses products and features through both design and organizational strategy. The session examines how team structure and working choices relate to the process of developing game features.
summary.zh: PeopleFun 的 Carol Miu 结合产品和功能案例，同时从设计与组织策略两个角度讨论开发，分析团队配置及工作方式如何参与功能构思和实现。

sessions.title: Free-to-Play Summit: Understanding NFTs: A Sea-Change for F2P Games
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：理解NFT——F2P游戏的重大转变

summary.en: Jordan Blackman discusses NFTs as a force affecting more than in-app purchases. The talk considers fundraising, community formation, social marketing, and relationships between creators and consumers from the period's perspective.
summary.zh: Jordan Blackman 从 2022 年背景讨论 NFT 对应用内购买之外环节的潜在影响，涉及筹资、社群建立、社交营销，以及创作者与消费者关系的变化。

sessions.title: From 'Clash of Clans' to 'Everdale': Scaling from Solo to Social
sessions.title_zh: 从《部落冲突》到《Everdale》：从单人扩展到社交

summary.en: The Everdale team describes adapting a Clash of Clans codebase for shared, real-time village activity and persistent cooperative projects. The case examines the interaction between technical architecture and the new social design.
summary.zh: 《Everdale》团队介绍如何在《部落冲突》代码基础上支持实时可见的村庄活动与持续共享的合作项目，讨论社交玩法变化带来的技术架构和设计挑战。

sessions.title: From Box Products to Live Service: How 'Destiny 2' Transformed Bungie

summary.en: Bungie reflects on organizational changes when moving from boxed releases to Destiny 2's live service.
summary.zh: Bungie 回顾从盒装产品开发转向《命运2》持续运营时的组织变化。

youtube.title: From Box Products to Live Service: How 'Destiny 2' Transformed Bungie

sessions.title: From Creation to Connection: What's New for Multiplayer Gaming at Unity (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 从创作到连接：Unity多人游戏开发的新进展（Unity赞助）

summary.en: Unity surveys its multiplayer development stack, including Netcode for GameObjects, Relay, Lobby, Multiplay, and Matchmaker. These tools frame the discussion of building and connecting multiplayer experiences.
summary.zh: Unity 梳理多人游戏开发技术栈中的 Netcode for GameObjects、Relay、Lobby、Multiplay 与 Matchmaker，介绍这些工具如何支持多人游戏的制作和玩家连接。

sessions.title: Fulfilling your Multiplayer Game's Potential: Launch and Live with Confidence (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 发挥多人游戏潜力：自信发行与运营（Unity赞助）

summary.en: Larry Rye and guests discuss preparing multiplayer services for launch. End-to-end player flows, component scaling, and synthetic tests frame the search for bottlenecks before live operation.
summary.zh: Larry Rye 与嘉宾讨论多人服务上线准备，从完整玩家流程、各组件扩容和合成测试出发，分析如何在正式运营前发现瓶颈。

sessions.title: Full Mobile Platform Performance Test & Analysis Solution (Presented by Tencent Cloud)
sessions.title_zh: 完整移动平台性能测试与分析方案（Tencent Cloud赞助）

summary.en: Tom Petreca introduces PerfDog within Tencent's WeTest services. The demonstration considers performance measurement on iOS and Android as part of preparing an application for release.
summary.zh: Tom Petreca 介绍腾讯 WeTest 中的 PerfDog，通过演示讨论 iOS 与 Android 性能指标采集，以及这些检查在应用发行准备中的作用。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: 'Visitations': VR for Ketamine Infusion Therapy

summary.en: Visitations describes designing meditative VR settings for use alongside clinical infusion treatment.
summary.zh: 《Visitations》介绍面向临床输注治疗场景的冥想式 VR 环境设计。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Accessibility in VR: Lessons Learned and Best Practices

summary.en: VR practitioners discuss accessibility lessons and approaches from their development experience.
summary.zh: VR 从业者结合开发经验，讨论无障碍设计的经验与方法。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Comedy-Driven Interaction Design with 'Floor Plan 2'

summary.en: Floor Plan 2 explores using comedy to guide interaction design in virtual reality.
summary.zh: 《Floor Plan 2》探讨如何通过喜剧思路，引导虚拟现实交互设计。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Creating Positive Social Engagement: Case Study: 'The Under Presents'

summary.en: The Under Presents examines design choices intended to encourage positive social connections.
summary.zh: 《The Under Presents》分享促进积极社交联系的设计方法。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Cross-Platform XR Development Use Case: 'Zombieland VR' with OpenXR
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：跨平台XR开发案例——Zombieland VR与OpenXR

summary.en: XR Games reviews choosing OpenXR for Zombieland VR: Headshot Fever in Unity. The postmortem follows platform goals, development decisions, and what did and did not work during implementation.
summary.zh: XR Games 回顾在 Unity 中为《Zombieland VR: Headshot Fever》采用 OpenXR 的过程，围绕跨平台目标、技术选择及实现中的得失展开复盘。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Designing for the Real World in a Pandemic
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：疫情中面向现实世界设计

summary.en: Niantic leads discuss decision-making for location-based games when the physical world changed rapidly during the pandemic. Pokémon GO examples frame the challenge of responding to differing regulations and evolving practices across regions.
summary.zh: Niantic 负责人结合《Pokémon GO》等项目，讨论疫情期间现实环境快速变化时的决策流程，以及如何应对各地不同的规定和不断调整的实践要求。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Hands Best: How AR & VR Devs Can Make the Most of Hand Tracking
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：善用双手——AR与VR开发者如何发挥手部追踪的潜力

summary.en: This session surveys hand tracking as an XR input method, covering tracking approaches and interaction models. Hybrid inputs and common assumptions provide starting points for discussing recognition challenges and design choices.
summary.zh: 梳理手部追踪在 XR 输入中的应用，介绍追踪方式、交互模型与双手结合其他输入的混合方案，并讨论识别难点和设计时容易带入的假设。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: How NASA Has Translated Aerospace Research into Biofeedback Game Experiences
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：NASA如何将航空航天研究转化为生物反馈游戏体验

summary.en: The speakers connect NASA's research on pilots' physiological signals with game and VR applications. The talk reviews biofeedback experiments and introduces tools for integrating body-signal inputs into game engines.
summary.zh: 将 NASA 利用生理信号研究飞行员表现的工作，与游戏和 VR 中的生物反馈应用联系起来，回顾相关体验实验，并介绍把身体信号接入引擎的工具思路。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: How NOT to Build a VR Arcade Game
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：VR街机游戏的开发避坑记

summary.en: MajorMega recounts building a VR arcade company, from an improvised prototype to a SpongeBob SquarePants cabinet. The story centers on obstacles and mistakes encountered while bringing a physical VR attraction to market.
summary.zh: MajorMega 回顾从临时拼装原型到推出《海绵宝宝》VR 街机的创业经历，讨论把实体 VR 娱乐设备推向市场时遇到的障碍与制作误区。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Keep Redlining OUT of the Metaverse

summary.en: Niantic discusses diversity and access when building virtual worlds, including support for Black-led developers.
summary.zh: Niantic 探讨构建虚拟世界时的多样性与参与机会，包括对黑人主导团队的支持。

youtube.title: Keep Redlining OUT of the Metaverse

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Metaverse Games: State of Play and Opportunities

summary.en: A market researcher examines existing game-based virtual worlds and potential metaverse opportunities.
summary.zh: 市场研究者分析现有游戏虚拟世界，以及元宇宙的潜在机会。

youtube.title: Metaverse Games: State of Play and Opportunities

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Seven Ways VR Will Change the World of Mental Healthcare!
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：VR改变心理健康照护的七种方式

summary.en: This presentation surveys clinical VR research and applications across fear, trauma, pain, movement, cognition, exercise, and virtual-human interaction. It also considers how game-development expertise contributes to engagement with these experiences.
summary.zh: 综述临床 VR 在恐惧、创伤、疼痛、运动、认知、锻炼和虚拟人互动等领域的理论、研究与应用，并讨论游戏开发经验如何参与这些体验的投入感设计。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Up Close & Virtual: The Power of Live VR Actors
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：近距离虚拟现场——真人VR演员的力量

summary.en: Alex Coulombe traces live VR performance experiments through a production with Actors Theatre of Louisville. Remote rendering, cloud streaming, and full-body and facial capture form the technical context for discussing audience proximity and viewpoint freedom.
summary.zh: Alex Coulombe 回顾现场 VR 演出探索及与路易斯维尔演员剧院的合作，讨论远程渲染、云串流和全身面部捕捉如何参与观众距离感与自由视角的设计。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: UX for Holograms
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：全息体验的用户体验设计

summary.en: This session presents five XR design principles and five interaction techniques drawn from games and other spatial experiences. It examines how tracking, shared spaces, and new display or sensing methods expand the UX designer's options.
summary.zh: 通过游戏与空间体验案例介绍五项 XR 设计原则及五种交互技巧，讨论身体追踪、共享空间和新型显示、感知方式如何扩展用户体验设计的手段。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Virtual Reality and Game Design is Reimagining Enterprise Applications
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：虚拟现实与游戏设计正在重塑企业应用

summary.en: Gregg Katano discusses VR uses beyond entertainment, including education, and the barriers of public awareness and access. Pop-up demonstrations illustrate how developers can meet audiences and gather direct feedback.
summary.zh: Gregg Katano 讨论 VR 在教育等娱乐以外领域的应用，以及公众认知和体验渠道带来的挑战，并以快闪展示活动说明开发者如何接触受众、获取直接反馈。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: What FMV Can Teach Us about Volumetric Videogames
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：全动态影像游戏能为体积视频游戏带来什么？

summary.en: This talk uses full-motion-video game design to consider interaction with volumetric video. It proposes design strategies for combining captured performances and depth data with expressive XR gameplay.
summary.zh: 借鉴全动态影像游戏的设计经验，探讨体积视频与互动玩法的结合，提出把带深度信息的实拍表演融入 XR 游戏表达的设计策略。

sessions.title: Future Strategy of a Successful Blockchain Platform (Presented by Wemade)
sessions.title_zh: 成功区块链平台的未来战略（Wemade赞助）

summary.en: Edgar Lee outlines the services a blockchain game platform needs, drawing on his experience with shared game-platform functions. WEMIX provides the case for discussing platform strategy and future developer support.
summary.zh: Edgar Lee 从游戏平台共用功能的开发经历出发，梳理区块链游戏平台所需的服务，并以 WEMIX 为案例讨论平台战略及未来的开发者支持方向。

summary.en: This design session examines gameplay organized around information, expectations, and uncertainty.
summary.zh: 本场设计分享讨论围绕信息、预期与不确定性构建的玩法。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Connections: Accessible and Practical Networking Advice
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨会：建立联系——易于参与的实用社交建议

summary.en: Code Coven's speakers draw on remote boot camps and teaching to discuss approachable professional networking. The session considers strategies intended to work for people with differing access needs.
summary.zh: Code Coven 的讲者结合远程训练营和教学经验，讨论容易参与的职业社交方法，交流如何照顾不同参与条件与需求。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Full Circle: From Game Jams to Industry and Back

summary.en: Developers discuss translating game-jam experience into professional skills and returning lessons to jams.
summary.zh: 开发者分享如何将 Game Jam 经历转化为职业技能，并将工作经验带回活动。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: How to Catch the Attention of the Engineering Hiring Manager

summary.en: An engineering hiring session examines how applicants can communicate their relevance to a role.
summary.zh: 工程招聘分享讨论应聘者如何有效展示自己与岗位的匹配度。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: How to Create Rapid Prototypes

summary.en: A prototyping session explores when to begin, stop, and focus an effective game prototype.
summary.zh: 原型开发分享讨论何时开始、何时停止，以及如何聚焦有效的游戏原型。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Killer Portfolio or Portfolio Killer Part 1: Advice from Industry Artists
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨会：出色的作品集，还是毁掉机会的作品集？第一部分——行业美术建议

summary.en: Industry artists discuss portfolio pitfalls and how applicants can avoid them. The panel focuses on evaluating the way an artist presents their work.
summary.zh: 行业美术从业者讨论作品集中的常见问题及避免方式，帮助求职者审视自己呈现作品的方式。

sessions.title: Game Demos Done Right
sessions.title_zh: 把游戏试玩版做好

summary.en: Chris Zukowski examines demos as marketing assets using examples and practitioner feedback. The discussion focuses on choosing a playable sample that creates interest and sharing without exhausting the reasons to buy the game.
summary.zh: Chris Zukowski 结合案例与行业反馈，讨论试玩版作为营销素材的设计：如何提供足够吸引玩家和传播的内容，同时为正式购买保留探索空间。

sessions.title: Game Design Patterns
sessions.title_zh: 游戏设计模式

summary.en: This session describes deriving reusable design patterns from gameplay experience and connecting them into a pattern language. It then considers using that framework in teaching and professional game development.
summary.zh: 介绍如何从游玩与设计经验提炼可复用的设计模式，再把模式连接成语言体系，并讨论这套方法在课堂及专业开发中的实际使用。

sessions.title: Game Level Generation using AI Bot (Presented by Tencent AI Lab)
sessions.title_zh: 利用 AI Bot 生成游戏关卡

summary.en: Tencent's May 2022 official interview cites game-level generation among its AI demonstrations at that year's GDC. The related account connects this example with production efficiency and the technical capabilities offered to development partners.
summary.zh: 腾讯在 2022 年 5 月发布的官方访谈中，将游戏关卡生成列为本届 GDC 的 AI 展示案例，并联系内容生产效率及面向开发合作伙伴的技术支持讨论其用途。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: 'Blackhaven' Postmortem: Designing Two Centuries of Difficult History in One Free Game

summary.en: Blackhaven reflects on designing and releasing an interactive mystery about difficult historical subjects.
summary.zh: 《Blackhaven》回顾围绕复杂历史议题设计、发行互动悬疑游戏的过程。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: A Topography of Words and Feels: Narrative Design in 'Lost Words: Beyond the Page'

summary.en: Lost Words examines narrative design and the emotional journey through grief.
summary.zh: 《Lost Words》分享叙事设计，以及围绕悲伤展开的情感历程。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Dynamic Narrative Systems in 'Elsinore'

summary.en: Elsinore explores dynamic narrative systems that enable varied player-driven situations.
summary.zh: 《Elsinore》介绍支持多样化玩家情境的动态叙事系统。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Game Narrative Review Competition Winners: Poster Analysis
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：叙事评论竞赛优胜者海报分析

summary.en: Winning narrative reviewers present game analyses in poster form. The opening example examines Danganronpa V3's truth-and-lies theme, perjury mechanic, and relationship between players and fictional characters.
summary.zh: 叙事评论竞赛优胜者通过海报展示游戏分析，其中开场案例讨论《新弹丸论破V3》的真假主题、伪证机制，以及玩家与虚构角色之间的联系。

evidence.note: 已核对公开英文字幕的开场讲者与主题；导读仅归纳实际可见的开场内容，未覆盖完整演讲。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: How to Run (and Survive) a Writers' Room

summary.en: A cross-media writer discusses organizing and sustaining a writers' room for games.
summary.zh: 跨媒体编剧分享如何组织并维持游戏编剧室的工作。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Interactive Pacing from the Museum Flashback Level in 'The Last of Us Part II'

summary.en: The Last of Us Part II examines optional content and player-controlled narrative pacing.
summary.zh: 《最后生还者 第二部》探讨可选内容，以及由玩家自行调整的叙事节奏。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: It's Not in the Writer's Manual: A Q&A Session for New Writers
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：写作手册之外——新编剧问答会

summary.en: Veteran writers and narrative designers field questions about entering and working in game writing. The open discussion includes roles, freelance versus staff work, rates, leadership, and collaboration within design teams.
summary.zh: 资深编剧与叙事设计师就进入游戏写作行业及实际工作展开问答，话题包括岗位定位、自由职业与全职、报价、带领编剧和设计团队协作。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Kindness Coins, or Chemistry Casino? A New Take On Romantic/Sexual Narrative Design
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：好人币还是化学反应赌场？恋爱与性叙事的新思路

summary.en: This talk explores romance systems built around character-specific chemistry rather than accumulated favors. Two proposed models consider NPC agency, attraction across game systems, and randomness in relationship arcs.
summary.zh: 讨论以角色之间特定的化学反应设计恋爱关系，替代累积好感行为换取回报的结构；通过两种模型探讨 NPC 自主性、跨系统吸引力及关系中的随机性。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Let Players Break Your Story: Narrative Design in Immersive Sims
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：让玩家打破故事——沉浸式模拟游戏的叙事设计

summary.en: Weird West provides a case for writing stories that survive players killing key characters or breaking expected rules. Lucas Loredo examines modular narrative, branching, and plot safeguards in a highly permissive game.
summary.zh: Lucas Loredo 以《诡野西部》讨论玩家能够杀死关键角色或违背预期规则时的叙事设计，介绍模块化故事、分支与情节保障措施如何配合高度自由的玩法。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Leveraging Player Psychology in 'Bluebeard's Bride'
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：在《蓝胡子的新娘》中运用玩家心理

summary.en: Bluebeard's Bride is used to discuss Jungian depth psychology as a design influence on emotional play. The session considers how a tabletop horror environment invites players to engage with personal fears.
summary.zh: 以桌面角色扮演游戏《蓝胡子的新娘》为例，讨论荣格深层心理学如何参与情感体验设计，以及恐怖游戏环境如何引导玩家接触和探索自己的恐惧。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Making Player Choices Feel like They Matter in Your Narrative
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：让叙事选择具有分量

summary.en: Scarlet Hollow's co-writer examines choice at the scale of both endings and individual interactions. The talk connects thematically responsive conclusions with relationships, dialogue variations, and art changes that personalize a playthrough.
summary.zh: 《Scarlet Hollow》的联合编剧从结局和单次互动两个尺度讨论选择设计，介绍主题相关的结局、关系系统，以及对白和美术细节如何回应玩家的具体经历。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Narrative Tools as Powerful as 'Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy's'
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：打造《漫威银河护卫队》式的强大叙事工具

summary.en: Eidos Montreal discusses expanding its writing tools for the Guardians' ensemble banter and recording needs. Text-to-speech generation, localized audio management, and early in-game testing illustrate links between authoring tools and the voice pipeline.
summary.zh: Eidos Montreal 介绍为群像插科打诨和多人录音扩充内部写作工具的过程，通过语音合成、本地化音频管理和早期游戏内测试，说明创作工具与配音流程的衔接。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Players or Virtual Tourists? Video Games and Tourism Psychology
companies: The Moonwalls & Academy of Art in Szczecin
tags: The Moonwalls & Academy of Art in Szczecin
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：玩家还是虚拟游客？游戏与旅游心理学

summary.en: Marcin Makaj applies research on tourism, authenticity, and perceptions of reality to game design. Examples from existing games lead into a practical process for considering players as visitors to unfamiliar worlds.
summary.zh: Marcin Makaj 将旅游行为、真实性和现实感知研究用于游戏设计，通过既有作品的例子，讨论把玩家视为陌生世界访客时可采用的设计步骤。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: The Dramaturgy of Video Games: Theatre, Story and Empathy
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：游戏的戏剧构作——剧场、故事与共情

summary.en: This talk considers dramaturgy as a resource for game design, alongside immersive theatre, live role-play, and escape rooms. It examines how performance and interactive design invite audiences or players into empathetic engagement.
summary.zh: 将戏剧构作视为游戏设计的参考，联系沉浸式剧场、真人角色扮演与密室逃脱，讨论表演和互动设计如何邀请观众、玩家参与情感体验。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: The Narrative Guide to Surviving the Monetization of Games
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：在商业化环境中生存的叙事指南

summary.en: The speaker examines narrative work in games structured around microtransactions and rapid access to action. The discussion considers how writers operate within teams and game systems shaped by passes, purchases, and production economics.
summary.zh: 讨论微交易与快速进入行动的节奏如何改变游戏叙事工作，分析编剧如何在通行证、购买机制及成本考量塑造的团队和系统中创作有意义的内容。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: The Narrative Innovation Showcase 2022
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：2022叙事创新展示

summary.en: Five short talks reveal the intentions and production problems behind experimental narrative work. Each speaker examines particular techniques and the design strategies developed to address those problems.
summary.zh: 五场短讲介绍叙事实验背后的创作目标和制作难题，分别拆解所采用的具体技巧，以及回应相关问题的设计策略。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: The New Phone Format Turning Netflix Watchers into "Accidental Gamers"
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：让Netflix观众意外成为玩家的手机叙事形式

summary.en: This session examines live-action stories told through smartphone-like interfaces, often called phone-first or found-phone experiences. It surveys the format's strengths, constraints, and potential audience among adult fiction viewers.
summary.zh: 探讨通过智能手机式界面展开的实拍互动叙事，梳理 phone-first 或 found-phone 形式的优势、限制及相关作品，并讨论其面向成年影视与小说受众的可能性。

sessions.title: Game Performance Optimization with Causal Models (Presented by Samsung Electronic)
sessions.title_zh: 用因果模型优化游戏性能（Samsung赞助）

summary.en: Hesham Dar examines Bayesian-network causal models for mobile performance tuning. The talk considers how to separate a parameter change's effect from other interacting device factors.
summary.zh: Hesham Dar 讨论移动性能调优中的贝叶斯网络因果模型，分析设备多个因素相互作用时，如何识别参数调整本身的影响。

youtube.title: Game Performance Optimization with Causal Models

sessions.title: GameFi Across Massive Games (Presented by Wemade)
sessions.title_zh: 大型游戏中的GameFi（Wemade赞助）

summary.en: Woojune Chung examines staking, auctions, and NFT trading on WEMIX through MIR4. The discussion considers these services as parts of a game's surrounding economy.
summary.zh: Woojune Chung 以《MIR4》为背景，介绍 WEMIX 的质押、拍卖和 NFT 交易，讨论这些服务如何参与游戏周边经济系统。

youtube.title: [GDC] GameFi Across Massive Games

sessions.title: Games Subscriptions: Is the "Netflix of Games" Inevitable and What Does It Mean for Developers?

summary.en: A business session examines game subscriptions and the implications of comparisons with video-streaming services.
summary.zh: 商业分享讨论游戏订阅，以及将其类比视频流媒体服务带来的影响。

youtube.title: Games Subscriptions: Is the "Netflix of Games" Inevitable and What Does It Mean for Developers?

sessions.title: Gamifying Creativity in 'Chicory': A Colorful Tale
sessions.title_zh: 《Chicory: A Colorful Tale》中创造力的游戏化

summary.en: Chicory's creator revisits attempts to make player creativity central to both play and story. Successful and unsuccessful design experiments illustrate ways to offer satisfying interaction without relying on imposed challenge.
summary.zh: 《Chicory: A Colorful Tale》的创作者回顾围绕玩家创造力展开玩法与故事的尝试，通过采用及放弃的设计方案，讨论不依赖强制挑战也能提供充实互动的办法。

sessions.title: Gaming Data: Take Control of Your Data & IP To Unlock New Revenue Streams and Empower Your Community, Presented by Grid Esports and J Moses (Presented by GRID)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏数据：掌握数据与IP，探索新收入并支持社群（GRID赞助）
