summary.en: J Moses and GRID discuss treating game data as an asset. Comparisons with sports-data licensing frame questions about curation, protection, and relationships with third-party data businesses.
summary.zh: J Moses 与 GRID 讨论把游戏数据视为资产，借助体育数据授权的类比，分析数据整理、保护及与第三方数据业务合作的问题。

evidence.note: 已核对公开英文字幕的开场讲者与主题；导读仅归纳实际可见的开场内容，未覆盖完整演讲。

sessions.title: Gaming For Cars? You bet! Car Audio Cardio Roundtable (Presented by the IGDA)
sessions.title_zh: 汽车也能玩游戏？车载音频圆桌

summary.en: The IGDA's interactive-audio group examines how autonomous vehicles could create work for game-audio professionals. Contributors from Audiokinetic, Bose Automotive and the MIDI Association discuss the emerging automotive context.
summary.zh: IGDA 互动音频小组讨论自动驾驶汽车可能为游戏音频从业者带来的机会，邀请 Audiokinetic、Bose Automotive 与 MIDI Association 的专家交流车载音频的发展情境。

sessions.title: GDC Main Stage: Independent Games Festival and Game Developers Choice Awards
sessions.title_zh: GDC 主舞台：独立游戏节与游戏开发者选择奖

summary.en: This combined ceremony celebrates independent games and peer-selected achievements across the industry. The official program pairs the 24th IGF Awards, hosted by Kelly Wallick, with the Game Developers Choice Awards.
summary.zh: 本场联合颁奖礼表彰独立游戏与行业同行评选的创作成果，节目将 Kelly Wallick 主持的第二十四届 IGF 奖与游戏开发者选择奖依次呈现。

sessions.title: GDC Main Stage: The Developer's Renaissance

summary.en: A multipart Main Stage presentation discusses game development's future and changing workplaces.
summary.zh: 主舞台系列分享讨论游戏开发的未来，以及不断变化的工作环境。

youtube.title: GDC 2022 Main Stage: The Developer's Renaissance

sessions.title: GDC Pitch: Day 1
sessions.title_zh: GDC 项目推介：第一天

summary.en: Developers practice five-minute game pitches before a panel of publishers, followed by questions and feedback. The opening explains pitching as a learnable skill and introduces Pocket Oasis as the first presentation.
summary.zh: 开发者向发行商评委进行五分钟游戏推介，再接受提问与反馈；开场围绕如何练习提案能力展开，并以《Pocket Oasis》作为首个展示项目。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，仅涉及活动形式与首个提案，不代表评估了全部项目。

sessions.title: GDC Pitch: Day 2
sessions.title_zh: GDC 项目推介：第二天

summary.en: The second day pairs five-minute developer pitches with feedback from publishers and investors. Its opening discusses practicing the skill and begins with Diditopia's presentation of a childhood-imagination-inspired building game.
summary.zh: 第二天继续由开发者进行五分钟提案并接受发行商与投资者反馈，开场强调推介能力的练习，并从 Diditopia 围绕童年想象与搭建体验的项目展示开始。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，仅涉及活动形式与首个提案，不代表评估了全部项目。

sessions.title: Gearing Up Millions of Armor Combinations in 'Dauntless'
sessions.title_zh: 为《Dauntless》装配数百万种护甲组合

summary.en: This case study examines Dauntless's modular armor and the pipeline used to validate combinations. Design practices, automation tools, and early content checks connect customization requirements with ongoing production.
summary.zh: 解析《Dauntless》的模块化护甲系统及组合验证流程，讨论设计约束、自动化工具和早期内容检查如何共同应对大量外观搭配与持续制作需求。

sessions.title: Getting Noticed: Tips for Making Your Pitch Stand Out
sessions.title_zh: 引人注意：让项目提案脱颖而出的技巧

summary.en: Drawing on reviewing game pitches, the speaker examines patterns in proposals that advance through a greenlight process. The session considers what to include or omit and how developers can assess a potential partner's fit.
summary.zh: 结合项目提案评审经验，分析进入后续立项流程的材料有哪些特征，讨论内容取舍，以及开发者如何根据自身目标判断合作伙伴是否合适。

sessions.title: Ghost in the Empathy Machine: Exploring the Player-Character Connection in 'Life is Strange: True Colors'
sessions.title_zh: 共情机器中的幽灵：《奇异人生：本色》的玩家与角色连接

summary.en: Deck Nine discusses making empathy explicit through Alex's power in Life is Strange: True Colors. The talk follows the mechanic's development and its effects on writing, informed by research on empathy in relationships.
summary.zh: Deck Nine 介绍《奇异人生：本色》如何把共情转化为 Alex 明确可用的能力，回顾机制演进及其对写作的机会和限制，并联系人际关系中的共情研究。

sessions.title: Give Your Players a Seat at the Table: Feedback Fundamentals
sessions.title_zh: 让玩家参与开发决策：反馈基础

summary.en: Age of Empires' customer-voice lead describes involving players from early development through live operation. Examples from Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition and IV connect small community councils with broader feedback processes.
summary.zh: 《帝国时代》的玩家声音负责人介绍如何从开发早期到上线运营持续邀请玩家参与，以二代决定版和四代说明小型社区顾问团及更广泛反馈流程的组织方式。

sessions.title: Giving Your Game the Best Chance of Success with the Cloud (Presented by Amazon Web Services)
sessions.title_zh: 借助云端给游戏争取成功机会（Amazon Web Services赞助）

summary.en: Tristan Greaves discusses cloud-launch preparation, common risks, and sustaining operations after release.
summary.zh: Tristan Greaves 结合支持工作室的经历，讨论云端发行准备、常见风险及上线后持续运营的问题。

sessions.title: Global Insights for a New Era of Games Advertising (Presented by Meta)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏广告新时代的全球洞察

summary.en: Meta's related 2022 Games Marketing Insights announcement compares changing player habits across major markets. It emphasizes audience diversity, lasting player relationships, and earning voluntary data sharing through a trusted environment and appropriate incentives.
summary.zh: Meta 的《2022 游戏营销洞察》相关发布说明比较主要市场的玩家习惯变化，重点讨论受众多样性、长期玩家关系，以及如何通过可信环境与合适激励促成玩家自愿分享信息。

evidence.note: 采用 Meta 于 2022 年 3 月发布的相关报告说明，未认定为 Tim Lion 本场演讲的原文或视频。

sessions.title: Greater Accessibility with Fewer New Features and Less Scope
sessions.title_zh: 以更少新功能和更小范围提升无障碍体验

summary.en: Schell Games explains accessibility planning for I Expect You To Die 2 using an Accessibility Matrix. The session considers early priorities, research, budgeting, and design decisions as ways to manage accessibility work within scope.
summary.zh: Schell Games 通过《I Expect You To Die 2》的无障碍矩阵介绍早期规划方法，讨论优先级、研究、预算及有意识的设计选择如何帮助控制无障碍工作的范围。

sessions.title: Hair and Fur Rendering in 'Diablo II: Resurrected'
sessions.title_zh: 《暗黑破坏神2：重制版》的毛发渲染

summary.en: This technical overview follows Diablo II: Resurrected's hair and fur pipeline, including an adapted energy-conserving scattering model and Gaussian ray bundles. Development compromises and failed approaches accompany the implementation details.
summary.zh: 介绍《暗黑破坏神2：重制版》的毛发渲染流程，涉及改造后的能量守恒散射模型和高斯光线束追踪，并结合实现细节讨论开发中的取舍、摩擦与失败尝试。

sessions.title: How a Time Loop Influenced 'Deathloop's' Narrative Design
sessions.title_zh: 时间循环如何影响《死亡循环》的叙事设计

summary.en: Arkane Lyon examines building a story around one repeating day while preserving player agency. The presentation connects Deathloop's themes and systems with the constraints of its looping premise and the tools used to address them.
summary.zh: Arkane Lyon 分析如何围绕反复发生的一天组织《死亡循环》的故事，并保留玩家自主性，说明时间循环的限制如何影响主题、系统及叙事工具的选择。

sessions.title: How Can Accelerators Best Facilitate for New Game Studios?
sessions.title_zh: 加速器如何更好地帮助新游戏工作室？

summary.en: This talk reviews the perspectives and initiatives used in a studio accelerator program. The speaker considers which goals, tasks, and resources were useful to participating teams and where the program's approach fell short.
summary.zh: 回顾工作室加速器项目所采用的不同思路与举措，讨论哪些目标、任务和资源对新团队有用，以及项目实施中未能达到预期的部分。

sessions.title: How Do You Make a Game That Was Supposed to Be Small, but Ended up Being Huge
sessions.title_zh: 原本想做小作品，却做成了大项目，怎么办？

summary.en: People Can Fly uses Outriders to discuss a project growing alongside its studio. The production history frames questions about when expansion helps development and when it creates risks.
summary.zh: People Can Fly 以《Outriders》的制作历程讨论项目与工作室同步扩张，分析规模增长在具体环境中带来的机会及可能危及开发的因素。

sessions.title: How Games Can Be Journalism
sessions.title_zh: 游戏如何成为新闻报道

summary.en: Nick Fortugno draws on collaborations with news organizations to examine games within journalistic projects. The discussion covers evidence, editorial rigor, research processes, and ethical expectations that differ from other impact-oriented games.
summary.zh: Nick Fortugno 结合与新闻机构合作的案例，讨论游戏如何参与报道，重点分析证据、编辑严谨性、研究流程及新闻伦理等要求与一般议题游戏的差异。

sessions.title: How Meta Quest Became a Billion Dollar Ecosystem (Presented by Meta)
sessions.title_zh: Meta Quest如何成为十亿美元生态（Meta赞助）

summary.en: Chris Pruett reviews the Quest ecosystem from a 2022 standpoint. The session considers how platform design and support relate to opportunities for VR developers.
summary.zh: Chris Pruett 从 2022 年背景回顾 Quest 生态，讨论平台设计与支持工作如何参与 VR 开发者的机会。

sessions.title: How Rigid Limitations Can Be Liberating, Developing Art Without Textures for 'The Falconeer'
sessions.title_zh: 严格限制如何带来自由：为《The Falconeer》制作无纹理美术

summary.en: The Falconeer's creator explains a long-running decision to make game art without textures. Technical-art experiments illustrate how a deliberate constraint informed individual solutions and the project's overall visual style.
summary.zh: 《The Falconeer》的创作者介绍长期坚持不用纹理制作游戏美术的选择，通过技术美术实验说明这一限制如何催生具体方案，并逐渐形成整体视觉风格。

sessions.title: How SYBO runs the decade's most downloaded mobile game (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: SYBO 如何运营十年间下载量领先的手游

summary.en: SYBO's leadership discusses operating Subway Surfers as a growing mobile business. The opening connects studio strategy and reducing uncertainty with technical direction, tooling and external partners.
summary.zh: SYBO 负责人围绕《Subway Surfers》的长期移动业务展开交流，开场讨论工作室策略、降低不确定性，以及技术方向、工具和外部合作的分工。

evidence.note: 仅依据公开英文字幕开场中实际出现的讨论整理。

sessions.title: How Tencent Protects Worldwide FPS Games with Advanced Anti-Cheat Solutions (Presented by Tencent Cloud)
sessions.title_zh: 腾讯如何用进阶反作弊方案保护全球 FPS 游戏

summary.en: Tencent introduces its anti-cheat service and the operational problems posed by FPS cheats. The stated agenda includes automated evidence collection, solution development and anti-cheat operations.
summary.zh: 腾讯介绍 FPS 作弊带来的运营问题与反作弊服务，议程涉及自动收集作弊证据、方案演进和反作弊运营系统。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，技术范围限于其中明确列出的议程。

sessions.title: How to Keep a Community Positive, Even When It Doesn't Want to Be
sessions.title_zh: 即使社群不愿配合，也要保持积极氛围

summary.en: This talk examines causes of persistent community negativity and responses ranging from direct intervention to subtle communication. Game examples support discussion of moderation choices, player advocates, and unproductive feedback.
summary.zh: 分析更新反响不佳、预期错位等持续负面情绪的成因，结合游戏案例讨论从直接干预到间接沟通的策略，以及审核方式、玩家支持者和无效反馈的处理。

sessions.title: How To Keep Your Team From Destroying Your Game
sessions.title_zh: 如何避免团队毁掉你的游戏

summary.en: Susan O'Connor examines recurring problems when teams combine authored stories with player agency. She presents three common traps for game-writing teams and proposed ways for studios to respond.
summary.zh: Susan O'Connor 讨论预设故事与玩家自主行为结合时反复出现的团队问题，提出游戏写作中的三类常见陷阱及工作室可以采用的应对办法。

sessions.title: How to Make Art that Pisses Off Dictatorships and Makes You a Refugee
sessions.title_zh: 如何创作激怒独裁政权、让自己成为难民的艺术

summary.en: Andrew recounts a personal path through protest, commercial art direction, and activism using games and technology. The talk considers the risks and purposes of art that challenges political power.
summary.zh: Andrew 结合个人经历，回顾街头抗议、商业美术指导与借助游戏和技术开展创作行动的交织，讨论挑战政治权力的艺术所面对的风险及其目的。

sessions.title: How Unity Gaming Services Addresses Unsolved Problems in Gaming (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: Unity Gaming Services 如何应对游戏领域尚未解决的问题

summary.en: Unity's related mobile-multiplayer article breaks the service stack into creating a game, connecting players and supporting communication. It explains choices between relay and dedicated hosting, matchmaking and lobbies, then connects analytics, content delivery and monetization with ongoing operations.
summary.zh: Unity 同期多人手游文章从游戏创建、玩家连接与交流拆解服务栈，讨论中继与专用服务器、匹配与大厅的选择，再将数据分析、内容分发和变现连接到持续运营需求。

evidence.note: 采用 GDC 2022 前一周发布的 Unity 相关文章，未认定为 Joanna Van Gansen 的本场演讲简介或视频。

articles.title: Unity 官方中文课程页：GDC 2022 Gaming Services

sessions.title: How Web3 Games Work (and Sadly Don't)

summary.en: This session examines Web3-game business models and the ways their incentive structures can fail.
summary.zh: 本场分享讨论 Web3 游戏商业模式，以及激励结构可能失效的方式。

youtube.title: How Web3 Games Work (and Sadly Don't)

sessions.title: Improving Design on 'Dauntless' through Community Engagement
sessions.title_zh: 通过社群参与改进《Dauntless》的设计

summary.en: Kristen discusses direct contact between designers and players through her community work. The talk considers how to begin, interpret player needs, and weigh the benefits and risks of including communities in design conversations.
summary.zh: Kristen 结合社群工作经验，讨论设计师如何直接与玩家交流，理解其需求，并权衡邀请社群参与设计讨论所带来的价值、风险与具体做法。

sessions.title: Inclusive Leadership @ Xbox Game Studios (Presented by Xbox Game Studios)
sessions.title_zh: Xbox Game Studios的包容性领导（Xbox Game Studios赞助）

summary.en: Xbox studio leaders reflect on changing teams and business culture. The panel discusses leadership perspectives and the directions they see ahead.
summary.zh: Xbox 工作室负责人回顾团队与商业文化的变化，交流领导工作的观察及对后续发展的看法。

sessions.title: Increase Engagement, Stickiness and Revenue Opportunities with Real-Time Voice and Video (Presented by Agora)
sessions.title_zh: 用实时语音与视频拓展参与、黏性和收入机会

summary.en: Ben Weekes examines embedding real-time voice and video into games. Agora's official session description includes integrating spatial audio and live video into a 3D game engine.
summary.zh: Ben Weekes 讨论在游戏中加入实时语音和视频，Agora 的官方讲座说明还包括将空间音频与实时视频集成进三维引擎的演示。

sessions.title: Independent Game Summit: These Non-Violent Delights: Designing 'Stonefly's' Combat

summary.en: Stonefly reflects on designing nonlethal combat through gameplay and narrative goals.
summary.zh: 《Stonefly》从玩法与叙事目标出发，回顾非致命战斗设计。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit Session: Getting Players Emotionally Invested in Procedural Characters in 'Wildermyth'

summary.en: Wildermyth discusses techniques for encouraging emotional attachment to procedurally generated characters.
summary.zh: 《Wildermyth》分享帮助玩家与程序化生成角色建立情感联系的技巧。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: 'Goblins of Elderstone': 5 Lessons From 6 Years in Development

summary.en: Goblins of Elderstone reflects on lessons from a prolonged development and funding journey.
summary.zh: 《Goblins of Elderstone》回顾长期开发与融资历程中的经验。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: 2022 Soapbox
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：2022 自由讲坛

summary.en: The opening Soapbox contribution by Chris Zukowski challenges the expectation that a studio's first game must become a breakout hit. He discusses repeated releases as part of building a reputation, business and career.
summary.zh: Chris Zukowski 的开场短讲反思首作必须一炮而红的期待，讨论如何把连续发行作品视为建立口碑、业务与职业道路的过程。

evidence.note: 仅依据公开英文字幕的首位讲者发言整理，未覆盖后续讲者的话题。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: A Game from a GIF: How 'Button City' Was Made

summary.en: Button City discusses developing a game around visual ideas that gained attention online.
summary.zh: 《Button City》分享如何围绕受到网络关注的视觉创意展开游戏开发。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: An Approach to Game Art for Solo Devs, Small Teams, and Non-Artists

summary.en: An independent developer explores workable art approaches for solo developers and small teams.
summary.zh: 独立开发者分享适合个人开发与小团队的可行美术方法。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Big in Japan, Not in the West: The Difficulties of Cross-Cultural Appeal
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：在日本大受欢迎，在西方却不然——跨文化吸引力的难题

summary.en: This session introduces Japan's independent-game history and barriers to reaching Western audiences. Language and cultural differences frame a discussion of how development communities can exchange knowledge across regions.
summary.zh: 介绍日本独立游戏的发展历史与进入西方市场的障碍，围绕语言和文化差异，讨论不同地区的开发社群如何分享经验、相互学习。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Building The 'SkateBIRD' Brand In Layers
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：分层建立《SkateBIRD》品牌

summary.en: SkateBIRD's development is revisited through a marketing-first approach and responses from its community. The account connects expanding a solo project with partnerships, venue choices, and planning for release.
summary.zh: 回顾《SkateBIRD》以营销为先、根据社群反应逐步扩大制作的过程，把单人项目的扩展与合作安排、宣传场合选择及发行规划联系起来。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Choose Your Own Misadventure: AI-Powered Futures for Game Design
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：选择你的意外冒险——AI驱动的游戏设计未来

summary.en: This talk weighs opportunities and ethical problems that new AI tools create for independent developers. Examples from the Knives and Paintbrushes Collective connect those questions with practical tools and experimental games.
summary.zh: 讨论新 AI 技术给独立开发者带来的机会与伦理问题，并以 Knives and Paintbrushes Collective 的工具和实验游戏，说明相关思路如何进入制作与游玩实践。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Contract Killers Episode 2: What's Wrong with your Publishing Contract?
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：合同杀手第二集——你的发行合同有什么问题？

summary.en: This session examines publishing clauses that may disadvantage independent developers. It explains practical consequences of selected provisions and considers how understanding them can inform negotiations before signing.
summary.zh: 分析可能使独立开发者处于不利地位的发行合同条款，解释相关约定在实践中的含义，并讨论理解这些影响如何帮助签约前的协商。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Don't Talk to Me or My Baby Ever Again: Negotiating Challenging Collaboration
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：别再来找我或我的作品——协商棘手的创作合作

summary.en: Sweet Baby Inc's Kim Belair and David Bedard reflect on working as external creative partners with teams of different sizes. Common collaboration failures and positive cases inform recommendations for developing productive partnerships.
summary.zh: Sweet Baby Inc 的 Kim Belair 与 David Bedard 回顾作为外部创意伙伴与不同规模团队合作的经历，结合常见问题和正面案例讨论如何组织合作关系。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Four-Day Workweek: We Did It! What now?
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：四天工作制，我们做到了！然后呢？

summary.en: Independent studios compare their experiences implementing a four-day week. The panel examines motivation, transition, wellbeing practices, evaluation, and coordination with partners who continue to work five days.
summary.zh: 多家独立工作室比较实施四天工作制的经历，讨论动机、过渡安排、健康与生产实践、评估方式，以及与仍实行五天工作制的外部伙伴协作的问题。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Game Dev Communities from Home
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：居家建设游戏开发社群

summary.en: Moderators from three Mexican communities share lessons from operating fully online during the pandemic. The talk examines how indi-es, Women in GAMEX, and DevsVJ MX maintained and developed connections remotely.
summary.zh: 墨西哥 indi-es、Women in GAMEX 与 DevsVJ MX 三个社群的管理者分享疫情期间完全线上运营的经验，讨论远程条件下如何维系并发展开发者之间的联系。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: If You Build It They Won't Come: Marketing Fallacies & Missed Opportunities
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：做好游戏，玩家也未必来——营销误区与错失的机会

summary.en: A trailer specialist and marketer examine assumptions that can weaken indie marketing. The session considers screenshots, trailers, and overlooked outreach opportunities as parts of building an audience over time.
summary.zh: 预告片专家与营销从业者讨论独立游戏宣传中的常见误区，涉及截图、预告片和容易遗漏的推广机会，以及如何随着开发逐步接触目标受众。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Indie Games and Our Queer, Sex-Positive Revolution
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：独立游戏与酷儿、性积极革命

summary.en: Sharang Biswas examines how interactive and analog games explore sexuality, gender, and desire. Role-play and computational models of romance provide examples for reflecting on representation and design possibilities.
summary.zh: Sharang Biswas 讨论互动与桌面游戏如何探索性、性别和欲望，通过角色扮演及恋爱关系的规则化表达，分析相关呈现方式与设计可能性。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Indie Marketing How-Not-To: Review Breaker, G2A, and the $1.9M Steam Bug
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：独立游戏营销反面教材——Review Breaker、G2A与190万美元Steam漏洞

summary.en: This retrospective tells the story of an elaborate attempt to win viral attention through an unconventional marketing scheme. The speaker reflects on clever ideas and complexity that did not translate into an audience.
summary.zh: 回顾一次试图凭借特殊方案制造病毒式传播的营销经历，反思巧思与复杂安排为何没有转化为实际受众关注。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Love, Affection, and Relationships in Design
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：设计中的爱、情感与关系

summary.en: This presentation combines game analysis and designer accounts to examine affection play in digital and analog games. It considers successful and unsuccessful approaches, then relates broad observations to specific design elements.
summary.zh: 结合游戏分析与设计师自述，讨论数字和桌面游戏中的爱、亲密与情感玩法，回顾有效及失效的尝试，并把整体观察转化为具体设计元素的参考。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Making Indie Games with Public Domain Content
companies: Kent State University/Pie for Breakfast Studios
tags: Kent State University/Pie for Breakfast Studios
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：利用公版内容制作独立游戏

summary.en: Chris Totten uses his games to discuss finding and adapting public-domain material. The session covers checking rights and trademarks, attribution, respecting source works, and building visual or musical identities from existing resources.
summary.zh: Chris Totten 结合自己的作品介绍寻找和改造公版素材的流程，涉及著作权与商标核对、注明来源、尊重原作，以及利用既有资源建立游戏视觉和音乐特色。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Making Room for Accessibility & Health
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：为无障碍与健康留出空间

summary.en: Two talks address workplace support for chronic illness, fatigue, and mental wellbeing in small teams. The session considers practical adjustments to studio processes, especially for needs that are not immediately visible.
summary.zh: 两场演讲讨论小型团队如何支持慢性疾病、疲劳及心理健康需求，重点关注不容易被看见的障碍，以及工作室流程中可以采取的实际调整。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Making Room for Climate Justice
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：为气候正义留出空间

summary.en: Benjamin Abraham presents research-informed actions independent studios and professionals can consider in response to the climate crisis. The talk also explores implications for future production and the games themselves.
summary.zh: Benjamin Abraham 从研究出发介绍独立工作室与从业者可以考虑的气候行动，并讨论气候危机对未来制作方式及游戏内容本身可能意味着什么。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Prioritizing Accessible Player Experiences
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：为无障碍玩家体验确定优先级

summary.en: This session uses feedback from players with disabilities to examine accessibility priorities under limited budgets and schedules. It distinguishes prerequisites for being able to play from the differing value players place on other options.
summary.zh: 结合残障玩家的数据和反馈，讨论预算、工期与人员有限时的无障碍优先级，区分能够进入游戏的必要条件与不同玩家对其他选项的重视程度。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Reimagining the Corporate Hellscape: The Art Direction of Going Under
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：重新想象公司地狱——《Going Under》的美术指导

summary.en: Nick Kaman follows Going Under's visual development through its references to contemporary technology-company illustration. The talk examines how project needs and constraints shaped a distinctive direction and supported the game's story.
summary.zh: Nick Kaman 回顾《Going Under》如何借鉴当代科技公司的插画语言，说明项目需求与限制怎样逐步塑造视觉方向，并与游戏叙事相配合。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Releasing an Indie Game Looks More like a Marathon than a Sprint
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：发行独立游戏更像马拉松，而非短跑

summary.en: Broken Arms Games reviews a year of post-release work on Hundred Days: Winemaking Simulator. The presentation focuses on everyday product care and the sales-oriented choices made after launch.
summary.zh: Broken Arms Games 回顾《Hundred Days: Winemaking Simulator》发行后一年的工作，介绍持续维护产品的日常实践，以及上线后围绕销售开展的策略选择。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Sacrifices Were Made: The 'Inscryption' Post-Mortem
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：作出了牺牲——《邪恶冥刻》复盘

summary.en: Daniel Mullins traces Inscryption from a short game-jam entry to a larger card-game and horror experience. The postmortem also examines its art direction, use of public-domain assets, and the development of its ARG.
summary.zh: Daniel Mullins 回顾《邪恶冥刻》从短篇 Game Jam 作品扩展为卡牌与恐怖体验的过程，同时讨论美术风格、公版资产的结合，以及 ARG 的策划与制作。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: The 2022 Failure Workshop
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：2022失败工作坊

summary.en: Four developers reflect on abandoned projects, game-jam expansion, genre combinations, and launch expectations. The workshop treats these cases as opportunities to examine when to stop, what to learn, and how to define failure beyond sales.
summary.zh: 四位开发者围绕放弃项目、扩展 Game Jam 作品、混合类型及发行预期分享经历，讨论何时止损、如何提炼经验，以及怎样在销量之外理解失败。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: The Art of 'The Big Con'
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：《The Big Con》的美术

summary.en: Art director Saffron Aurora revisits The Big Con's evolving 1990s-inspired visual style and production pipelines. The presentation also reflects on an art director's responsibilities and influence within a project.
summary.zh: 美术总监 Saffron Aurora 回顾《The Big Con》九十年代风格的演变及制作流程，并讨论美术总监在项目中的职责、工作方式和影响。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: The Resolve of the Latin American Gaming Industry
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：拉丁美洲游戏行业的决心

summary.en: This talk surveys Latin American game development, markets, and content creators despite gaps in industry attention and infrastructure. The speaker examines regional experiences as material other game communities can learn from.
summary.zh: 讨论拉丁美洲在行业关注和开发基础设施有限的情况下，游戏、市场与内容创作者的发展，结合地区经历交流其他开发社群可以借鉴的经验。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Unpacking a Narrative Through 1,000 Household Items
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：用一千件家居物品拆开一个故事

summary.en: Unpacking's creators explain how object placement and narrative developed together. The talk examines environmental storytelling techniques that convey relationships and life changes with household objects and very little text.
summary.zh: 《Unpacking》的创作者介绍物品摆放机制与叙事如何共同发展，讨论用家居物品和极少文字传达关系、人生转变的环境叙事技巧，以及相关关卡的设计取舍。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: What [Blank] Taught Me About Game Dev
companies: NorQuest College & Unannounced Studio & Caldera Interactive Ltd. (former)
tags: NorQuest College & Unannounced Studio & Caldera Interactive Ltd. (former)
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：某件事教会我的游戏开发经验

summary.en: These microtalks draw game-development lessons from jobs and personal experiences outside the industry. The speakers consider how unfamiliar fields can contribute techniques and perspectives to different development disciplines.
summary.zh: 多场短讲从游戏行业之外的工作和个人经历提炼开发经验，讨论其他领域如何为不同工种带来方法与观察角度，以及跨职业进入行业的价值。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Writing Personal Experiences Without Sacrificing Your Health
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：书写个人经历，同时守护自身健康

summary.en: Emma Kidwell discusses bringing difficult personal experiences into games without neglecting the creator's wellbeing. Analysis of other works and a short I Wish I Were A Robot postmortem support practical guidance on handling heavy themes.
summary.zh: Emma Kidwell 讨论如何把艰难的个人经历写进游戏，同时照顾创作者自身状态；结合其他作品和《I Wish I Were A Robot》的简短复盘，分享处理沉重主题的实践考虑。

sessions.title: Inside Unity's new flagship demo (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 走进 Unity 的全新旗舰演示

summary.en: Mark Schoennagel examines Enemies inside the Unity Editor, beginning with its digital-human capture pipeline. Unity's accompanying announcement connects the demo to facial shading, strand-based hair and HDRP rendering.
summary.zh: Mark Schoennagel 在 Unity 编辑器中拆解《Enemies》，从数字人的捕捉流程讲起；配套官方说明介绍面部着色、发丝模拟与 HDRP 渲染等技术。

evidence.note: Unity 官方 GDC 公告列出了本场演讲，并以 Vault 公开英文字幕的开场内容补充。

sessions.title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 即时神经图形基元（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: Thomas Müller's research introduces trainable multiresolution hash encoding for neural graphics primitives. The approach connects compact networks with GPU-oriented implementation choices.
summary.zh: Thomas Müller 的研究介绍用于神经图形基元的可训练多分辨率哈希编码，讨论紧凑网络与面向 GPU 的实现选择之间的关系。

evidence.note: 采用讲者参与的 NVIDIA 原始研究论文，发布页标注为 2022 年 7 月。属于相关研究资料，未声称后续发表的全部细节和结果均在 GDC 展示。

sessions.title: Intel XeSS an AI based Super Sampling solution for Real-time Rendering (Presented by Intel)
sessions.title_zh: Intel XeSS：面向实时渲染的AI超采样方案（Intel赞助）

summary.en: Intel explains XeSS hardware and software, compares upscaling approaches, and presents examples from Art by Rens and Massive Work.
summary.zh: Intel 介绍 XeSS 的软硬件基础，与常见上采样方法比较，并展示 Art by Rens 和 Massive Work 的应用案例。

sessions.title: Interview Wizardry
sessions.title_zh: 面试魔法

summary.en: This session examines hiring from the employer's perspective and questions common assumptions about resumes and interviews. It offers the speaker's approach to preparation, negotiation, and understanding what a role may actually involve.
summary.zh: 从雇主视角分析招聘，并反思简历和面试中的常见假设，介绍讲者对于准备、协商及理解岗位实际职责的思路。

sessions.title: Introducing Unity's Newest Game Sample (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 介绍Unity最新游戏示例（Unity赞助）

summary.en: Unity introduces Gigaya as a production case for combining engine tools in a puzzle-platformer. The discussion connects stylized URP graphics, character control, and team workflows.
summary.zh: Unity 以解谜平台游戏示例 Gigaya 介绍多种引擎工具在制作中的配合，涉及 URP 风格化画面、角色控制与团队工作流程。

evidence.note: 依据 Unity 在 GDC 2022 发布的 Gigaya 官方公告，仅归纳其中说明的示例与工作流程，未当作未读的演讲实录。

sessions.title: It's Been 10 Years Since Tropes vs Women in Video Games: What's Changed?
companies: The Games and Online Harassment Hotline
tags: The Games and Online Harassment Hotline
sessions.title_zh: 《电子游戏中的套路与女性》十年后：改变了什么？

summary.en: Anita Sarkeesian revisits Tropes vs Women in Video Games, from its production to the responses it received. The talk assesses changes in women's representation and the industry, while considering work still ahead.
summary.zh: Anita Sarkeesian 回顾《电子游戏中的套路与女性》的制作、反馈与争议，讨论十年间女性呈现和游戏行业发生的变化，以及她认为仍待推进的问题。

sessions.title: Kickstart RT : Easy Open Source Ray Tracing (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: Kickstart RT：易于接入的开源光线追踪（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: This session examines Kickstart RT's world-space lighting cache and cross-API integration for reflections, global illumination, and shadows.
summary.zh: 介绍 Kickstart RT 用于反射、全局光照与阴影的世界空间光照缓存，并讨论跨 API 接入及其算法思路。

sessions.title: Knowing Me, Knowing You: Finding the Right Game Pitch in an Ever Changing Landscape
sessions.title_zh: 知己知彼：在不断变化的环境中找到合适的游戏提案

summary.en: Agostino Simonetta compares the motivations of publishers, platform holders, investment firms, and grant providers. The session considers how studios can align a pitch with a potential funder's goals and their own strengths.
summary.zh: Agostino Simonetta 比较发行商、平台方、投资机构和政府资助的不同动机，讨论工作室如何依据自身优势与出资方目标调整提案，并理解变化中的交易环境。

sessions.title: Landscape of Extremist Behavior in Games
tags: Center on Terrorism, Extremism, and Counterterrorism
sessions.title_zh: 游戏中的极端主义行为图景

summary.en: This session uses platform data and network visualizations to examine extremist communities and signaling across games. The discussion considers recruitment, shared identity, and the need for collaboration across platforms and developers.
summary.zh: 通过平台数据与网络可视化分析游戏中的极端主义社群、身份表达和招募行为，并讨论跨平台、跨开发商合作应对这一问题的必要性。

sessions.title: Leaders Working at the Heart of the Team 2022
sessions.title_zh: 在团队核心工作的领导者2022

summary.en: Leaders share situations where communication and emotional awareness mattered beyond formal production processes. Cases include building teams and studios remotely, acknowledging uncertainty, and supporting developers through pandemic-era change.
summary.zh: 多位负责人分享流程之外的沟通与情绪判断如何参与团队领导，案例涉及远程建立团队和工作室、承认未知，以及在疫情与行业人员变动中支持开发者。

sessions.title: Lessons from 'Duolingo': From Startup to IPO
sessions.title_zh: 《多邻国》的经验：从初创到上市

summary.en: Karin Tsai reflects on Duolingo's growth from a small startup to a much larger organization. The talk focuses on prioritization, changes in organizational design, and responses to expected growing pains.
summary.zh: Karin Tsai 回顾多邻国从小型初创团队扩展为大型组织的经历，重点讨论优先级取舍、组织结构演变，以及如何预判并处理成长带来的问题。

sessions.title: Lessons Learned From Two Decades of Audio Programming
sessions.title_zh: 二十年音频编程的经验教训

summary.en: Guy revisits lessons from an earlier talk on game audio programming after another eight years of work. The session compares how earlier advice has evolved and introduces further observations from two decades in the field.
summary.zh: Guy 在早先音频编程经验分享的基础上，回顾又八年实践带来的变化，讨论原有体会如何演进，以及二十年从业过程中新增的认识。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: 'Deathloop': How We Designed Four Maps Four Times
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：《死亡循环》——四张地图，四次设计

summary.en: Arkane Lyon examines keeping Deathloop's repeated maps engaging and its murder puzzle understandable. The talk also considers how multiplayer introduced additional constraints into a time-loop level structure.
summary.zh: Arkane Lyon 讨论《死亡循环》如何让玩家反复探索四张地图时保持兴趣，并理解刺杀谜题，同时分析多人玩法给时间循环关卡结构带来的额外限制。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: 1,2,3 Acion! Inspiring Level Design Pacing From Music
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：1、2、3，行动！从音乐中寻找关卡节奏灵感

summary.en: This talk adapts a musical 1,2,3 Action pattern to pacing challenges and events in levels. Examples from a 2D platformer illustrate how the pattern can inform the arrangement of playable sequences.
summary.zh: 将音乐中的“1、2、3，行动”模式用于关卡挑战和事件节奏，通过二维平台游戏片段说明这一结构如何启发可玩段落的编排。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: Designing the Museum Flashback: 'The Last of Us Part II'
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：设计《最后生还者 第二部》的博物馆回忆

summary.en: Evan Hill follows the Museum Flashback level from story outline to final polish. The case covers collaboration with writers, 3D blockout, improvisation, playtesting, and iteration within Naughty Dog's narrative-first approach.
summary.zh: Evan Hill 梳理博物馆回忆关卡从故事提纲到最终打磨的过程，介绍与编剧合作、三维白盒、即兴尝试、试玩和迭代如何服务于顽皮狗的叙事优先方法。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: Just Me & My Pitch: The Confused Art of Showing a Layout
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：我与提案——展示布局这门令人困惑的艺术

summary.en: This session proposes an eight-step approach to presenting a level design. It examines why demonstrations need context and explanation, and how combining both can make a complex playable layout easier to evaluate.
summary.zh: 提出展示关卡设计的八步方法，讨论复杂可玩布局为何需要上下文与讲解，以及如何结合演示和说明，让听众更容易理解和评估设计。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: Knocking on Death's Door: Designing a New Bunker for 'Horizon Forbidden West'

summary.en: Guerrilla traces the creation and iteration of Horizon Forbidden West's Death's Door quest.
summary.zh: Guerrilla 回顾《地平线：西之绝境》“死亡之门”任务的创作与迭代。

youtube.title: Knocking on Death's Door: Designing a New Bunker for 'Horizon Forbidden West'

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: Torchbearers: New Generation Immersive Sim Developers
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：接棒者——新一代沉浸式模拟开发者

summary.en: Designers from Tangiers, Gloomwood, Skin Deep, and Peripeteia compare interpretations of the immersive-sim tradition. Moderated by Harvey Smith, the panel discusses influences, design philosophy, and contemporary production challenges.
summary.zh: 《Tangiers》《Gloomwood》《Skin Deep》和《Peripeteia》的设计师交流对沉浸式模拟的理解，由 Harvey Smith 主持讨论创作来源、设计理念及当代制作难点。

sessions.title: Level the Playing Field With Highly-Accurate Clocks for Multiplayer Games (Presented by Clockwork)
sessions.title_zh: 用高精度时钟让多人游戏公平竞争

summary.en: Clockwork's related technical introduction connects synchronized clocks with event ordering, state replication and snapshots in distributed systems. It also describes measuring one-way packet or RPC delay to distinguish network interruptions and problematic virtual machines.
summary.zh: Clockwork 的相关技术文章将时钟同步与分布式系统的事件排序、状态复制及快照联系起来，并介绍如何测量数据包或远程调用的单向延迟，以识别网络短暂中断与虚拟机问题。

evidence.note: 采用 GDC 2022 前发布的 Clockwork 官方相关文章，未认定为 Vig Sachidananda 本场演讲的原文或录制。

sessions.title: Level-Up Your Gaming Telemetry Using Apache Kafka (Presented by Red Hat)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Apache Kafka 升级游戏遥测

summary.en: A related Red Hat talk by Evan Shortiss uses game-server events to explain real-time telemetry analysis with Kafka Streams. The practical workflow combines Kafka provisioning, Java and Quarkus processing, and deployment to OpenShift.
summary.zh: Evan Shortiss 的相关 Red Hat 讲座以游戏服务器事件说明 Kafka Streams 实时分析，涵盖 Kafka 配置、Java 与 Quarkus 处理，以及部署到 OpenShift 的流程。

evidence.note: 采用同一讲者的 Red Hat 2021 DevNation 相关讲座，不能认定为 GDC 2022 的录制版本。

sessions.title: Leveling up for Climate: 3 Ways Gaming Companies Can Take Action for the Planet
sessions.title_zh: 为气候升级：游戏公司为地球行动的三种方式

summary.en: Playing for the Planet Alliance members discuss environmental work in games, including platform decarbonization and green activities in live titles. The panel considers how other companies might organize their own actions.
summary.zh: Playing for the Planet 联盟成员介绍游戏行业的环保实践，包括游戏平台减碳和在线游戏中的绿色活动，并讨论其他公司可以如何组织自身行动。

sessions.title: Leveraging Games in the Fight to Protect Local Cultures
companies: University of Skvde / An Otter Team
Sweden Game Arena / An Otter Team
tags: Cultural Antiquities Task Force, U.S. Department of State
Cultural Antiquities Task Force, U.S. Department of State)
University of Skvde / An Otter Team
Sweden Game Arena / An Otter Team
sessions.title_zh: 借助游戏保护地方文化

summary.en: This panel examines the Cultural Heritage Game Jam and games addressing heritage protection. The winning Purunmachu team discusses translating concerns about looting, preservation, and community values into an interactive work.
summary.zh: 圆桌回顾文化遗产 Game Jam 及相关作品，获奖项目《Purunmachu》团队介绍如何把文物掠夺、保护与社群价值等议题转化为互动体验。

sessions.title: Live Long and Render!
sessions.title_zh: 长久开发，持续渲染！

summary.en: An educator-turned-developer reflects on a graphics-programming path from early OpenGL experiments to multiplatform rendering frameworks. The session shares career and technical lessons, including connections with other development disciplines.
summary.zh: 一位从教育转向开发的图形程序员回顾从 OpenGL 初步实验到多平台渲染框架的经历，分享技术与职业体会，并讨论其他开发工种参与图形编程的途径。

sessions.title: Lombax Lessons: A 'Ratchet and Clank: Rift Apart' Design Postmortem
sessions.title_zh: 隆巴克斯的经验：《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》设计复盘

summary.en: The lead designer connects Rift Apart's initial pillars with later systems, constraints, and pivots. Examples include Rivet's development, Pocket Dimensions, navigation in dense visuals, and goals for inclusion and accessibility.
summary.zh: 首席设计师将《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》的初始支柱与后续系统、限制和调整联系起来，涉及 Rivet 的演变、口袋空间、密集画面中的导航及包容性和无障碍目标。

sessions.title: Long Live Events: An Honest Postmortem about the Transformation of Indie Arena Booth to an Online Event
sessions.title_zh: 活动长存：Indie Arena Booth转向线上活动的坦诚复盘

summary.en: Valentina Birke reviews Indie Arena Booth's move to a social MMO event platform. The postmortem considers community participation, event marketing, online limits, and figures gathered from two years of experimentation.
summary.zh: Valentina Birke 回顾 Indie Arena Booth 转为社交 MMO 活动平台的经历，结合两年的数据和实践讨论社群参与、线上活动营销，以及网络形式的能力与限制。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: 4 Years of Bringing Characters to Life with Computer Brains
tags: Electronic Arts, The University of Edinburgh
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：四年探索——用计算机大脑赋予角色生命

summary.en: This research retrospective follows deep-learning approaches to animation and control built from motion-capture data. Quadrupeds, scene interactions, basketball, and martial arts illustrate how successive problems shaped the work.
summary.zh: 回顾四年间利用动作捕捉数据研究深度学习动画与控制的过程，通过四足移动、场景交互、篮球和武术案例说明问题、方法与后续研究如何彼此推动。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Aegis Engine: Building Multi-modal Moderation System in NetEase Games
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：Aegis Engine——构建网易游戏多模态审核系统

summary.en: NetEase introduces a moderation system spanning image, audio, and text. The technical overview considers fine-grained image recognition and OCR, noise-robust speech recognition, and text methods for identifying inappropriate content.
summary.zh: 网易介绍覆盖图像、音频和文本的多模态内容审核系统，分析细粒度图像识别、OCR、抗噪语音识别与文本挖掘如何分别参与不当内容检测。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: AI Animator : A Real Time Motion Completion System
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：AI Animator——实时动作补全系统

summary.en: Yinglin Duan presents research on generating game animation through real-time motion completion. The session explores an alternative to relying on a large prebuilt motion library, with attention to runtime and memory demands.
summary.zh: 段颖琳介绍实时动作补全的动画生成研究，探索在大型预制动作库之外组织动画的方法，并讨论游戏实时生成所面对的速度、内存与表现要求。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Emotion Detection for Expressive Characters in 'Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy'
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：《漫威银河护卫队》中表现性角色的情绪检测

summary.en: Romain Trachel discusses deploying emotion and facial-expression recognition during production. The system bakes actor-emotion curves for runtime animation, connecting recorded performances with the Guardians' body language during dialogue.
summary.zh: Romain Trachel 介绍制作阶段部署情绪与面部表情识别的过程，通过预烘焙演员情绪曲线，让运行时动画系统在对白中驱动护卫队成员的肢体表达。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Emotional Neural Style Transfer: Expressing Character AI Emotion through Paintings
tags: SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD, AI Division
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：情绪神经风格迁移——用绘画表达角色AI情感

summary.en: This session examines a character AI that records its journey as paintings whose style reflects its emotions. Model design, emotion controls, blending, and region masks illustrate an alternative channel for player-AI communication.
summary.zh: 介绍将旅途所见转化为绘画的角色 AI，并利用神经风格迁移表现情绪；讨论模型、情绪控制、风格混合与区域遮罩如何构成玩家理解 AI 的另一种渠道。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: It's Complicated: Getting ML inside a AAA Engine
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：事情很复杂——把ML装进AAA引擎

summary.en: Ubisoft follows navigation and vehicle-handling ML solutions through integration with Snowdrop and Anvil. The session examines the complete pipeline, resource and runtime costs, engine requirements, and knowledge sharing across projects.
summary.zh: 育碧梳理导航与车辆操控机器学习方案接入 Snowdrop、Anvil 的流程，讨论资源和运行成本、引擎要求、适用性判断，以及多个 ML 项目间的知识共享。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Multi-Modal Based Frame Rate Prediction
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：基于多模态数据的帧率预测

summary.en: Booming Tech uses Conqueror's Blade to examine collecting latency-related game data and training a frame-rate predictor. The case considers relevant features and how prediction could inform proactive optimization choices.
summary.zh: Booming Tech 以《战意》为实验平台，介绍卡顿相关数据的采集与保存、帧率预测模型及关键特征分析，并讨论预测结果如何为提前调整画质等优化策略提供依据。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Walk Lizzie, Walk! Emergent Physics-Based Animation through Reinforcement Learning
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：Lizzie，走起来！强化学习驱动的物理动画涌现

summary.en: This talk presents reinforcement learning as a way for user-created creatures to learn physics-based movement. It examines locomotion as a consequence of anatomy and training, alongside the problems encountered in automatic animation.
summary.zh: 介绍让用户自创生物通过强化学习获得物理运动的研究，将移动能力视为身体结构与训练共同产生的结果，并讨论自动动画过程中的问题和方法。

sessions.title: Making Beautiful Cross-Platform Content With URP - Part 1 (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 用 URP 制作精美的跨平台内容：第一部分

summary.en: Unity's related June 2022 URP tutorial introduces lighting as part of a rendering workflow that must scale across devices. It focuses on balancing realistic illumination and optimization for projects targeting 2D, 3D, VR or AR platforms.
summary.zh: Unity 于 2022 年 6 月发布的相关 URP 教程从光照切入跨设备渲染流程，介绍在面向 2D、3D、VR 或 AR 的项目中兼顾真实感光照与优化的思路。

evidence.note: 采用 Unity 于 2022 年 6 月发布的相关 URP 教程，未认定为 3 月 GDC 第一部分录制，也未推断讲者、章节或大会版本的对应关系。

sessions.title: Making Beautiful Cross-Platform Content With URP - Part 2 (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 用 URP 制作精美的跨平台内容：第二部分

summary.en: In a related URP performance discussion, Jonas Mortensen examines depth textures, depth priming and decal rendering on Quest. His diagnostic approach checks the decal technique and uses the Frame Debugger to investigate extra depth work before assuming a cause or fix.
summary.zh: 在相关 URP 性能讨论中，Jonas Mortensen 围绕 Quest 上的深度纹理、Depth Priming 与贴花渲染展开排查，建议核对贴花技术设置，并用 Frame Debugger 检查额外的深度处理。

evidence.note: 采用本场讲者在 GDC 2022 前公开发表的相关技术回复，未认定为第二部分演讲提纲，也未推断修复效果、性能收益或上下两部分的内容分工。

sessions.title: Making Game Production Tools with Bifrost (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Bifrost 制作游戏生产工具

summary.en: Maxime Jeanmougin presents procedural production tools built with Bifrost for Maya. Hair simulation for cutscenes and a toolset for generating game-ready buildings illustrate the workflow.
summary.zh: Maxime Jeanmougin 介绍用 Maya 的 Bifrost 构建程序化生产工具，通过过场头发模拟和批量生成游戏建筑的工具集说明工作方式。

youtube.title: Making Game Production Tools with Bifrost

sessions.title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Unleashing Substance 3D Designer to Sculpt Complex Characters (Presented by Adobe)
sessions.title_zh: 《漫威银河护卫队》：用Substance 3D Designer雕刻复杂角色（Adobe赞助）

summary.en: Genci Buxheli examines character sculpting and detailing across Designer, ZBrush, and Maya, emphasizing flexibility before finalizing shapes.
summary.zh: Genci Buxheli 介绍 Designer、ZBrush 与 Maya 之间的角色雕刻和细化流程，讨论如何在最终定形前保留迭代空间。

youtube.title: Guardians of The Galaxy: Unleashing Designer | Substance Days at GDC 2022 | Adobe Substance 3D

sessions.title: Massively Interactive Live Events and the Future of Interactive Media (Presented by Genvid Technologies)
sessions.title_zh: 大规模互动直播活动与互动媒体的未来

summary.en: Genvid's related announcement of The Walking Dead: Last Mile illustrates its MILE format through a persistent shared world. Viewers participate in an evolving story and influence characters, showing how a broadcast can combine audience reach with collective narrative decisions.
summary.zh: Genvid 同期公布的《The Walking Dead: Last Mile》以持续演进的共享世界说明 MILE 形式：观众参与故事并影响角色，将直播传播与群体叙事决策结合起来。

evidence.note: 采用 GDC 2022 前发布的 Genvid 相关产品公告，未认定为 Jacob Navok 本场演讲的实录。

sessions.title: Math In Game Development Summit: Deep Dive: Quaternion Springs
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：深入解析四元数弹簧

summary.en: This deep dive develops a quaternion spring for orientation changes, addressing curved paths and behavior under large forces. Quaternion derivatives and swing-twist decomposition lead toward a practical implementation.
summary.zh: 围绕旋转平滑中的异常轨迹和大力作用问题，推导四元数弹簧，介绍四元数求导、摆动扭转分解等概念，并逐步落到可用于游戏的实现。

sessions.title: Math In Game Development Summit: Practical Automation: A Guide to Random Game Content Generation
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：实用自动化——随机游戏内容生成指南

summary.en: Starting from mathematical principles and small demos, this talk examines technical and experiential issues in random content generation. It also proposes a model for assessing generated play experiences and guiding generator changes.
summary.zh: 从数学原理与小型演示出发，讨论随机内容生成在实际应用中的技术和体验问题，并提出评估生成体验的模型，用于指导生成程序的调整。

sessions.title: Math In Game Development Summit: Turning Patterns and Fractals: Program Generation of Natural Textures
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：图灵斑图与分形——自然纹理的程序生成

summary.en: This session combines Turing patterns, fractals, and machine-learning ideas for procedural natural textures. Examples include animal and plant surfaces as well as branching growth, in the context of high-resolution asset storage.
summary.zh: 结合图灵斑图、分形与机器学习思路讨论自然纹理程序生成，涉及动植物表面及枝蔓生长形态，并将其放在高分辨率资产存储需求的背景下分析。

sessions.title: Math In Game Development Summit: Visualizing Math
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：将数学可视化

summary.en: This talk explains shader mathematics through pixel-animation and VFX workflows across game tools. Particle systems, bitmaps, vector fields, graphs, and animated examples connect familiar math operations with visible effects.
summary.zh: 通过像素动画与特效流程解释着色器数学，结合粒子、位图、向量场、图表和动态示例，展示常用运算如何影响纹理坐标、世界位置及图像通道的视觉结果。

sessions.title: Maximize Game Operations with Minimal Cost: Online Operation Experience of 'Meteor Butterfly Sword'
sessions.title_zh: 以最小成本开展游戏运营：《流星蝴蝶剑》的在线运营经验

summary.en: The Meteor Butterfly Sword team describes organizing live content with a smaller development group. User personas, requirement breakdowns, a bimonthly release rhythm, weekly unlocks, and recombining content provide the main production topics.
summary.zh: 《流星蝴蝶剑》团队介绍人员精简后的内容运营方式，围绕用户画像与需求拆解、双月版本与每周解锁，以及内容复制组合，讨论版本和项目管理。

sessions.title: Minority Care: Make Color No Longer a Cognitive Disability
sessions.title_zh: 关怀少数群体：不让颜色成为认知障碍

summary.en: Naraka: Bladepoint provides a case for examining color information from the perspective of players with color-vision deficiencies. The session considers core player needs and broader work on accessibility standards at NetEase.
summary.zh: 以《永劫无间》为例，从色觉障碍玩家的角度审视颜色承载的信息，讨论核心识别需求与对应设计，并介绍网易推进无障碍规范的工作。

sessions.title: Mission Giver: Impossible: How 10 Separate Disciplines Collaborated to Redefine Mission Giving in 'Far Cry 6'

summary.en: Far Cry 6 examines collaboration across disciplines when redesigning its mission-giving experience.
summary.zh: 《孤岛惊魂6》分享重新设计任务交付体验时的跨专业协作。

sessions.title: Modern Accessibility in 'Diablo II: Resurrected,' Because Hell Welcomes All
sessions.title_zh: 《暗黑破坏神2：重制版》的现代无障碍设计：地狱欢迎所有人

summary.en: This talk examines adapting Diablo II for a broader audience while retaining its classic experience. Individual accessibility changes illustrate how the team interpreted player needs and offered options within a remaster.
summary.zh: 讨论《暗黑破坏神2：重制版》如何在保留经典体验的同时服务更多玩家，通过具体无障碍调整说明团队如何理解需求，并在重制作品中提供可选择的方案。

sessions.title: Motherhood in the Games Industry

summary.en: Mothers in game development discuss experiences and challenges at the intersection of work and parenthood.
summary.zh: 游戏开发行业的母亲讨论工作与育儿交汇处的经历及挑战。

youtube.title: Motherhood in the Game Industry

sessions.title: My Elephant in the Room: An 'Old World' Postmortem

summary.en: Soren Johnson discusses redesigning historical 4X conventions in Old World.
summary.zh: Soren Johnson 分享《Old World》如何重新设计历史题材 4X 游戏惯例。

youtube.title: My Elephant in the Room: An 'Old World' Postmortem

sessions.title: My First Game Credit Roundtable (Presented by the IGDA)
sessions.title_zh: 我的第一条游戏署名圆桌

summary.en: The roundtable notes examine how a first game credit affects recognition and career development. Participants also raise naming conventions, name changes and missing credits in live games as issues for future policy work.
summary.zh: 圆桌笔记讨论首次游戏署名对认可感和职业发展的意义，并提出姓名规范、姓名变更和持续运营游戏漏署名等后续政策问题。

evidence.note: 资料 PDF 明确说明未录制演讲，提供的是圆桌讨论笔记；IGDA 官方公告另有确认。

sessions.title: Never The Same Twice: Procedural World Handling in 'Returnal'
sessions.title_zh: 每次都不同：《Returnal》的程序化世界管理

summary.en: Housemarque discusses adapting its procedural-world experience from top-down games to Returnal's third-person production. The talk focuses on technical problems such as loading environments and their many possible arrangements.
summary.zh: Housemarque 介绍将俯视角游戏的程序化世界经验转用于第三人称《Returnal》的过程，重点讨论环境及其大量排列方式的加载等技术问题与后续经验。

sessions.title: New Face of Gaming (Presented by Xbox)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏行业的新面孔（Xbox赞助）

summary.en: Xbox professionals share experiences from different roles and discuss how diverse perspectives influence the industry. Brittney Pettway moderates the conversation.
summary.zh: Xbox 不同岗位的从业者分享个人经历，讨论多样化视角如何影响游戏行业，由 Brittney Pettway 主持交流。

sessions.title: New GPU, the Ultimate Reality! (Presented by Samsung Electronics)
sessions.title_zh: 新GPU，极致现实！（Samsung赞助）

summary.en: Samsung introduces Xclipse 920's graphics architecture and developer considerations. Ray tracing and variable rate shading cases frame discussion of mobile rendering and optimization.
summary.zh: Samsung 介绍 Xclipse 920 的图形架构及开发注意事项，通过光追和可变速率着色案例讨论移动渲染与优化。

sessions.title: Not Another ATT Session: How to win on iOS in 2022 (Presented by ironSource)
sessions.title_zh: 不再只是 ATT 讨论：如何在 2022 年的 iOS 平台胜出

summary.en: Yevgeny Peres frames app growth as a cycle of acquisition, engagement and monetization, analysis, and reinvestment. His introduction then traces how App Store discovery and product pages shape the decision to download, setting up a discussion of newer iOS opportunities.
summary.zh: Yevgeny Peres 将应用增长梳理为获客、参与和变现、分析及再投入的循环，再从 App Store 的发现机制与产品页演变切入，讨论影响下载决策的新机会。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，已核对讲者与 iOS 主题，未推断 ATT 应对方法或后续功能。

sessions.title: NVIDIA DLSS Overview & Game Integrations (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: NVIDIA DLSS概览与游戏集成（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: Andrew Edelsten explains DLSS's AI and spatiotemporal upsampling foundations, then considers integration into a game engine.
summary.zh: Andrew Edelsten 介绍 DLSS 的 AI 与时空上采样基础，并讨论将其接入游戏引擎的过程。

sessions.title: One Frame in 'Halo Infinite'
sessions.title_zh: 《光环：无限》中的一帧

summary.en: 343 Industries examines Halo Infinite's frame structure across consoles, PCs, and dedicated servers. Topics include variable frame rates, dependency-based scheduling, and execution-model changes required by differing hardware.
summary.zh: 343 Industries 解析《光环：无限》在主机、PC 和专用服务器上的帧结构，讨论从固定帧率转向可变帧率、基于依赖的调度，以及适应不同硬件所需的执行模型调整。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: 'Sky's' Journey to 1MM CCU: A Cloud Native Approach To Scaling
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：《光·遇》迈向百万同时在线——云原生扩展方法

summary.en: Sky's online-services team explains backend changes made while preparing for growth beyond its initial iOS release. The session examines scaling challenges and cloud-native architectural choices for a small service team.
summary.zh: 《光·遇》在线服务团队介绍从早期 iOS 版本扩展时的后端调整，围绕潜在用户增长分析扩容难题，以及小型服务团队采用云原生架构的选择。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: 10 Ways To Crash Your Server on Launch Day
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：发行日搞崩服务器的十种方法

summary.en: Chris Cobb uses deliberately inverted advice to review common online launch failures. Studio stories cover login queues, microservice mistakes, and excessive data storage as prompts for examining server readiness.
summary.zh: Chris Cobb 用反向建议梳理在线游戏首发常见故障，结合工作室经历讨论登录队列、微服务错误和过量数据存储等问题，帮助审视服务器上线准备。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: From Development to Production: Building Game Servers for the Cloud
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：从开发到生产——为云端构建游戏服务器

summary.en: EA explains bringing cloud deployment into multiplayer development earlier through its game-server hosting tools. Containerization, configuration management, and deployment pools illustrate how packaging and playtesting fit into the production pipeline.
summary.zh: EA 介绍如何通过游戏服务器托管工具，在多人开发早期引入云端部署，结合自动容器化、配置管理与部署池，说明打包、测试和生产环境之间的衔接。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Observing Changes: Time-Dependent Social Network Visualization and Community Behavior Pattern Analysis
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：观察变化——时变社交网络可视化与社群行为模式分析

summary.en: This session examines temporal social-network visualization at both group and individual scales. An online game's opening-period data provides a case for exploring readable representations and patterns in changing player relationships.
summary.zh: 讨论群体与个人尺度的时变社交网络可视化，以新开服在线游戏的数据为例，探索如何表达不断变化的玩家关系，并据此分析社交行为模式。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Quasar, Brightest in the Galaxy: Expanding 'EVE Online's' Server Potential with gRPC
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：星河最亮的Quasar——用gRPC拓展《星战前夜》服务器潜力

summary.en: CCP describes Quasar, a gRPC-based approach that moves selected EVE Online systems outside the main server. The talk examines architectural motivations and implications for large battles, maintenance, and service stability.
summary.zh: CCP 介绍基于 gRPC 的 Quasar 架构，讨论如何把《星战前夜》的部分系统移到主服务器之外，并分析这种服务划分对大型战斗、维护和稳定性的意义。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Real-Time Anomaly Monitoring in Multiplayer Online Games
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：多人在线游戏的实时异常监控

summary.en: ThunderFire UX explains monitoring that distinguishes game-service anomalies from faults in a real-time data pipeline. Cases involving transmission and scheduling show how locating a failure stage informs investigation and recovery estimates.
summary.zh: 雷火 UX 介绍如何区分游戏服务异常与实时数据链路故障，通过网络传输、任务调度等实例说明监控系统如何定位问题环节，并辅助排查和恢复时间判断。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: 'Space Station 13': Behind one of the Largest Open Source Games
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：《Space Station 13》——大型开源游戏幕后

summary.en: A Space Station 13 fork maintainer discusses how open development changes game design and production. The talk weighs community involvement and extensive forking against challenges specific to maintaining an open-source game.
summary.zh: 《Space Station 13》分支维护者讨论开源如何改变游戏设计与制作，分析社群参与、自建分支的自由，以及维护开放项目时不同于闭源开发的挑战。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Being Successful with Open Source in Game Development
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：在游戏开发中做好开源

summary.en: Drawing on Google's game-related open-source work, this session examines motivations and costs for individuals and companies. It also considers project health from the perspectives of creators and contributors.
summary.zh: 结合 Google 在游戏领域的开源经验，讨论个人与公司参与开源的动机和成本，并从项目发起者与贡献者双方分析健康开源项目所需的条件。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: How to Be a Successful Individual or Company Lead by Creating OSS, a Case Study From Messagepack for C#, Unirx, Unitask
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：通过OSS成长——MessagePack for C#、UniRx与UniTask案例

summary.en: The creator of several C# and Unity libraries discusses releasing and maintaining small-to-medium open-source projects. The session connects practical development choices with career paths, community value, and company support.
summary.zh: 多款 C# 与 Unity 库的作者回顾中小型开源项目的发布与维护，讨论开发选择、社群意义、个人职业路径，以及公司如何支持并参与相关工作。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Open Source Strategy for Game Studios
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：游戏工作室的开源策略

summary.en: An open-source strategist and a narrative-tool creator discuss open source as a studio-level decision. The session considers implications for recruiting, onboarding, and a studio's public identity beyond obtaining free utilities.
summary.zh: 开源策略专家与叙事工具创作者从工作室层面讨论开源选择，分析招聘、入职和对外形象等方面的关系，帮助团队建立更完整的开源思路。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Understanding the Godot Engine Architecture and Development Process
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：理解Godot引擎架构与开发流程

summary.en: This overview examines Godot's technical areas, architectural choices, and planned direction. It also explains the community-driven development process and practices followed by people contributing code.
summary.zh: 综述 Godot 的技术模块、架构选择与发展方向，同时介绍社区主导的开发流程及代码贡献者采用的实践，帮助理解引擎技术与协作模式的联系。

sessions.title: Opportunities for Universal Scene Description (USD) in Game Development (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 通用场景描述USD在游戏开发中的机会（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: Technical leaders discuss production-pipeline bottlenecks and studios' experiments with using USD to address them.
summary.zh: 多位技术负责人讨论游戏制作流程的瓶颈，以及工作室探索 USD 应用时的思路与机会。

sessions.title: Optimizing Ray Tracing GPU Workloads using Nsight Graphics: GPU Trace and Nsight Systems (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Nsight Graphics、GPU Trace 与 Nsight Systems 优化光追工作负载

summary.en: Dana Elifaz and Louis Bavoil use NVIDIA profiling tools to investigate ray-tracing performance. An opening Guardians of the Galaxy case shows how CPU and GPU timelines reveal idle gaps and thread behavior that starves rendering.
summary.zh: Dana Elifaz 与 Louis Bavoil 通过 NVIDIA 分析工具调查光追性能，开场以《银河护卫队》为例，说明如何从 CPU、GPU 时间线和线程等待识别渲染供给不足。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，未推断性能提升数值。

sessions.title: Orchestrating Next-Gen Graphics With Nsight Systems (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Nsight Systems 协调下一代图形工作负载

summary.en: Uri Shomroni places Nsight Systems within a graphics-development profiling workflow. He examines how CPU delays, GPU load, synchronization, parallelism and bandwidth can each limit performance.
summary.zh: Uri Shomroni 介绍 Nsight Systems 在图形开发分析流程中的作用，讨论 CPU 延迟、GPU 负载、同步、并行度和带宽如何分别形成性能限制。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，已核对开场讲者与主题。

sessions.title: Oriental Narrative: How to Understand 'Swordsmen (Wuxia)' in Chinese Games
sessions.title_zh: 东方叙事：如何理解中国游戏中的武侠

summary.en: NetEase speakers approach wuxia through game production and user research. Examples from Chinese martial-arts games frame an explanation of cultural expectations that can be difficult to access across language barriers.
summary.zh: 网易讲者从游戏制作和用户研究两个角度解读武侠，以相关游戏为背景，向跨文化开发者说明语言障碍之外的文化预期与玩家理解方式。

sessions.title: Our remote future: Game creation and collaboration with AWS (Presented by Amazon Web Services)
sessions.title_zh: 我们的远程未来：借助AWS创作游戏与协作（Amazon Web Services赞助）

summary.en: Antony Passemard discusses converging development technologies and AWS tools for remote game teams.
summary.zh: Antony Passemard 讨论游戏开发技术的汇合，以及 AWS 工具如何参与远程团队的创作与协作。

sessions.title: Panel: Experimenting with USD in Game Pipelines (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: 圆桌：在游戏管线中试用 USD

summary.en: Autodesk's panel discusses USD as a way to exchange and work with complex scene data. Contributors from NetEase and Eidos-Montréal examine nonlinear, non-destructive workflows and collaboration across tools.
summary.zh: Autodesk 圆桌围绕 USD 对复杂场景数据的交换与操作展开，网易和 Eidos-Montréal 的嘉宾讨论跨工具协作，以及非线性、非破坏式工作流程。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，已核对圆桌题目及参与者。

sessions.title: Pathing in 'Age of Empires IV': Flow Fields and Steering Behaviors
sessions.title_zh: 《帝国时代4》的寻路：流场与转向行为

summary.en: The Age of Empires IV team examines combining flow fields, hierarchical A*, and steering for large groups in changing battlefields. Terrain, unit sizes, optimization, and implementation pitfalls provide the detailed topics.
summary.zh: 《帝国时代4》团队介绍在动态战场中结合流场、分层 A* 与转向行为组织大规模单位移动，讨论地形、单位体型、优化及实际实现中的细节问题。

sessions.title: Performance Tuning Games for Hybrid Architectures (Presented by Intel)
sessions.title_zh: 为混合架构调优游戏（Intel赞助）

summary.en: Intel examines Alder Lake's P-cores and E-cores, thread scheduling, Thread Director, and game workloads suited to efficiency cores.
summary.zh: Intel 解析 Alder Lake 的性能核与能效核，讨论线程调度、Thread Director，以及适合交给能效核的游戏任务。

youtube.title: Performance Tuning Games for Hybrid Architectures | GDC 2022 | Intel Software

sessions.title: Performant Reflective Beauty: Hybrid Raytracing with Far Cry 6 (Presented by AMD)
sessions.title_zh: 高效的反射之美：《孤岛惊魂6》的混合光追（AMD赞助）

summary.en: AMD and Ubisoft discuss their collaboration on hybrid ray-traced reflections for Far Cry 6.
summary.zh: AMD 与育碧介绍为《孤岛惊魂6》实现混合光追反射的合作，聚焦这一效果的技术制作背景。

sessions.title: Physiological Effects of Crunch: A Look at the Science
sessions.title_zh: 加班的生理影响：看看科学证据

summary.en: Ian Schreiber reviews published research on long working hours and associated sleep loss. The session asks how duration and intensity relate to measurable effects on mental and physical functioning.
summary.zh: Ian Schreiber 回顾关于长工时及相关睡眠不足的已发表研究，讨论加班持续时间和强度如何与可测量的身心影响联系起来。

sessions.title: Play and Earn: Transforming Games with the Blockchain Economy (Presented by Wemade)
sessions.title_zh: 边玩边赚：用区块链经济改变游戏

summary.en: Wemade presents MIR4's connections between game resources, tokens and tradable characters. The opening also introduces WEMIX's developer onboarding, SDK and guidelines for linking games to its proposed blockchain economy.
summary.zh: Wemade 介绍《MIR4》中游戏资源、代币与可交易角色之间的联系，开场还说明 WEMIX 面向开发者的接入、SDK 和设计指南，以及其区块链经济构想。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，仅归纳讲者介绍的经济构想。

sessions.title: Play to Earn Entertainment & Economy (Presented by Splinterlands)
sessions.title_zh: 边玩边赚的娱乐与经济

summary.en: Richard Adleta explains Splinterlands' economic design through ownership, exchange and staking of in-game assets. The talk considers how decentralization, openness and user utility shape both the game and its company.
summary.zh: Richard Adleta 围绕游戏资产的持有、交换与质押介绍《Splinterlands》的经济设计，讨论去中心化、开放和用户效用如何影响游戏与公司组织。

youtube.title: Play to Earn Entertainment & Economy (Presented by Splinterlands)

sessions.title: Practical Vulkan - From API to Applications (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 实用Vulkan：从API到应用（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: Martin-Karl Lefrancois uses nvpro-samples to progress from Vulkan fundamentals toward more complex graphics applications.
summary.zh: Martin-Karl Lefrancois 借助 nvpro-samples，从 Vulkan 基础逐步讲到更复杂的图形应用构建。

sessions.title: Principles towards Real-Time Simulation of Material Point Method on Modern GPUs (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 现代GPU上材质点法实时模拟的设计原则（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: The researchers connect GPU architecture principles with material-point-method simulation. Their work considers both single-GPU execution and multi-GPU coordination for real-time physics.
summary.zh: 研究者将 GPU 架构原则应用于材质点法模拟，讨论面向实时物理的单 GPU 执行与多 GPU 协作。

evidence.note: 研究者自己的项目页明确列出 GDC 2022 演讲，并提供 GPU 材质点法研究背景；作为讲者相关资料使用，未当作原始 Vault 简介。

sessions.title: Procedural Primer for Artists (Presented by Houdini)
sessions.title_zh: 美术人员的程序化入门（Houdini赞助）

summary.en: Robert Magee discusses artist-controllable Houdini tools shared through Unity or Unreal, including how artists can communicate their requirements.
summary.zh: Robert Magee 介绍可在 Unity 或 Unreal 中使用的 Houdini 程序化工具，讨论美术控制和向技术美术表达需求的方法。

sessions.title: Procedural Workflows in Production (Presented by Houdini)
sessions.title_zh: 生产中的程序化工作流程（Houdini赞助）

summary.en: Simon Verstraete uses Project Titan to explain how procedural game tools are built and used during production.
summary.zh: Simon Verstraete 以 Project Titan 为例，介绍游戏程序化工具如何构建，以及这些工具在制作中的使用方式。

sessions.title: Production Essentials Summit: Anti-Crunch: Patterns and Practices
sessions.title_zh: 制作基础峰会：反加班——模式与实践

summary.en: Chris Cobb discusses production and team practices used at Pragma to resist crunch. Milestone planning, early code, frequent shipping, stable teams, and work-life expectations form the main examples.
summary.zh: Chris Cobb 介绍 Pragma 应对加班文化的制作与团队实践，涉及里程碑规划、尽早编写代码、频繁交付、长期稳定团队，以及工作与生活边界的建立。

sessions.title: Production Essentials Summit: Congratulations You've Become a Lead: Now What?

summary.en: A production leader discusses responsibilities and challenges faced by newly promoted team leads.
summary.zh: 制作负责人讨论新晋团队主管需要承担的职责及面临的挑战。

sessions.title: Production Essentials Summit: No Mavericks, No Martyrs: Sustainable, Collaborative Production
sessions.title_zh: 制作基础峰会：不要独行侠，也不要牺牲者——可持续的协作制作

summary.en: This talk examines developers adding work outside agreed pipelines and hours, and the consequences for other departments. It discusses scope growth, technical debt, and trust, then considers leadership responses that preserve enthusiasm.
summary.zh: 分析开发者绕过既定流程或额外加时加入内容时，对下游部门、项目范围、技术债和团队信任的影响，并讨论负责人如何在保留热情的同时引导可持续协作。

sessions.title: Production Essentials Summit: Production in Media Res
sessions.title_zh: 制作基础峰会：中途接手制作工作

summary.en: Cases from Filament Games, Studio Drydock, and PUBG Corporation examine producers joining projects already underway. The session focuses on diagnosing problems and choosing responses while continuing everyday production duties.
summary.zh: 通过 Filament Games、Studio Drydock 和 PUBG Corporation 的案例，讨论制作人中途加入项目时，如何一边承担日常职责，一边诊断问题并选择合适的解决策略。

sessions.title: Production Essentials Summit: The Agile vs Waterfall Myth
sessions.title_zh: 制作基础峰会：敏捷与瀑布之争的迷思

summary.en: Benjamin Hoyt questions a strict choice between Agile and Waterfall in game production. Drawing on licensed projects, he outlines a hybrid approach for work-for-hire games with tight budgets and fixed deadlines.
summary.zh: Benjamin Hoyt 结合授权项目经验，反思游戏制作中敏捷与瀑布的二选一思路，并提出面向预算紧张、期限固定的委托开发项目的混合方法。

sessions.title: Professional Growth: Growing You, Not Just Your Skills
sessions.title_zh: 职业成长：成长的是你，不只是技能

summary.en: This session considers resilience, humility, kindness, discipline, and other personal traits behind teamwork. A cycling analogy frames deliberate practice and learning to function amid the discomfort of uncertain problems.
summary.zh: 讨论支撑团队工作的韧性、谦逊、善意和自律等个人特质，以自行车训练为比喻，介绍有意识的练习以及在不确定问题带来的不适中成长。

sessions.title: Psychonauts 2: Bringing Classic Characters into the Modern Era (Presented by Adobe)
sessions.title_zh: 《脑航员2》：让经典角色走进现代（Adobe赞助）

summary.en: Double Fine examines updating Psychonauts characters through a new engine and Substance Painter workflow while preserving the original visual identity.
summary.zh: Double Fine 讨论《脑航员2》如何借助新引擎与 Substance Painter 流程更新角色，同时保留前作确立的视觉特征。

youtube.title: Psychonauts 2: Classic Characters in The Modern Era | Substance Days at GDC 2022 | Substance 3D

sessions.title: Pulling Together A Business Case
sessions.title_zh: 构建商业论证

summary.en: Rami Ismail examines how independent developers frame pitches, budgets, risks, and opportunities. The talk draws on supporting studios to discuss recurring mistakes and assembling a business case a funding partner can assess.
summary.zh: Rami Ismail 结合帮助工作室的经验，讨论独立开发者如何组织提案、预算、风险与机会，分析反复出现的误区，并说明怎样形成可供出资方评估的商业论证。

sessions.title: Push Start Button: The New Amazon GameSparks (Presented by Amazon Web Services)
sessions.title_zh: 按下开始键：全新 Amazon GameSparks

summary.en: AWS's accompanying launch article explains GameSparks through serverless game logic, player data and client messaging. A Unity turn-based game example combines guest authentication, turn notifications and calls to an existing leaderboard, with a console test harness for iterating on Cloud Code.
summary.zh: AWS 同期发布文章以无服务器游戏逻辑、玩家数据和客户端消息介绍 GameSparks，并用 Unity 回合制游戏说明游客认证、轮次通知及既有排行榜接入，以及通过控制台测试 Cloud Code 的迭代方式。

evidence.note: 依据 GameSparks 同日官方发布文章，属于配套产品资料，未认定为恢复的 GDC 演讲简介或录制。

sessions.title: Ray Tracing Performance Revealed. How to optimize your game with the Radeon Developer Tool Suite (Presented by AMD)
sessions.title_zh: 揭秘光追性能：用Radeon开发工具套件优化游戏（AMD赞助）

summary.en: AMD demonstrates profiling ray-tracing stages and acceleration structures with Radeon GPU Profiler and Radeon Raytracing Analyzer.
summary.zh: AMD 演示如何利用 Radeon GPU Profiler 与 Raytracing Analyzer 分析光追各阶段及加速结构的性能问题。

sessions.title: Recalibrating Our Limits: Lighting on 'Ratchet and Clank: Rift Apart'
sessions.title_zh: 重新校准极限：《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》的灯光

summary.en: Insomniac's lighting team discusses adapting workflows from Marvel's Spider-Man for Rift Apart. The session examines setup, production challenges, and pipeline changes in pursuing the project's PS5 visual goals.
summary.zh: Insomniac 灯光团队讨论如何将《漫威蜘蛛侠》的流程用于《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》，介绍设定、制作难点及开发期间的调整，以回应 PS5 项目的视觉目标。

sessions.title: Recording Art and Engineering Practice: Social Network with Musical Instruments in 'Revelation Mobile'
sessions.title_zh: 录音艺术与工程实践：《天谕》手游中的乐器社交

summary.en: Revelation Mobile provides a case for making instrumental performance part of MMORPG play. The team discusses instruments, shared scores, and ensemble performance as components of player-led musical and social interaction.
summary.zh: 以《天谕》手游为例，讨论如何把乐器演奏变成 MMORPG 玩法，介绍乐器、乐谱分享和组建乐队等内容如何构成玩家主导的音乐与社交互动。

sessions.title: Redefining Online Multiplayer Experiences on PlayStation 5 (Presented by Amazon Web Services)
sessions.title_zh: 重新定义PlayStation 5在线多人体验（Amazon Web Services赞助）

summary.en: Sony examines moving its multiplayer ecosystem from PS4-era architecture toward a flexible AWS-backed design for PS5.
summary.zh: Sony 回顾从 PS4 到 PS5 的多人生态架构调整，讨论借助 AWS 应对扩展性、可用性与变化中的需求。

sessions.title: Refreshing 'Guild Wars 2' with the Traditional Music of Korea
sessions.title_zh: 用韩国传统音乐焕新《激战2》

summary.en: The End of Dragons soundtrack team discusses combining Korean musical traditions with Guild Wars' existing identity. The account includes learning as cultural outsiders, early mistakes, and bringing Korean collaborators into the process.
summary.zh: 《激战2：巨龙绝境》配乐团队讨论如何把韩国音乐传统与系列既有声音结合，回顾外来创作者的学习、早期失误，以及邀请韩国合作成员参与的过程。

sessions.title: Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Cars and Tracks Design in Racing Games
sessions.title_zh: 利用强化学习辅助竞速游戏车辆与赛道设计

summary.en: This presentation examines deep reinforcement learning for evaluating cars across racing tracks. Racing-line generation and drift-area visualization are discussed as tools for designers assessing vehicle performance and track difficulty.
summary.zh: 介绍用深度强化学习评估不同车辆与赛道组合的方法，讨论赛车路线生成和漂移区域可视化如何为车辆性能、赛道难度的设计判断提供工具。

sessions.title: Remastering a Classic: 'Diablo II: Resurrected'
sessions.title_zh: 重制经典：《暗黑破坏神2：重制版》

summary.en: The remaster team discusses decisions about what to update and what to preserve in Diablo II. Controller support, frame-rate changes, quality-of-life options, and rejected ideas illustrate the design tradeoffs.
summary.zh: 重制团队讨论《暗黑破坏神2》哪些部分需要更新、哪些应该保留，通过手柄支持、帧率调整、便利性功能及未采用方案，说明现代化设计中的取舍。

sessions.title: Research Advances Toward Real-time Path Tracing (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 迈向实时路径追踪的研究进展（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: NVIDIA surveys research on sampling, denoising, systems, and optimization for real-time path tracing. It also discusses combining GeForce SDKs into a reference renderer.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 综述面向实时路径追踪的采样、降噪、系统与优化研究，并讨论如何把 GeForce SDK 组合成参考渲染器。

sessions.title: Respectful Nonbinary Representation & Localization
sessions.title_zh: 尊重非二元性别的呈现与本地化

summary.en: Xbox's Gaming for Everyone team discusses nonbinary characters and player expression across cultures. The session considers respectful representation alongside locally appropriate ways of translating and adapting that content.
summary.zh: Xbox 的 Gaming for Everyone 团队讨论非二元角色与玩家自我表达，介绍尊重相关身份的呈现方式，以及在不同文化和语言中进行合适本地化的考虑。

sessions.title: Resurrecting a Classic: Bringing 'Diablo II' into the 3rd Dimension
sessions.title_zh: 让经典复活：把《暗黑破坏神2》带入第三维度

summary.en: This technical retrospective examines placing a modern 3D renderer over Diablo II's two-dimensional game. Reverse-engineering sprite-based spaces, adding height variation, and building a custom PBR renderer illustrate the reconstruction process.
summary.zh: 从技术角度回顾如何在《暗黑破坏神2》的二维游戏之上搭建现代 3D 渲染，涉及逆向理解精灵世界、加入真实高度变化，以及专用 PBR 渲染器的制作。

sessions.title: RTX SDKs: The Foundation of Next-gen Lighting for Games (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: RTX SDK：下一代游戏光照的基础（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: NVIDIA introduces RTXDI, RTXGI, and NRD through their roles in direct lighting, indirect lighting, and denoising. The session covers core mechanisms and basic integration considerations for the three SDKs.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 介绍 RTXDI、RTXGI 与 NRD 分别在直接光照、间接光照和降噪中的作用，说明核心机制及三个 SDK 的基本接入考虑。

sessions.title: Rules of the Game 2022: Specific Techniques from Discerning Designers
sessions.title_zh: 2022游戏规则：挑剔设计师的具体技巧

summary.en: Designers each present a focused technique used in their own practice. The short talks are framed around revisiting difficult design decisions when testing, community responses, or a core loop reveal problems.
summary.zh: 设计师分别用短讲分享自己采用的具体技巧，围绕试玩、社群反馈或核心循环暴露问题时，如何重新审视难以取舍的设计决定提供思路。

sessions.title: Scaling Ubisoft Rainbow Six Extraction to Millions of Players with GameLift (Presented by Amazon Web Services)
sessions.title_zh: 用GameLift为《彩虹六号：异种》承载数百万玩家（Amazon Web Services赞助）

summary.en: Ubisoft examines automated, redundant deployment and GameLift multi-region operations for Rainbow Six Extraction, including monitoring across data centers.
summary.zh: 育碧介绍《彩虹六号：异种》的自动化与冗余部署，以及 GameLift 多区域运营，讨论跨数据中心的监控和管理。

youtube.title: Scaling Ubisoft Rainbow Six Extraction to millions of players with GameLift - GDC 2022

sessions.title: Serious Games as the Next Level for Your Career
sessions.title_zh: 严肃游戏：职业发展的下一关

summary.en: The speaker uses personal projects to show game-design skills applied outside conventional entertainment careers. The talk considers serious games as a path for creative work and continued development where traditional opportunities may be limited.
summary.zh: 讲者通过个人经历展示游戏设计技能在传统娱乐岗位之外的应用，讨论严肃游戏如何提供创作与成长路径，尤其适用于常规行业机会有限的环境。

sessions.title: Share Early, Share Often: Transparency in Art Pipelines
sessions.title_zh: 尽早分享，经常分享：美术流程的透明沟通

summary.en: Phoenix Labs discusses making evolving art direction visible across a team. The session examines early sharing, candid feedback, and cross-disciplinary participation as ongoing parts of an art pipeline.
summary.zh: Phoenix Labs 介绍如何让全团队看见不断演进的美术方向，讨论早期分享、坦诚反馈与跨工种参与怎样融入持续的美术制作流程。

sessions.title: Shifts and Rifts: Dimensional Tech in 'Ratchet and Clank: Rift Apart'
sessions.title_zh: 切换与裂缝：《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》的维度技术

summary.en: Insomniac examines the rendering and I/O behind Rift Apart's dimensional transitions. The session connects PS5 hardware capabilities with sequences that shift between worlds during play.
summary.zh: Insomniac 解析《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》维度切换背后的渲染与 I/O 技术，说明 PS5 的硬件能力如何参与游玩过程中的跨世界转换。

sessions.title: SideFX Labs 2021-2022 | Servicing Next-Gen Development (Presented by Houdini)
sessions.title_zh: SideFX Labs 2021—2022：服务下一代开发（Houdini赞助）

summary.en: Mai Ao surveys SideFX Labs tools for worldbuilding, scanning, grooming, UVs, and effects, alongside the team's plans.
summary.zh: Mai Ao 回顾 SideFX Labs 在世界构建、扫描、毛发、UV 和特效等方面的工具，并介绍团队后续计划。

sessions.title: Simulating Tropical Weather in 'Far Cry 6'
sessions.title_zh: 模拟《孤岛惊魂6》的热带天气

summary.en: The Far Cry 6 team examines coordinating weather systems through continuous transitions. Wet surfaces, puddles, clouds, rain, ocean rendering, and vegetation form part of the technical and artistic discussion.
summary.zh: 《孤岛惊魂6》团队讨论如何协调热带天气系统，实现昼夜变化中的连续天气过渡，涵盖湿润表面、水坑、云雨、海洋和植被的技术实现及美术流程。

sessions.title: Social Media Deep Dive: 'Among Us' TikTok Strategy
sessions.title_zh: 社交媒体深度解析：《Among Us》的TikTok策略

summary.en: Victoria Tran reviews Among Us' approach to joining and producing content for TikTok. Statistics and examples support discussion of time investment, platform tone, community participation, and what did or did not work.
summary.zh: Victoria Tran 结合数据与内容案例，回顾《Among Us》进入 TikTok 的策略，讨论时间投入、平台语气、融入社群及内容效果中的得失。

sessions.title: Solo Development, Myths, Reality and Survival Strategies
sessions.title_zh: 单人开发：神话、现实与生存策略

summary.en: Solo developers compare the motivations, support, and difficult realities behind their released games. The panel examines mental health, market outcomes, and how individual journeys complicate the idea of an entirely solitary creator.
summary.zh: 多位单人开发者通过已发行作品的经历，交流动机、支持网络、心理状态与市场现实，并讨论个人创作旅程如何让“独自完成游戏”的概念变得更复杂。

sessions.title: Star Atlas: From Embedding Games into Industry to Embedding Industry into Games (Presented by Star Atlas)
sessions.title_zh: Star Atlas：从把游戏嵌入产业到把产业嵌入游戏

summary.en: Michael Wagner presents Star Atlas as an open framework for creators and a virtual economy. The official address description connects its space-exploration MMO vision with Unreal Engine 5, Solana and player-owned assets.
summary.zh: Michael Wagner 将《Star Atlas》介绍为面向创作者与虚拟经济的开放框架，官方演讲说明将太空探索 MMO 愿景与 Unreal Engine 5、Solana 及玩家资产持有联系起来。

evidence.note: 发布方称该视频为原演讲的重新演绎版本。导读保留项目构想的表述，未将其当作已实现的功能。

youtube.title: Star Atlas: From Embedding Games into Industry to Embedding Industry into Games [GDC 2022 Speech]
youtube.note: 发布方注明为 GDC 2022 演讲的重新演绎版本。

sessions.title: Starbreeze: Rebuilding the Studio after the Crash
sessions.title_zh: Starbreeze：危机后重建工作室

summary.en: Tobias Sjögren recounts Starbreeze's reconstruction after its 2018 crisis from the perspective of those who remained. The talk considers rebuilding culture, strategy, and trust with partners and players.
summary.zh: Tobias Sjögren 从留任成员的视角回顾 Starbreeze 在 2018 年危机后的重建，讨论团队文化、发展策略，以及与伙伴、玩家之间信任的恢复。

sessions.title: Stop Wasting Your Game Art! (Presented by Perforce Software)
sessions.title_zh: 别再浪费游戏美术资产！

summary.en: Perforce introduces Helix DAM as a way to find and reuse existing art rather than recreate missing assets. Its GDC announcement connects a shared Helix Core repository with search, automatic tagging, and review and sharing workflows for 2D, 3D and animation files.
summary.zh: Perforce 介绍如何通过 Helix DAM 找回并复用已有美术资产，减少因难以查找而重复制作的工作；GDC 发布说明涉及基于 Helix Core 的统一仓库、自动标签、搜索、审阅与共享流程。

evidence.note: 依据 Perforce 经 PR Newswire 发布的 GDC 2022 产品与会话公告整理，仅描述所公布的流程，未声称测得节省效果。

sessions.title: Studio 'Top Trumps': A Producer's Guide to Comparing Games Studios
sessions.title_zh: 工作室能力牌：制作人的游戏公司比较指南

summary.en: This talk uses a Top Trumps-style comparison to examine how studio types shape production work. Team resources, stakeholders, business exposure, and definitions of success inform choices about suitable working environments.
summary.zh: 借用能力牌式比较，分析不同工作室类型如何影响制作人的职责，涉及团队资源、利益相关者、日常商业接触和成功标准，以帮助判断适合自己的工作环境。

sessions.title: Succeed by Failing - A Developer's Journey in Error and Crash Reporting (Presented by Backtrace)
sessions.title_zh: 以失败促成进步：开发者的错误与崩溃报告之旅

summary.en: Mac Clark revisits building and shipping Fishing on the Fly as a solo developer. His description examines how crash and error reporting can turn development failures into a feedback loop.
summary.zh: Mac Clark 回顾独立制作并发行《Fishing on the Fly》的经历，讨论错误与崩溃报告如何帮助把开发挫折转化为持续反馈。

evidence.note: 讲者另列有 Devcom 2022、PG Connects London 2023 与 O3DE 2022 等版本，未认定这些活动的录制内容相同。

sessions.title: Supercharge your Mobile Game Stability with Crashlytics for Unity (Presented by Google)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Unity 的 Crashlytics 提升手游稳定性

summary.en: Samuel Edson and Marc Richards introduce Crashlytics for Unity's workflow for finding, prioritizing and fixing stability issues. The matching official 2022 session focuses on crash investigation for mobile games.
summary.zh: Samuel Edson 与 Marc Richards 介绍 Unity 的 Crashlytics 如何用于发现、排序和修复稳定性问题，同主题官方 2022 年讲座聚焦手游崩溃调查。

evidence.note: 官方视频标注为 Google for Games 2022，发布于 2022 年 3 月 15 日。作为同讲者、同主题的相关资料使用，未认定为 GDC 现场录制。

sessions.title: SuperPolish: Indie Game Audio
sessions.title_zh: 精细打磨：独立游戏音频
