summary.en: Four audio professionals discuss techniques and creative decisions for polished sound within indie constraints. The session considers the effects of limited budgets, time, and technology on the production approach.
summary.zh: 四位音频从业者讨论独立项目中打磨声音的技术和创作策略，分析预算、时间与技术限制如何影响制作方法，以及如何在这些条件下组织音频工作。

sessions.title: Surveying Developer Communication and Collaboration Needs During a Global Pandemic
sessions.title_zh: 全球疫情下开发者沟通与协作需求调查

summary.en: York University and IGDA present 2021 survey and interview findings on remote game development. The discussion covers communication, collaboration, wellbeing, productivity perceptions, and preferences for future office arrangements.
summary.zh: 约克大学与 IGDA 介绍 2021 年关于远程游戏开发的问卷及访谈结果，讨论沟通协作、心理状态、生产效率感受，以及开发者对未来办公安排的偏好。

sessions.title: Tackling Toxicity: How To Build a Thriving Player Community (Presented by Unity)
tags: MD, MPH - cofounder of Healthy Gamer
sessions.title_zh: 应对恶意行为：如何建设健康活跃的玩家社区

summary.en: Unity opens this discussion with players' accounts of harassment, exclusion and ineffective reporting. These experiences frame community safety as a support and product-design problem, including the limits of manually isolating disruptive players.
summary.zh: Unity 以玩家遭遇骚扰、排斥及举报无效的经历展开讨论，将社区安全放到客服与产品设计中审视，并反思手工隔离违规玩家这类处理方式的局限。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，仅归纳玩家遭遇及社区支持设计讨论，未推断后续 AI 机制。

sessions.title: Tale of Immortal: How To Sell 1.8 Million Copies in Chinese Market Within One Month (Presented by Leiting Games)
sessions.title_zh: 《鬼谷八荒》如何在中国市场一个月售出 180 万份

summary.en: Jinwen Hu explains the publishing decision behind Tale of Immortal and the marketing plan used to introduce its cultivation theme to a broader audience. The session also examines publisher selection criteria and the Chinese PC and console market for developers considering entry.
summary.zh: 胡金文介绍雷霆为何选择发行《鬼谷八荒》，以及如何围绕修仙题材制定面向更广泛玩家的营销策略，并讨论发行选品标准与中国 PC、主机市场的进入考量。

evidence.note: 依据检索索引中可见的官方 Vault 简介整理，未将讲题中的销量数字扩展为额外的因果结论。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Bringing the World to Your Shaders
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：把世界带进着色器

summary.en: Unreal Engine examples show how external scene information can drive materials and shaders. The talk examines world-space projection, blending assets into landscapes, and using terrain data to vary painted foliage.
summary.zh: 通过 Unreal Engine 示例介绍如何把外部场景信息传入材质和着色器，涉及世界空间投射、资产与地形融合，以及利用地形信息改变手绘植被分布的表现。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Building 'Zeta Halo': Scaling Content Creation for the Largest 'Halo' Ever
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：建造Zeta Halo——扩展史上最大《光环》的内容制作

summary.en: The Halo Infinite team discusses processes and tools for producing a larger cross-platform world. Mask painting, terrain, hex structures, and specification controls illustrate the technical-art challenges of scaling content.
summary.zh: 《光环：无限》团队介绍为大型跨平台世界开发的流程与工具，通过遮罩绘制、地形、六边形结构和规格控制等内容，讨论扩展资产制作规模时的技术美术问题。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Character Outfit Pipeline with Substance 3D Suite
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：使用Substance 3D套件的角色服装流程

summary.en: A Dance Central VR pipeline overview leads into authoring cosmetic color variants with Substance tools. The demonstration examines Designer graphs and Painter layer filters as ways to structure iteration.
summary.zh: 以《Dance Central VR》的角色流程为背景，演示使用 Substance Designer 图结构与 Painter 图层过滤器制作外观配色变化，讨论如何组织服装迭代。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Finding Harmony in Anime Style and Physically Based Rendering

summary.en: NetEase examines rendering approaches that combine physical plausibility with an anime-inspired visual style.
summary.zh: 网易分享兼顾物理可信度与动画风格视觉表现的渲染方法。

youtube.title: Finding Harmony in Anime Style and Physically Based Rendering

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Freelancing Tech Art Part-Time: A Few Dos and Don'ts
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：兼职自由职业——一些该做与不该做的事

summary.en: This session shares lessons on starting and growing a part-time technical-art practice while employed full-time. It focuses on considerations that distinguish technical-art freelancing from other kinds of contract work.
summary.zh: 分享全职技术美术人员开展兼职业务的经验，讨论起步与扩展时需要考虑的做法，并重点分析技术美术自由职业与其他外包工作的差异。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Human Perception of Motion and Animation
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：人对运动与动画的感知

summary.en: This talk follows visual-perception research into motion and animation. Frame-rate perception, visual-field position, color, optic flow, and spatial understanding are considered as factors in designing efficiently rendered scenes.
summary.zh: 从视觉感知研究延伸到运动与动画，讨论帧率、视野位置、颜色、光流及空间理解等因素，为判断互动场景中哪些视觉信息值得优先表现提供参考。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Lighting the Way: Efficient Dynamic Lighting & Shadows on Mobile
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：照亮前路——移动端高效动态光照与阴影

summary.en: NetEase presents techniques for dynamic lighting and shadows in a mobile rendering pipeline. The talk examines scene and character solutions together with lessons encountered while developing them.
summary.zh: 网易介绍移动渲染流程中的动态光照与阴影技术，讨论场景及角色表现采用的方案，并交流研发这些方案时积累的经验。

sessions.title: The Art and Worldbuilding of 'Lost in Random'
sessions.title_zh: 《Lost in Random》的美术与世界构建

summary.en: Olov Redmalm traces Lost in Random's gothic fairy-tale world through concept art, clay models, and writing. The talk examines how visual development and narrative influenced each other around dice, tabletop play, and chance.
summary.zh: Olov Redmalm 通过概念图、黏土模型与写作经历，梳理《Lost in Random》的哥特童话世界，讨论围绕骰子、桌面游戏和随机性展开的视觉开发与叙事如何彼此影响。

sessions.title: The Art Direction of 'Psychonauts 2'

summary.en: Psychonauts 2 explores translating distinctive minds into levels, enemies, and bosses.
summary.zh: 《Psychonauts 2》介绍如何将各具特色的心智世界转化为关卡、敌人和首领。

youtube.title: The Art Direction of 'Psychonauts 2'

sessions.title: The Art of 'Sable': Imperfection, Limitation and Worldbuilding through Visual Design
sessions.title_zh: 《Sable》的美术：通过不完美、限制与视觉设计构建世界

summary.en: Sable's team discusses how a small production shaped its visual choices and worldbuilding. The presentation examines techniques for a handmade, two-dimensional look in a playable 3D open world.
summary.zh: 《Sable》团队讨论小规模制作如何影响视觉选择与世界构建，介绍在保持玩法可读性的同时，让三维开放世界呈现手绘般二维观感的方法。

sessions.title: The Audio Journey of 'Psychonauts 2': Welcome To Our Mind
sessions.title_zh: 《脑航员2》的音频旅程：欢迎进入我们的心灵

summary.en: Double Fine's audio leads revisit five years of sound and music production on Psychonauts 2. Creative and technical problems are considered alongside morale, lockdown isolation, and reduced resources.
summary.zh: Double Fine 音频负责人回顾《脑航员2》五年的声音与音乐制作，将创作、技术难题同团队士气、隔离工作和资源减少联系起来，分享对音频从业者与负责人的体会。

sessions.title: The Burden of Proof: Narrative Deduction Mechanics for Detective Games
sessions.title_zh: 举证责任：侦探游戏的叙事推理机制

summary.en: Jon Ingold uses Overboard! to examine how players communicate a deduction back to a game. The talk considers assembling and refining explanations from evidence while preserving room for creative reasoning.
summary.zh: Jon Ingold 以《Overboard!》讨论玩家如何向游戏证明自己的推理，分析用证据和猜测组装、修正解释的系统，并思考如何在反馈明确的同时保留创造性判断空间。

sessions.title: The Design Direction of 'I Expect You To Die 2'
sessions.title_zh: 《I Expect You To Die 2》的设计方向

summary.en: Francisco Souki uses actual production documents to explain the VR sequel's design process. The session follows documentation, team alignment, and playtesting through different stages of development.
summary.zh: Francisco Souki 通过实际制作文档介绍 VR 续作《I Expect You To Die 2》的设计流程，讨论各阶段所需的文档、团队方向协调，以及内外部试玩如何参与决定游戏走向。

sessions.title: The Design of 'HoloVista': Crafting Mechanics for Immersive Storytelling
sessions.title_zh: 《HoloVista》的设计：为沉浸式叙事打造机制

summary.en: Scott Jon Siegel follows HoloVista from a desire to tell mixed-reality stories to its eventual hidden-object structure. The account examines collaborative exploration and changes made during production and the pandemic.
summary.zh: Scott Jon Siegel 回顾《HoloVista》从混合现实叙事愿望到寻物玩法结构的形成，介绍团队协作探索，以及制作中期与疫情期间作出的设计调整。

sessions.title: The Developer Journey: How Intel and EXOR implemented XeSS in Riftbreaker (Presented by Intel)
sessions.title_zh: 开发者之旅：Intel与EXOR如何为《Riftbreaker》实现XeSS（Intel赞助）

summary.en: Intel and EXOR revisit XeSS integration in The Riftbreaker, connecting implementation lessons with the Schmetterling engine's development history.
summary.zh: Intel 与 EXOR 回顾《Riftbreaker》的 XeSS 接入，结合 Schmetterling 引擎的发展经历，交流实现方法与经验。

youtube.title: The Riftbreaker and XeSS: Bringing Xe Tech to Galatea | GDC 2022 | Intel Software

sessions.title: The Fine Line Between Difficult and Impossible: Adventures in VR Development
sessions.title_zh: 困难与不可能之间的细线：VR开发冒险

summary.en: Owlchemy Labs uses difficult VR production problems to examine uncertainty and feasibility. The cases focus on how the team decided whether an obstacle could be solved or exceeded practical limits.
summary.zh: Owlchemy Labs 通过棘手的 VR 开发案例，讨论未知且难以估算的问题，说明团队如何判断一个障碍属于可攻克的挑战，还是超出了实际可行范围。

sessions.title: The Future of .NET and Unity (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: .NET与Unity的未来（Unity赞助）

summary.en: Unity discusses its effort to modernize scripting foundations through .NET integration, language features, and runtime changes.
summary.zh: Unity 介绍脚本技术基础的现代化方向，涉及 .NET 集成、语言功能和运行时调整。

evidence.note: Unity 官方文章直接链接 GDC 2022 的 .NET 会话；导读限于文章描述的脚本与运行时议题，未将文章当作原始大会简介。

sessions.title: The Future of Ad Monetization and Mediation for Mobile Games (Presented by InMobi)
sessions.title_zh: 手游广告变现与聚合的未来

summary.en: Meson and MobilityWare discuss ad mediation through publisher choice, transparency and data control. The opening considers demand-partner management and how privacy changes affect audience understanding and monetization decisions.
summary.zh: Meson 与 MobilityWare 从发行商选择权、透明度和数据控制讨论广告聚合，涉及需求方管理，以及隐私变化如何影响受众理解与变现决策。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，已核对 Meson、MobilityWare 讲者及主题。

sessions.title: The Importance of Digital Humans for Industries (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 数字人对各行业的重要性（NVIDIA赞助）

summary.en: Technology leaders consider digital-human applications beyond media and entertainment. The panel compares current work in the area and perspectives on future uses.
summary.zh: 技术负责人讨论数字人在媒体娱乐之外的应用，交流各公司正在开展的工作，以及对后续用途的看法。

evidence.note: 采用同题、同讲者的 NVIDIA GTC 2022 年 3 月官方介绍，属于同期其他活动的相关版本；内容限于该页明确说明的应用及讨论范围。

sessions.title: The Key Role of Internal Production Communities of Practice at Ubisoft
sessions.title_zh: 育碧内部制作实践社群的关键作用

summary.en: Ubisoft outlines its internal communities-of-practice framework and a decade of related initiatives. Producer communities and a technical advisory board illustrate how shared expertise is organized around production work.
summary.zh: 育碧介绍内部实践社群框架与十年的相关举措，通过资深制作人社群和技术咨询委员会等例子，说明制作领域的经验与集体知识如何被组织起来。

sessions.title: The Magic that makes the Metaverse Feel Real (Presented by Agora)
sessions.title_zh: 让元宇宙具有真实感的魔法

summary.en: Hermes Frangoudis examines the demands of real-time interaction in virtual worlds. Agora's official session description uses real examples to connect edge computing and real-time networks with shared digital experiences.
summary.zh: Hermes Frangoudis 讨论虚拟世界中实时互动的需求，Agora 的官方说明通过实际案例，将边缘计算、实时网络与共同数字体验联系起来。

sessions.title: The Making of Unity's Latest Flagship Demo, an Achievement in Graphics and Rendering (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: Unity 最新旗舰演示的制作：图形与渲染实践

summary.en: Mark Schoennagel breaks down the Enemies cinematic in the Unity Editor. The stated topics include eye rendering, skin tension, real-time hair and DLSS, beginning with the capture of the actor's face.
summary.zh: Mark Schoennagel 在 Unity 编辑器中拆解《Enemies》，介绍眼睛渲染、皮肤张力、实时头发与 DLSS 等议题，并从演员面部捕捉流程讲起。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理。Unity 的《Enemies》公告分别列有 GDC／NVIDIA 演讲与 GTC 版本，未将两者当作相同录制。

sessions.title: The Many Challenges of Making 'Baldur's Gate 3'
sessions.title_zh: 制作《博德之门3》的重重挑战

summary.en: Swen Vincke discusses Baldur's Gate 3 while it is in development, balancing a studio vision with expectations for a beloved series. The talk considers storytelling tools, growth, and preserving Larian's working principles.
summary.zh: Swen Vincke 从开发中的《博德之门3》出发，讨论系列玩家预期与团队自身愿景的协调，涉及叙事工具、工作室扩张，以及如何维持 Larian 原有的工作原则。

sessions.title: The MAW: Safely Multithreading the Deterministic Gameplay of 'Age of Empires IV'
sessions.title_zh: MAW：安全地为《帝国时代4》的确定性玩法引入多线程

summary.en: The Age of Empires IV team explains tools for multithreading a simulation that must remain deterministic across different PCs. Debugging and verification are examined alongside ways to reduce the burden on gameplay programmers.
summary.zh: 《帝国时代4》团队介绍在不同 PC 上保持模拟结果一致的多线程工具，讨论调试与验证机制，以及如何减轻玩法程序员编写并行代码时的负担。

sessions.title: The NextGen In-game Voice Chat Experience and Solution (Presented by Tencent Cloud)
sessions.title_zh: 下一代游戏内语音聊天体验与方案

summary.en: Anthony Siu connects cross-platform and mobile play with the practical demands of in-game voice. The opening examines inconsistent networks, noisy play locations, and interference from game audio as challenges for noise reduction and echo cancellation.
summary.zh: Anthony Siu 从跨平台和移动游戏的发展谈到游戏内语音的实际需求，开场分析网络不稳定、游玩环境嘈杂，以及游戏声音干扰给降噪和回声消除带来的挑战。

evidence.note: 公开英文字幕开场明确介绍了讲者、Tencent Cloud 与本场 GDC 演讲；导读限于开场提出的问题，未覆盖后续实现细节。

sessions.title: The Path to Leveraging DOTS in Production (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 将 DOTS 用于正式制作的路径

summary.en: Ramen VR and Electric Square discuss practical uses of ECS in shipped game production. Unity's session description connects Zenith's large-scale VR gameplay with Detonation Racing's deterministic simulation for testing, design iteration and streaming.
summary.zh: Ramen VR 与 Electric Square 分享 ECS 在游戏制作中的实际用途；Unity 的会话说明涉及《Zenith》的大规模 VR 玩法，以及《Detonation Racing》用于测试、设计迭代和流送的确定性模拟。

evidence.note: Unity 官方页面提供本场介绍及直接播放链接，Jonas De Maeseneer 的公开文章也确认参加 GDC 2022。导读依据可见的会话介绍，未推断需要登录后才能观看的视频内容。

youtube.title: The path to leveraging DOTS in production | Unity at GDC 2022

sessions.title: The Real-Time Volumetric Superstorms of 'Horizon Forbidden West'
sessions.title_zh: 《地平线 西之绝境》的实时体积超级风暴

summary.en: Guerrilla examines extending its Nubis cloud system with superstorms, internal lighting, and lightning. Temporal upscaling for fast clouds and scalability between PlayStation generations form part of the implementation discussion.
summary.zh: Guerrilla 介绍 Nubis 云系统如何扩展出超级风暴、内部照明和闪电，讨论快速移动云层的时间上采样，以及在不同世代 PlayStation 间扩展表现的实现选择。

sessions.title: The Soundscapes of Yara: Audio Innovation and Representation in 'Far Cry 6'
sessions.title_zh: 雅拉的声景：《孤岛惊魂6》的音频创新与文化呈现

summary.en: Eduardo Vaisman examines how voices, music, ambience, and effects supported Far Cry 6's setting and narrative. The talk connects technical execution with early production choices about Latino-Caribbean representation.
summary.zh: Eduardo Vaisman 讨论对白、音乐、环境声和音效如何共同构建《孤岛惊魂6》的雅拉，将技术实现与前期关于拉丁加勒比环境及人物呈现的制作选择联系起来。

sessions.title: The Unity Roadmap for 2022 (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: Unity 2022 年路线图

summary.en: Unity's related 2022.1 release overview explains the year's focus on an extensible Editor, faster iteration and better performance visibility. UI Toolkit, material variants and frame-timing tools illustrate the broader roadmap for creator workflows and platform support.
summary.zh: Unity 的 2022.1 相关发布文章说明编辑器扩展、迭代效率与性能可见性等年度方向，并以 UI Toolkit、材质变体和帧时间工具展示创作流程与平台支持的改进思路。

evidence.note: 采用 Unity 于 2022 年 5 月发布的 2022.1 官方相关文章，其中直接链接 GDC 路线图视频；未把后续发布细节等同于完整的 3 月大会演讲。

articles.title: Unity 官方中文课程页：GDC 2022 技术路线图

youtube.title: The Unity roadmap for 2022 | Unity at GDC 2022

sessions.title: Thinking Like Players: How 'Halo Infinite's' Multiplayer Bots Make Decisions
sessions.title_zh: 像玩家一样思考：《光环：无限》多人机器人的决策

summary.en: This deep dive examines how Halo Infinite bots interpret game state and weigh possible actions. Combat, weapon collection, and flag capture provide examples for discussing player-like decisions and the team's evaluation process.
summary.zh: 深入分析《光环：无限》机器人如何理解局势并权衡行动，通过交战、获取武器和夺旗等例子，讨论接近玩家思考方式的决策系统及团队评估方法。

sessions.title: Three Opportunities to Improve Character Design in the Games Industry
sessions.title_zh: 改进游戏角色设计的三次机会

summary.en: Research on historical character-design trends and interviews with nineteen designers examines how stereotypes become routine studio practice. The talk identifies opportunities for practitioners and educators to question those patterns.
summary.zh: 结合角色设计历史研究与十九位设计师访谈，分析刻板印象如何成为工作室惯例，并讨论从业者和教育者可以在哪些环节挑战这些模式、采用更包容的设计。

sessions.title: Thriving in Game Audio Panel: A Post-Pandemic Future
sessions.title_zh: 在游戏音频领域成长：疫情后的未来圆桌

summary.en: Experienced and newer audio professionals compare career experiences in a changing work environment. Remote collaboration, networking, work-life balance, inclusion, accessibility, and personal branding form the main topics.
summary.zh: 资深与初入行业的音频从业者交流变化中的职业经历，讨论远程协作、人脉建立、生活平衡、包容与无障碍，以及个人品牌的构建。

sessions.title: Tips From the Trenches: How To Help Recruiters and Hiring Managers Get You In The Door

summary.en: Recruiters discuss how applicants can work effectively with hiring teams when seeking game-industry roles.
summary.zh: 招聘人员介绍游戏行业求职者如何与招聘团队有效合作。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: An Easy-to-Use Cutscenes Preview Tool with Low Resources
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：低资源、易上手的过场预览工具

summary.en: NetEase presents a cutscene-preview tool built around five plugins for turning scripts into speech and animation prototypes. The session examines how designers and artists can iterate together before final animation production.
summary.zh: 网易介绍由五个插件组成的过场预览工具，把剧本转成语音和动画原型，讨论设计师与美术如何在正式制作前共同迭代，减少预期理解上的偏差。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Efficiently Shuffling Loads of Data from Place to Place
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：高效搬运海量数据

summary.en: This postmortem examines a data-transfer tool created for large games developed across locations. The discussion covers architecture, speed, storage and bandwidth tradeoffs, and problems encountered while running the system at scale.
summary.zh: 复盘为跨地区大型游戏开发建立的数据传输工具，讨论架构、速度、空间和带宽之间的取舍，以及系统开发和规模化运行时遇到的问题。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: File System Tricks for Safe Incremental Builds
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：安全增量构建的文件系统技巧

summary.en: This session examines using file-system snapshots and virtual volumes to isolate unreliable incremental builds. The talk discusses an engine-independent design and its integration into a Unity build process.
summary.zh: 讨论用文件系统快照和虚拟卷隔离增量构建中的陈旧或损坏数据，介绍独立于引擎的设计，以及它接入 Unity 构建流程的方式。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Help Game Designers Analyze Data: How to Develop an Online Pivot Table Tool
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：帮助设计师分析数据——如何开发在线透视表工具

summary.en: The speakers describe a tool that lets designers retrieve and analyze data without writing code. Design and engineering considerations address the communication burden between designers and data engineers and ways to deploy a similar workflow.
summary.zh: 介绍让设计师无需编程即可获取与分析数据的在线工具，从设计和工程角度讨论如何组织自助分析，减少与数据工程师反复沟通，并分享类似技术流程的实施建议。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Immutable Data for Editors for 'EVE Echoes'
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：《星战前夜：无烬星河》编辑器中的不可变数据

summary.en: EVE Echoes' editor framework provides a case for immutable data in tool development. The session examines UI decoupling, reusable undo/redo, and combining the framework with component-based interfaces.
summary.zh: 以《星战前夜：无烬星河》的编辑器框架为例，讨论不可变数据如何参与 UI 解耦、可复用撤销重做，以及与组件化界面结合的工具开发。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Ubisoft Connect: Building User-Centered Frameworks for Internal Tools
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：Ubisoft Connect——为内部工具构建以用户为中心的框架

summary.en: A UX designer and researcher revisit the redesign of Ubisoft Connect's Pylon release tool. The session combines a user-centered framework with qualitative research, usability evaluation, and exercises for internal-tool teams.
summary.zh: UX 设计师与用户研究员回顾 Ubisoft Connect 发行工具 Pylon 的改造，结合定性研究、可用性评估及练习，介绍内部工具团队采用的用户中心框架。

sessions.title: Trim my Starship: Building Flexible, Modular Hero Assets in 3ds Max (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: 修整我的星舰：用 3ds Max 构建灵活的模块化主角资产

summary.en: Thomas Marrone explains Star Trek Online's modular starship modeling and shared UV template. Interchangeable ship parts and material sets show how the pipeline supports extensive player customization while remaining expandable.
summary.zh: Thomas Marrone 介绍《Star Trek Online》的模块化星舰建模与共用 UV 模板，说明可替换部件和材质组合如何支持玩家定制，并让管线继续扩充。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，仅涉及其中说明的建模与 UV 方法，未推断后续 3ds Max 操作。

sessions.title: Unfolding Your Gaming Potential With Galaxy GameDev (Presented by Samsung Electronics)
sessions.title_zh: 用Galaxy GameDev释放游戏潜力（Samsung赞助）

summary.en: The Unity and Samsung session introduces Adaptive Performance 4.0 updates, including new controls for scaling mobile workloads.
summary.zh: Unity 与 Samsung 介绍 Adaptive Performance 4.0 的更新，讨论通过新的调节项适配移动端工作负载。

evidence.note: Unity 官方文章明确关联 Galaxy GameDev 的 GDC 2022 演讲；导读限于其中描述的 Adaptive Performance 4.0 议题。

sessions.title: Unity Art Tools: A New Era of Creativity (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: Unity 美术工具：创意的新阶段

summary.en: Unity's panel introduces the combination of Wētā Digital, Ziva Dynamics and SpeedTree technologies. The opening discusses bringing film-oriented tools and rendering into real-time creation and wider artist workflows.
summary.zh: Unity 圆桌介绍 Wētā Digital、Ziva Dynamics 与 SpeedTree 技术的结合，开场讨论电影级工具和渲染如何进入实时创作，以及面向更广泛美术用户的工作流程。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，已核对圆桌题目及 Natalya Tatarchuk 的参与。

sessions.title: Urban Worlds: A New Procedural Modeler (Presented by Threedee.io)
sessions.title_zh: 城市世界：新的程序化建模器（Threedee.io赞助）

summary.en: Threedee introduces a procedural modeling approach for urban environments. Responsive geometry and drawing-based controls frame the discussion of architectural variation and keeping artists involved in generation.
summary.zh: Threedee 介绍面向城市环境的程序化建模方法，通过响应式几何和绘图控制，讨论建筑变化的组织方式，以及如何让美术人员持续参与生成过程。

sessions.title: Use Your Game Developer Superpowers to Fight the Climate Crisis Workshop
sessions.title_zh: 用游戏开发者的超能力应对气候危机工作坊

summary.en: This workshop combines lectures and activities on bringing climate-change and resilience messaging into games. Teams and individuals explore design approaches linking understanding of the crisis with player-facing experiences.
summary.zh: 工作坊通过讲授与活动，讨论如何把气候变化和气候韧性信息融入游戏，帮助团队与个人将对相关议题的理解转化为面向玩家的设计方法。

sessions.title: UX Summit: 'DEATHLOOP's' User Research and User Experience Death Loop
sessions.title_zh: UX峰会：《死亡循环》的用户研究与体验迭代

summary.en: Arkane Lyon recounts how research and UX work reshaped Deathloop's opening hours during development. The case follows major changes that solved some problems while exposing others across level, narrative, and UI design.
summary.zh: Arkane Lyon 回顾用户研究与体验设计如何在开发中重塑《死亡循环》的开场，讨论横跨关卡、叙事和 UI 的重大调整，以及解决旧问题后出现的新问题。

sessions.title: UX Summit: Empirical Study: How to Use Electrodermal Activity in Games
sessions.title_zh: UX峰会：实证研究——如何在游戏中使用皮电活动

summary.en: Natali examines electrodermal activity through research involving Detroit: Become Human and Destiny 2. The session considers findings, interpretation risks, and a proposed model for making physiological measurements useful in development.
summary.zh: Natali 结合《底特律：化身为人》和《命运2》的研究，讨论皮电活动数据的发现、解释风险，以及如何建立可用于开发决策的生理测量模型。

sessions.title: UX Summit: It's Not Just About Design: Universal Approaches to Designing in a Collaborative Environment
sessions.title_zh: UX峰会：不只是设计——协作环境中的通用方法

summary.en: This session places product design within teamwork, relationships, and understanding users. Experiences of success and failure lead into practical approaches for handling everyday collaborative situations.
summary.zh: 将产品设计放回团队关系、用户理解与个人信心的背景中，通过成功和失败经历，讨论面对日常协作情境时可以采用的实际方法。

sessions.title: UX Summit: Research on Visual Fatigue When Playing Games
sessions.title_zh: UX峰会：游戏过程中的视觉疲劳研究

summary.en: NetEase's UX team explains measuring visual fatigue and establishing a benchmark for mobile play. The session examines how fatigue indicators can inform adjustments to game-design parameters.
summary.zh: 网易 UX 团队介绍移动游戏视觉疲劳的测量与基准建立，并讨论如何把相关指标用于设计参数调整，理解视觉疲劳对游玩体验的影响。

sessions.title: UX Summit: Storytelling Is Design: A Human Centric Approach to Game Narrative
sessions.title_zh: UX峰会：叙事就是设计——以人为中心的游戏叙事方法

summary.en: A King narrative designer applies UX concepts to storytelling. Affordances, signifiers, accessibility, emotional journeys, personas, validation, and documentation provide the framework for the discussion.
summary.zh: King 的叙事设计师将 UX 思路用于故事创作，围绕可供性、指示符、无障碍、情感旅程、人物画像、验证及文档，讨论以人为中心的叙事方法。

sessions.title: Velocity & Luminance Adaptive Rasterization (Presented by Intel)
sessions.title_zh: 速度与亮度自适应光栅化（Intel赞助）

summary.en: Intel examines variable rate shading and a motion/content-adaptive error metric in MiniEngine, including implementation choices and quality tradeoffs.
summary.zh: Intel 介绍可变速率着色及 MiniEngine 中针对运动和内容的自适应误差度量，讨论实现优化与画质取舍。

youtube.title: Velocity & Luminance Adaptive Rasterization | GDC 2022 | Intel Software

sessions.title: Version Control for Game Developers (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 面向游戏开发者的版本控制

summary.en: Unity's related 2022 best-practice guide links version control with project organization and collaboration across technical and art roles. It compares centralized and distributed workflows, then addresses asset metadata, large files, branching and review as practical parts of a team workflow.
summary.zh: Unity 的 2022 年相关实践指南把版本控制与项目组织、程序和美术协作联系起来，比较集中式与分布式流程，并讨论资产元数据、大文件、分支和审查等团队工作环节。

evidence.note: 采用 Unity 公开提供的 2022 年版本控制实践电子书，未认定为 Michael Saver、Neha Khalwadekar 与 Marie-Christine Babin 的 GDC 幻灯片。

articles.title: Unity 官方中文课程页：GDC 2022 Plastic SCM

sessions.title: Virtual Sync: Terabytes on Demand
sessions.title_zh: Virtual Sync：按需获取TB级数据

summary.en: This talk examines a virtual file system that fetches game assets only when needed. The development account covers performance, operating-system constraints, and monitoring while supporting large projects and remote work.
summary.zh: 介绍按需获取游戏资产的虚拟文件系统，回顾面对大型项目与远程办公数据传输需求时，性能、操作系统限制和规模化监控等方面的工程问题。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: Animating Pixels
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：让像素动起来

summary.en: This session connects pixel-animation techniques with mobile UI, effects, and environments. Tool demonstrations and animated math explanations examine particle systems, bitmaps, vector fields, and shader operations.
summary.zh: 把像素动画方法用于移动游戏的 UI、特效和环境，通过工具演示与动态数学解释，讨论粒子、位图、向量场及着色器运算如何参与制作。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: Can We Do It with Particles?: VFX Learnings from 'Returnal'

summary.en: Housemarque describes programmable particles and simulation techniques behind key Returnal visual effects.
summary.zh: Housemarque 分享《Returnal》关键视觉效果所用的可编程粒子与模拟技术。

youtube.title: Can We Do It with Particles?: VFX Learnings from 'Returnal'

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: FX in 'Lost Survivors': From Vision to Production
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：《Lost Survivors》的特效——从愿景到制作

summary.en: The Lost Survivors team traces an FX vision into production for a resource-management mobile game. Stylized fluid techniques, scalable effects, data handling, and shaders for non-specialist artists form the main examples.
summary.zh: 《Lost Survivors》团队梳理资源管理手游的特效目标如何进入制作，介绍风格化流体、可扩展效果、数据管理，以及便于非特效美术使用的着色器方案。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: How Parameters Drive the Particle Effects of 'Forza Horizon 5'
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：参数如何驱动《极限竞速：地平线5》的粒子特效

summary.en: Playground Games examines rebuilding effects in a node-based editor during remote production. The talk uses examples to show how parameter-driven systems supported a broad range of Forza Horizon 5 effects.
summary.zh: Playground Games 回顾远程制作期间使用节点式编辑器重建特效的经历，通过《极限竞速：地平线5》的例子说明参数驱动系统如何支持多样化效果制作。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: How to (Not) Create Textures for VFX
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：如何制作，以及避免误做特效纹理

summary.en: This overview compares texture types used in VFX and methods for creating them. Painting, photo compositing, procedural generation, and simulation are considered as starting points for artists choosing an approach.
summary.zh: 概览特效常用的漫反射、查找表、侵蚀和流动等纹理，并比较绘制、照片合成、程序生成及模拟等制作方式，帮助美术人员判断从何入手。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: How to Think like a Scripted Particle
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：像脚本化粒子一样思考

summary.en: Phillip James uses practical examples to introduce scripted-particle workflows. The session examines how artists can approach flexible tools such as Niagara, PopcornFX, and VFX Graph without treating them only as complex technical showcases.
summary.zh: Phillip James 通过实际情境介绍脚本化粒子的思考方式，讨论美术人员如何开始使用 Niagara、PopcornFX 和 VFX Graph 等灵活工具，将功能落实到日常制作。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: Restoring the Forest: Capturing the Themes of 'Kena' Through VFX
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：恢复森林——用特效表达《柯娜》的主题

summary.en: Ember Lab discusses VFX supporting restoration and regrowth in Kena: Bridge of Spirits. Layered feedback for clearing corruption and effects for the Rot's abilities connect gameplay actions with environmental themes.
summary.zh: Ember Lab 介绍《柯娜：精神之桥》中表达恢复与再生的特效，通过清除腐化的分层反馈和 Rot 能力效果，讨论玩家行动与环境主题的视觉联系。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: VFX as a Game Design Language
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：作为游戏设计语言的特效

summary.en: This talk examines VFX as a way to communicate broad game-design ideas through art direction. It proposes a shared vocabulary for discussing creative decisions and collaboration around effects.
summary.zh: 把特效视为通过美术指导传达游戏设计概念的方式，讨论相关原则与共同语言如何帮助团队交流创作判断，并组织特效协作。

sessions.title: Voices in the Machine: Making Space for Yourself in AAA
sessions.title_zh: 机器中的声音：在AAA项目中为自己留出空间

summary.en: Drawing on Far Cry 6, the speaker discusses personal expression inside a large production structure. The proposed approach considers finding one's creative voice and making space for other individual perspectives.
summary.zh: 结合《孤岛惊魂6》的经历，讨论大型制作结构中的个人表达，介绍如何发现自己的创作声音，并为其他成员的经验和视角提供空间。

sessions.title: Welcome to the Shift Show! (Presented by Digital.ai Software, Inc.)
sessions.title_zh: 欢迎来到变革秀：理解游戏安全威胁

summary.en: Amir Amitai examines how permissive and restrictive platforms expose games to different threats. His introduction uses memory-editing experiences to frame actionable approaches to building security into games.
summary.zh: Amir Amitai 讨论开放程度不同的平台会给游戏带来哪些安全威胁，开场结合内存修改经历，说明如何从攻击者视角思考游戏内建安全。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，已核对讲者 Amir Amitai，未推断后续具体防护措施。

sessions.title: What Being Neurodivergent Means in Game Development
companies: Radiant G! Studios & Pro Game Guides
tags: Radiant G! Studios & Pro Game Guides
sessions.title_zh: 神经多样性对游戏开发意味着什么

summary.en: Developers share how neurodivergence affects their work and careers. Their accounts examine everyday development processes and ways of navigating workplaces designed around neurotypical expectations.
summary.zh: 多位开发者分享神经多样性如何影响工作与职业经历，讨论日常开发过程，以及如何在以神经典型预期组织的职场中寻找合适的工作方式。

sessions.title: What if Your Phone's Avatar Is in the Game or Metaverse? (Presented by Samsung Electronics)
sessions.title_zh: 如果手机虚拟化身进入游戏或元宇宙会怎样？（Samsung赞助）

summary.en: Samsung presents Galaxy AR Emoji and its SDK for carrying a user's avatar into other applications. The session considers their use in game characters and virtual spaces.
summary.zh: Samsung 介绍 Galaxy AR Emoji 及其 SDK，讨论如何把用户的虚拟化身带入其他应用，并用于游戏角色与虚拟空间。

sessions.title: What the Fungible? A Developer Discussion on NFTs
companies: Petaverse Network / Tiny Rebel Games Ltd.
tags: Petaverse Network / Tiny Rebel Games Ltd.
sessions.title_zh: 这是什么可替代性？开发者谈NFT

summary.en: This developer debate examines competing claims about NFTs in games. The discussion considers environmental impact, speculation, inequality, player influence, and the possibilities of a new audience relationship.
summary.zh: 开发者围绕游戏 NFT 的不同主张展开讨论，涉及环境影响、投机、玩家差距、玩家参与决策，以及新技术可能带来的受众关系变化。

sessions.title: What the UK Games Industry Learned from Its Census
sessions.title_zh: 英国游戏行业从人口普查中学到了什么

summary.en: Results from the 2019 and 2021 UK Games Industry Censuses examine the workforce's makeup. The session considers different dimensions of diversity, especially socioeconomic background, and workers' views of their sector.
summary.zh: 介绍 2019 和 2021 年英国游戏行业人口普查结果，从不同维度分析从业者构成，尤其关注社会经济背景，并讨论工作人员对所在行业的感受。

sessions.title: What's New with the Android Game Development Kit (Presented by Google)
sessions.title_zh: Android Game Development Kit 的新功能

summary.en: Scott Carbon-Ogden reviews AGDK's integrated workflows, C/C++ libraries and performance tools. The opening highlights Visual Studio 2022 support and improvements to Java and JNI debugging in the Android Game Development Extension.
summary.zh: Scott Carbon-Ogden 梳理 AGDK 的集成流程、C/C++ 库与性能工具，开场重点介绍 Visual Studio 2022 支持，以及 Android Game Development Extension 的 Java 和 JNI 调试改进。

evidence.note: 依据公开英文字幕的开场部分整理，已核对讲者与产品。

sessions.title: What's Next for Gaming? Trends To Expect in 2022 (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏的下一步：2022 年值得关注的趋势

summary.en: Unity examines industry patterns through its 2022 Gaming Report. The official session description combines data from Unity's systems with expert analysis to discuss building and operating games.
summary.zh: Unity 借助 2022 游戏报告讨论行业变化，官方讲座说明结合系统数据与专家分析，围绕游戏构建和运营提供观察。

sessions.title: Winning the Launch with Google Ad Solutions (Presented by Google)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Google 广告方案把握游戏首发

summary.en: Jen and Katie examine launch as a distinct stage of a game's lifecycle. Their workflow links measurement, open testing, monetization planning and pre-registration campaigns with preparation for release.
summary.zh: Jen 与 Katie 将首发视为游戏生命周期中的独立阶段，讨论指标测量、开放测试、变现规划与预注册广告如何共同服务发行准备。

evidence.note: 播放器开场称活动为 Google for Games Developer Summit。导读依据其中实际可见的同主题材料，未认定另有相同的 GDC 现场录制。

sessions.title: Women Building Careers in the Games Industry: What It's Gonna Take
tags: University of Southern California, USC Games
sessions.title_zh: 女性如何在游戏行业建立职业生涯：还需要什么？

summary.en: Women working in games discuss career paths, education, and advancement through personal accounts. The panel compares approaches to inclusion and considers barriers that continue to affect underrepresented groups.
summary.zh: 游戏行业女性通过个人经历讨论教育、入行和职业晋升，交流包容措施中有效与不足的做法，以及代表不足群体仍面临的障碍。

sessions.title: Women Building the Metaverse (Presented by Meta)
sessions.title_zh: 建设元宇宙的女性（Meta赞助）

summary.en: Meta leaders discuss inclusion in games and social experiences. Their different disciplines provide perspectives on representation, diversity, and accessibility.
summary.zh: Meta 女性负责人从不同专业角度讨论游戏和社交体验中的包容性，涉及文化呈现、多样性与无障碍。

sessions.title: Women in Games in LATAM: Where Are We Standing?
companies: Puerto Rico Science Technology & Research Trust
tags: Puerto Rico Science Technology & Research Trust
sessions.title_zh: 拉丁美洲游戏行业中的女性：我们身处何处？

summary.en: Women from across Latin America discuss regional initiatives for diversity, equity, and inclusion. The panel examines entry barriers, opportunities, and strategies for supporting women's growth in the games industry.
summary.zh: 来自拉丁美洲多地的女性讨论地区多样性、公平与包容举措，交流进入行业时的特殊障碍、机会，以及支持女性在游戏领域成长的策略。

sessions.title: XAI-Enhanced Data Driven Player Churn Analysis for Actionable Decision Making
sessions.title_zh: 以可解释AI增强数据驱动的玩家流失分析，支持可执行决策

summary.en: NetEase presents a churn-analysis framework combining prediction, explanations, and intervention evaluation. Cases from card games and MMORPGs examine feature collection and turning model output into decisions that can be followed up.
summary.zh: 网易介绍结合流失预测、原因解释与干预评估的分析框架，通过卡牌和 MMORPG 案例讨论特征采集，以及如何把模型输出转化为可追踪效果的具体决策。

sessions.title: Zwift: The World's Biggest Esports Metaverse (Presented by Zwift)
sessions.title_zh: Zwift：体育参与与电竞虚拟世界

summary.en: Zwift's marketing and engineering leaders present complementary views of its connected sports experience. The opening connects consumer identity and participation with the product's engineering challenges and roadmap.
summary.zh: Zwift 的市场与工程负责人从两种视角介绍联网体育体验，开场讨论消费者认知、运动参与，以及产品工程挑战和后续方向之间的联系。

evidence.note: 仅依据公开英文字幕中实际出现的开场议题整理。
